entry.summary: Presents NBAvatar for realistic head avatar rendering handling hand-face interaction using oriented planar primitives combined with neural rendering. Achieves up to 30% LPIPS reduction for novel-view and novel-pose rendering.

entry.title: Real-time Rendering-based Surgical Instrument Tracking via Evolutionary Optimization

author.name: Hanyang Hu, Zekai Liang, Florian Richter, Michael C. Yip

entry.summary: Incorporates CMA-ES evolutionary optimization into a rendering-based surgical instrument tracking pipeline for robot-assisted surgery. Jointly estimates state without relying on unreliable feature detections.

entry.title: COMPASS: The explainable agentic framework for Sovereignty, Sustainability, Compliance, and Ethics

author.name: Jean-S\'ebastien, Dessureault, Alain-Thierry, Iliho Manzi, Soukaina, Alaoui Ismaili, Khadim, Lo, Mireille, Lalancette, \'Eric, B\'elanger

entry.summary: COMPASS introduces a multi-agent orchestration framework integrating digital sovereignty, environmental sustainability, regulatory compliance, and ethical alignment into autonomous agent decision-making through modular governance mechanisms.

entry.title: Compiling Temporal Numeric Planning into Discrete PDDL+: Extended Version

author.name: Andrea Micheli, Enrico Scala, Alessandro Valentini

entry.summary: Presents a practical polynomial compilation from temporal planning with durative actions (PDDL 2.1) into PDDL+, filling a long-standing gap in the planning literature with experimental validation.

entry.title: Exploring Collatz Dynamics with Human-LLM Collaboration

author.name: Edward Y. Chang

entry.summary: Explores Collatz conjecture dynamics through human-LLM collaboration, proving structural results about modular scrambling and burst-gap decomposition. Demonstrates LLM utility as a mathematical exploration partner.

entry.title: A Simple Efficiency Incremental Learning Framework via Vision-Language Model with Nonlinear Multi-Adapters

author.name: Haihua Luo, Xuming Ran, Jiangrong Shen, Timo H\"am\"al\"ainen, Zhonghua Chen, Qi Xu, Fengyu Cong

entry.summary: Proposes SimE, a simple framework using vision-language models with nonlinear multi-adapters for incremental learning, discovering a nonlinear correlation between adapter connections and performance that enables efficient training.

entry.title: Bridging Discrete Marks and Continuous Dynamics: Dual-Path Cross-Interaction for Marked Temporal Point Processes

author.name: Yuxiang Liu, Qiao Liu, Tong Luo, Yanglei Gan, Peng He, Yao LIu

entry.summary: Proposes NEXTPP, a dual-channel framework combining discrete event mark encoding with continuous Neural ODE dynamics via cross-interaction for marked temporal point processes.

entry.title: SPEGC: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Semantic-Prompt-Enhanced Graph Clustering for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Xiaogang Du, Jiawei Zhang, Tongfei Liu, Tao Lei, Yingbo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SPEGC for continual test-time adaptation in medical image segmentation, using semantic prompt-enhanced graph clustering to avoid error accumulation from unreliable supervisory signals.

entry.title: FBCIR: Balancing Cross-Modal Focuses in Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Chenchen Zhao, Jianhuan Zhuo, Muxi Chen, Zhaohua Zhang, Wenyu Jiang, Tianwen Jiang, Qiuyong Xiao, Jihong Zhang, Qiang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes FBCIR, a method to diagnose focus imbalances in composed image retrieval models and demonstrates that models disproportionately attend to one modality, degrading performance on challenging cases.

entry.title: How Intelligence Emerges: A Minimal Theory of Dynamic Adaptive Coordination

author.name: Stefano Grassi

entry.summary: Develops a dynamical theory of adaptive coordination in multi-agent systems treating coordination as a structural property of coupled dynamics rather than centralized optimization. Establishes convergence and stability results.

entry.title: Toward Complex-Valued Neural Networks for Waveform Generation

author.name: Hyung-Seok Oh, Deok-Hyeon Cho, Seung-Bin Kim, Seong-Whan Lee

entry.summary: Presents ComVo, a complex-valued neural vocoder where both generator and discriminator use native complex arithmetic for iSTFT-based waveform generation, better capturing the inherent structure of complex spectrograms.

entry.title: Survival Meets Classification: A Novel Framework for Early Risk Prediction Models of Chronic Diseases

author.name: Shaheer Ahmad Khan, Muhammad Usamah Shahid, Muddassar Farooq

entry.summary: Proposes a novel framework integrating survival analysis with classification for early chronic disease risk prediction across five diseases using EMR data, showing survival methods can be re-engineered for effective classification.

entry.title: Stable Spike: Dual Consistency Optimization via Bitwise AND Operations for Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Yongqi Ding, Kunshan Yang, Linze Li, Yiyang Zhang, Mengmeng Jing, Lin Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes Stable Spike for spiking neural networks, using bitwise AND operations to decouple stable spike skeletons from noisy spikes across timesteps, improving consistency and recognition performance.

entry.title: Hybrid Human-Agent Social Dilemmas in Energy Markets

author.name: Isuri Perera, Frits de Nijs, Julian Garcia

entry.summary: Studies hybrid human-agent social dilemmas in energy load management, showing artificial agents using globally observable signals can increase coordination through evolutionary dynamics and reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Beyond Convolution: A Taxonomy of Structured Operators for Learning-Based Image Processing

author.name: Simone Cammarasana

entry.summary: Provides a systematic taxonomy of operators that extend or replace standard convolution in learning-based image processing, organizing alternatives into five families including decomposition-based, adaptive, and non-linear operators.

entry.title: Learning Tree-Based Models with Gradient Descent

author.name: Sascha Marton

entry.summary: Thesis proposing a method for learning decision trees with gradient descent by making the discrete tree structure differentiable, enabling integration with modern ML approaches.

entry.title: Beyond Barren Plateaus: A Scalable Quantum Convolutional Architecture for High-Fidelity Image Classification

author.name: Radhakrishnan Delhibabu

entry.summary: Proposes a QCNN architecture with localized cost functions and tensor-network initialization to mitigate barren plateaus, achieving 98.7% on MNIST.

entry.title: Huntington Disease Automatic Speech Recognition with Biomarker Supervision

author.name: Charles L. Wang, Cady Chen, Ziwei Gong, Julia Hirschberg

entry.summary: Presents a systematic study of ASR for Huntington's disease speech, comparing multiple ASR architectures and proposing biomarker-based auxiliary supervision, reducing WER from 6.99% to 4.95%.

entry.title: Duration Aware Scheduling for ASR Serving Under Workload Drift

author.name: Darshan Makwana, Yash Jogi, Harsh Kotta, Aayush Kubba

entry.summary: Proposes duration-aware scheduling (SJF, HRRN) for ASR serving pipelines, using audio duration as a proxy for processing time to reduce head-of-line blocking under workload drift.

entry.title: ZTab: Domain-based Zero-shot Annotation for Table Columns

author.name: Ehsan Hoseinzade, Ke Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ZTab, a domain-based zero-shot framework for semantic column type detection in relational tables that addresses performance with many column types while avoiding privacy risks of closed-source LLMs.

entry.title: UniHetCO: A Unified Heterogeneous Representation for Multi-Problem Learning in Unsupervised Neural Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Kien X. Nguyen, Ilya Safro

entry.summary: Proposes UniHetCO, a unified heterogeneous graph representation for solving multiple combinatorial optimization problems (e.g., Max Clique, Max Independent Set) within a single unsupervised neural framework using constrained quadratic programming encodings. This eliminates the need for problem-specific surrogate losses.

entry.title: CAETC: Causal Autoencoding and Treatment Conditioning for Counterfactual Estimation over Time

author.name: Nghia D. Nguyen, Pablo Robles-Granda, Lav R. Varshney

entry.summary: Introduces CAETC for counterfactual estimation over time using adversarial representation learning with an autoencoding architecture. Addresses time-dependent confounding bias in observational data for applications like personalized medicine.

entry.title: A Further Efficient Algorithm with Best-of-Both-Worlds Guarantees for $m$-Set Semi-Bandit Problem

author.name: Botao Chen, Jongyeong Lee, Chansoo Kim, Junya Honda

entry.summary: Studies FTPL optimality for m-set semi-bandit problems, showing that FTPL with specific distributions achieves optimal regret bounds and best-of-both-worlds guarantees with improved computational efficiency.

entry.title: Topological DeepONets and a generalization of the Chen-Chen operator approximation theorem

author.name: Vugar Ismailov

entry.summary: Develops a topological extension of DeepONets where the operator input lies in an arbitrary Hausdorff locally convex space, generalizing the Chen-Chen operator approximation theorem to this broader setting.

entry.title: Efficient Generative Modeling with Unitary Matrix Product States Using Riemannian Optimization

author.name: Haotong Duan, Zhongming Chen, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Studies unitary matrix product states (MPS) for generative modeling with Riemannian optimization, showing clear benefits over standard MPS training through reduced parameter ambiguity and improved efficiency.

entry.title: Conformal e-prediction in the presence of confounding

author.name: Vladimir Vovk, Ruodu Wang

entry.summary: Extends conformal e-prediction to handle observed confounding between features X and labels Y, covering both IID and spatially dependent observation settings.

entry.title: A Unified Latent Space Disentanglement VAE Framework with Robust Disentanglement Effectiveness Evaluation

author.name: Xiaoan Lang, Fang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes bfVAE, a unified framework for disentangled VAEs with new evaluation metrics (FVH-LT, DBSR-LS) for assessing disentanglement effectiveness, especially for tabular data where ground-truth factors are unknown.

entry.title: MRI2Qmap: multi-parametric quantitative mapping with MRI-driven denoising priors

author.name: Mohammad Golbabaee, Matteo Cencini, Carolin Pirkl, Marion Menzel, Michela Tosetti, Bjoern Menze

entry.summary: Introduces MRI2Qmap, a plug-and-play framework for quantitative MRI reconstruction that leverages training data from clinically-routine weighted MRI images to overcome the scarcity of quantitative imaging training data.

entry.title: Spatially Robust Inference with Predicted and Missing at Random Labels

author.name: Stephen Salerno, Zhenke Wu, Tyler McCormick

entry.summary: Proposes a doubly robust estimator for spatial inference with predicted labels and missing-at-random data, addressing fold-level correlation from cross-fitting that distorts spatial variance estimators.

entry.title: Cross-Resolution Attention Network for High-Resolution PM2.5 Prediction

author.name: Ammar Kheder, Helmi Toropainen, Wenqing Peng, Samuel Ant\~ao, Zhi-Song Liu, Michael Boy

entry.summary: Introduces CRAN-PM, a dual-branch Vision Transformer with cross-resolution attention for continent-scale high-resolution PM2.5 prediction, incorporating elevation-aware and wind-guided attention mechanisms.

entry.title: BLooP: Zero-Shot Abstractive Summarization using Large Language Models with Bigram Lookahead Promotion

author.name: Varun Iyer, Cornelia Caragea

entry.summary: Proposes BLooP, a training-free decoding intervention for abstractive summarization that promotes tokens forming bigrams from the source document via hash table lookup, improving faithfulness in zero-shot LLM summarization.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Biomedical Article Classification

author.name: Jakub Proboszcz, Pawe{\l} Cichosz

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates LLMs as text classifiers for biomedical article classification across 15 datasets, comparing various prompting strategies and output processing methods against conventional classifiers.

entry.title: Beyond Polarity: Multi-Dimensional LLM Sentiment Signals for WTI Crude Oil Futures Return Prediction

author.name: Dehao Dai, Ding Ma, Dou Liu, Kerui Geng, Yiqing Wang

entry.summary: Examines multi-dimensional LLM-extracted sentiment signals (relevance, polarity, intensity, uncertainty, forwardness) for predicting WTI crude oil futures returns, comparing GPT-4o, Llama 3.2, FinBERT.

entry.title: Evidential learning driven Breast Tumor Segmentation with Stage-divided Vision-Language Interaction

author.name: Jingxing Zhong, Qingtao Pan, Xuchang Zhou, Jiazhen Lin, Xinguo Zhuang

entry.summary: Proposes TextBCS, a text-guided breast tumor segmentation model using evidential learning and stage-divided vision-language interaction for MRI analysis.

entry.title: Towards Automated Initial Probe Placement in Transthoracic Teleultrasound Using Human Mesh and Skeleton Recovery

author.name: Yu Chung Lee, David G. Black, Ryan S. Yeung, Septimiu E. Salcudean

entry.summary: Presents a framework for automated initial ultrasound probe placement guidance using human mesh and skeleton recovery from RGB images, targeting teleultrasound applications.

entry.title: ActiveFreq: Integrating Active Learning and Frequency Domain Analysis for Interactive Segmentation

author.name: Lijun Guo, Qian Zhou, Zidi Shi, Hua Zou, Gang Ke

entry.summary: Proposes ActiveFreq for interactive medical image segmentation, combining active learning for region selection with frequency domain analysis for enhanced feature extraction.

entry.title: UCAN: Unified Convolutional Attention Network for Expansive Receptive Fields in Lightweight Super-Resolution

author.name: Cao Thien Tan, Phan Thi Thu Trang, Do Nghiem Duc, Ho Ngoc Anh, Hanyang Zhuang, Nguyen Duc Dung

entry.summary: Presents UCAN, a lightweight super-resolution network that unifies convolution and attention for expanded receptive fields. Combines window-based spatial attention with Hedgehog Attention and cross-layer parameter sharing for efficiency.

entry.title: VTEdit-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multi-Reference Image Editing Models in Virtual Try-On

author.name: Xiaoye Liang, Zhiyuan Qu, Mingye Zou, Jiaxin Liu, Lai Jiang, Mai Xu, Yiheng Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces VTEdit-Bench, a benchmark evaluating universal multi-reference image editing models for virtual try-on scenarios. Systematically assesses strengths and limitations of general editors compared to specialized VTON models.

entry.title: Derain-Agent: A Plug-and-Play Agent Framework for Rainy Image Restoration

author.name: Zhaocheng Yu, Xiang Chen, Runzhe Li, Zihan Geng, Guanglu Sun, Haipeng Li, Kui Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes Derain-Agent, a plug-and-play framework that uses agent-based dynamic restoration for image deraining. Includes a Planning Network for tool scheduling and Strength Modulation for adaptive processing.

entry.title: Pano360: Perspective to Panoramic Vision with Geometric Consistency

author.name: Zhengdong Zhu, Weiyi Xue, Zuyuan Yang, Wenlve Zhou, Zhiheng Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Pano360 for panorama stitching that extends 2D alignment to 3D photogrammetric space using transformer-based architecture. Uses camera poses to guide global alignment, addressing distortion in challenging scenes.

entry.title: Nyxus: A Next Generation Image Feature Extraction Library for the Big Data and AI Era

author.name: Nicholas Schaub, Andriy Kharchenko, Hamdah Abbasi, Sameeul Samee, Hythem Sidky, Nathan Hotaling

entry.summary: Introduces Nyxus, a feature extraction library designed for scalable processing of terabyte-to-petabyte imaging datasets. Handles the gap between modern segmentation and feature extraction across scientific disciplines.

entry.title: GeNeX: Genetic Network eXperts framework for addressing Validation Overfitting

author.name: Emmanuel Pintelas, Ioannis E. Livieris

entry.summary: Proposes GeNeX, a framework using genetic algorithms to mitigate validation overfitting in both model generation and ensemble construction. Particularly targets low-data regimes and distribution shift scenarios.

entry.title: ADMM-based Continuous Trajectory Optimization in Graphs of Convex Sets

author.name: Lukas Pries, Jon Arrizabalaga, Zachary Manchester, Markus Ryll

entry.summary: Presents an ADMM-based solver for continuous trajectory optimization in non-convex environments using polynomial parameterization and spatio-temporal allocation graphs. Achieves joint optimization over discrete spatial and continuous temporal domains.

entry.title: MirrorDrift: Actuated Mirror-Based Attacks on LiDAR SLAM

author.name: Rokuto Nagata, Kenji Koide, Kazuma Ikeda, Ozora Sako, Shion Horie, Kentaro Yoshioka

entry.summary: Demonstrates MirrorDrift, a physical attack on LiDAR SLAM using actuated planar mirrors to create ghost points, providing an injection-free alternative to LiDAR spoofing. Shows significant localization drift in simulation experiments.

entry.title: D-SLAMSpoof: An Environment-Agnostic LiDAR Spoofing Attack using Dynamic Point Cloud Injection

author.name: Rokuto Nagata, Kenji Koide, Kazuma Ikeda, Ozora Sako, Kentaro Yoshioka

entry.summary: Introduces D-SLAMSpoof, a dynamic LiDAR spoofing attack that compromises SLAM even in feature-rich environments through temporally coordinated injection patterns. Also proposes ISD-SLAM, a defense method using inertial dead reckoning.

entry.title: Enhancing Lightweight Vision Language Models through Group Competitive Learning for Socially Compliant Navigation

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Atsushi Konno, Toshihiko Yamasaki, Ling Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes Group Competitive Learning (GCL) to enhance lightweight Vision Language Models for socially compliant robot navigation. Aims to bridge the gap between reasoning capability and inference efficiency for real-time robotic deployment.

entry.title: Modeling a Constant-Compute Automated AI R&D Process

author.name: Satya Benson

entry.summary: Attempts to model how compute constraints affect AI R&D acceleration using Jones-style idea production models. Explores whether constant compute could limit recursive AI self-improvement.

entry.title: Evaluating Explainable AI Attribution Methods in Neural Machine Translation via Attention-Guided Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Aria Nourbakhsh, Salima Lamsiyah, Adelaide Danilov, Christoph Schommer

entry.summary: Proposes using teacher-derived attribution maps as structured signals in knowledge distillation to evaluate explainability methods for transformer-based seq2seq models in neural machine translation.

entry.title: A Learning-Based Superposition Operator for Non-Renewal Arrival Processes in Queueing Networks

author.name: Eliran Sherzer

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning-based superposition operator for non-renewal arrival processes in queueing networks, mapping moments and autocorrelation descriptors to merged process characteristics.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Policy Optimization via Bellman Consistency and Hybrid Critics

author.name: Ming-Hong Chen, Kuan-Chen Pan, You-De Huang, Xi Liu, Ping-Chun Hsieh

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-domain RL method using Bellman consistency and hybrid critics to jointly address state/action space mismatches and negative transfer risks between source and target domains.

entry.title: Decomposing Observational Multiplicity in Decision Trees: Leaf and Structural Regret

author.name: Mustafa Cavus

entry.summary: Introduces leaf regret and structural regret as complementary notions of observational multiplicity for decision trees, extending theoretical frameworks previously limited to logistic regression.

entry.title: PROMO: Promptable Outfitting for Efficient High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On

author.name: Haohua Chen, Tianze Zhou, Wei Zhu, Runqi Wang, Yandong Guan, Dejia Song, Yibo Chen, Xu Tang, Yao Hu, Lu Sheng, Zhiyong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes PROMO for efficient high-fidelity virtual try-on, approaching VTON as structured image editing. Aims to balance fidelity and efficiency by avoiding auxiliary reference networks while maintaining photorealistic synthesis.

entry.title: Single Pixel Image Classification using an Ultrafast Digital Light Projector

author.name: Aisha Kanwal, Graeme E. Johnstone, Fahimeh Dehkhoda, Johannes H. Herrnsdorf, Robert K. Henderson, Martin D. Dawson, Xavier Porte, Michael J. Strain

entry.summary: Demonstrates image classification at multi-kHz frame rates using single pixel imaging with microLED-on-CMOS digital light projector combined with lightweight ML models. Tests on MNIST classification.

entry.title: Edge-Assisted Multi-Robot Visual-Inertial SLAM with Efficient Communication

author.name: Xin Liu, Shuhuan Wen, Jing Zhao, Tony Z. Qiu, Hong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an edge-assisted multi-robot SLAM system using pyramid IMU prediction for lightweight optical flow tracking. Combines edge and cloud computing for real-time multi-robot mapping.

entry.title: CoViLLM: An Adaptive Human-Robot Collaborative Assembly Framework Using Large Language Models for Manufacturing

author.name: Jiabao Zhao, Jonghan Lim, Hongliang Li, Ilya Kovalenko

entry.summary: Proposes CoViLLM, an adaptive human-robot collaborative assembly framework using LLMs for manufacturing. Combines depth-camera localization with LLM-based task planning to handle customized and previously unseen product assembly.

entry.title: AI Psychometrics: Evaluating the Psychological Reasoning of Large Language Models with Psychometric Validities

author.name: Yibai Li, Xiaolin Lin, Zhenghui Sha, Zhiye Jin, Xiaobing Li

entry.summary: Applies psychometric methodologies to evaluate psychological reasoning of LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, LLaMA-2, LLaMA-3) using the Technology Acceptance Model, examining convergent, discriminant, predictive, and external validity.

entry.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Encoding for Accurate Residue-Level pKa Prediction

author.name: Van Le, Tan Le

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid quantum-classical framework for predicting residue-level pKa values in proteins, combining Gaussian kernel quantum-inspired features with a Deep Quantum Neural Network architecture.

entry.title: Quality-Driven Agentic Reasoning for LLM-Assisted Software Design: Questions-of-Thoughts (QoT) as a Time-Series Self-QA Chain

author.name: Yen-Ku Liu, Yun-Cheng Tsai

entry.summary: Introduces Questions-of-Thoughts (QoT), a quality-driven prompting scaffold that decomposes user goals into engineering steps with self-questioning verification for LLM-assisted software design. Evaluated across API design, data communication, and file system tasks.

entry.title: A Stable Neural Statistical Dependence Estimator for Autoencoder Feature Analysis

author.name: Bo Hu, Jose C Principe

entry.summary: Proposes a stable neural statistical dependence estimator for autoencoder analysis based on orthonormal density-ratio decomposition, avoiding the computational issues of MINE while enabling meaningful dependence measurements.

entry.title: Causal Prosody Mediation for Text-to-Speech:Counterfactual Training of Duration, Pitch, and Energy in FastSpeech2

author.name: Suvendu Sekhar Mohanty

entry.summary: Proposes a causal prosody mediation framework for expressive TTS, augmenting FastSpeech2 with emotion conditioning and counterfactual training objectives to disentangle emotional prosody from linguistic content.

entry.title: HELM: Hierarchical and Explicit Label Modeling with Graph Learning for Multi-Label Image Classification

author.name: Marjan Stoimchev, Boshko Koloski, Jurica Levati\'c, Dragi Kocev, Sa\v{s}o D\v{z}eroski

entry.summary: Introduces HELM for hierarchical multi-label image classification in remote sensing, using hierarchy-specific class tokens in ViT, graph convolutions for hierarchy encoding, and self-supervised learning for unlabeled data.

entry.title: Sim-to-reality adaptation for Deep Reinforcement Learning applied to an underwater docking application

author.name: Alaaeddine Chaarani, Narcis Palomeras, Pere Ridao

entry.summary: Presents a sim-to-real transfer approach for autonomous underwater docking using deep RL (PPO) with a high-fidelity digital twin, including a multiprocessing framework to accelerate training.

entry.title: SommBench: Assessing Sommelier Expertise of Language Models

author.name: William Brach, Tomas Bedej, Jacob Nielsen, Jacob Pichna, Juraj Bedej, Eemeli Saarensilta, Julie Dupouy, Gianluca Barmina, Andrea Blasi N\'u\~nez, Peter Schneider-Kamp, Kristian Ko\v{s}\v{t}\'al, Michal Ries, Lukas Galke Poech

entry.summary: Introduces SommBench, a multilingual benchmark testing LLM sommelier expertise across wine theory, feature completion, and food-wine pairing - a domain grounded in sensory knowledge that LLMs can only learn textually.

entry.title: Group Resonance Network: Learnable Prototypes and Multi-Subject Resonance for EEG Emotion Recognition

author.name: Renwei Meng

entry.summary: Proposes Group Resonance Network for cross-subject EEG emotion recognition, combining individual EEG features with group-level prototypes and multi-subject synchrony patterns.

entry.title: Single molecule localization microscopy challenge: a biologically inspired benchmark for long-sequence modeling

author.name: Fatemeh Valeh, Monika Farsang, Radu Grosu, Gerhard Sch\"utz

entry.summary: Introduces SMLM Challenge, a benchmark for evaluating state space models on biologically realistic single molecule localization microscopy data.

entry.title: Hybrid Energy-Aware Reward Shaping: A Unified Lightweight Physics-Guided Methodology for Policy Optimization

author.name: Qijun Liao (School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing, China), Jue Yang (School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing, China), Yiting Kang (School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing, China), Xinxin Zhao (School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing, China), Yong Zhang (Jiangsu XCMG Construction Machinery Research Institute Co., Ltd., China), Mingan Zhao (Jiangsu XCMG Construction Machinery Research Institute Co., Ltd., China)

entry.summary: Proposes H-EARS, a hybrid energy-aware reward shaping method for deep RL that combines potential-based reward shaping with energy-aware action regularization, achieving linear complexity while providing theoretical convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Legal-DC: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Legal Documents

author.name: Yaocong Li, Qiang Lan, Leihan Zhang, Le Zhang

entry.summary: Constructs Legal-DC benchmark for Chinese legal RAG with 480 documents and 2,475 QA pairs, and proposes a structure-aware RAG approach for legal provisions.

entry.title: To Words and Beyond: Probing Large Language Models for Sentence-Level Psycholinguistic Norms of Memorability and Reading Times

author.name: Thomas Hikaru Clark, Carlos Arriaga, Javier Conde, Gonzalo Mart\'inez, Pedro Reviriego

entry.summary: Extends psycholinguistic norm probing of LLMs to sentence-level features (memorability and reading times), finding that fine-tuning enables alignment with human judgments for these previously unstudied norms.

entry.title: DeepHistoViT: An Interpretable Vision Transformer Framework for Histopathological Cancer Classification

author.name: Ravi Mosalpuri, Mohammed Abdelsamea, Ahmed Karam Eldaly

entry.summary: Proposes DeepHistoViT, a Vision Transformer framework for histopathological cancer classification with an integrated attention mechanism for interpretability.

entry.title: PCA-Enhanced Probabilistic U-Net for Effective Ambiguous Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Xiangyu Li, Chenglin Wang, Qiantong Shen, Fanding Li, Wei Wang, Kuanquan Wang, Yi Shen, Baochun Zhao, Gongning Luo

entry.summary: Proposes PEP U-Net, which integrates PCA into the posterior network of a Probabilistic U-Net for ambiguous medical image segmentation, reducing redundancy in high-dimensional latent spaces and improving computational efficiency. The inverse PCA operation restores expressiveness for multi-hypothesis generation.

entry.title: Towards Universal Computational Aberration Correction in Photographic Cameras: A Comprehensive Benchmark Analysis

author.name: Xiaolong Qian, Qi Jiang, Yao Gao, Lei Sun, Zhonghua Yi, Kailun Yang, Luc Van Gool, Kaiwei Wang

entry.summary: Presents comprehensive benchmark analysis for computational aberration correction across diverse photographic lenses. Identifies factors influencing CAC methods and their cross-lens generalization.

entry.title: Shadowless Projection Mapping for Tabletop Workspaces with Synthetic Aperture Projector

author.name: Takahiro Okamoto, Masaki Takeuchi, Masataka Sawayama, Daisuke Iwai

entry.summary: Introduces a synthetic aperture projector for shadow-free projection mapping on tabletop workspaces. Uses multiple projector positions to compensate for user occlusion without computational latency.

entry.title: Deep Learning-based Assessment of the Relation Between the Third Molar and Mandibular Canal on Panoramic Radiographs using Local, Centralized, and Federated Learning

author.name: Johan Andreas Balle Rubak, Sara Haghighat, Sanyam Jain, Mostafa Aldesoki, Akhilanand Chaurasia, Sarah Sadat Ehsani, Faezeh Dehghan Ghanatkaman, Ahmad Badruddin Ghazali, Julien Issa, Basel Khalil, Rishi Ramani, Ruben Pauwels

entry.summary: Compares local, federated, and centralized deep learning for classifying mandibular third molar-canal relationships on panoramic radiographs across eight labelers. Finds federated learning competitive with centralized approaches.

entry.title: A Causal Approach to Predicting and Improving Human Perceptions of Social Navigation Robots

author.name: Maximilian Diehl, Nathan Tsoi, Gustavo Chavez, Karinne Ramirez-Amaro, Marynel V\'azquez

entry.summary: Proposes a Causal Bayesian Network for predicting and improving human perceptions of social navigation robots. Uses causal rather than associative reasoning to identify controllable factors when robots are perceived as incompetent.

entry.title: MiNI-Q: A Miniature, Wire-Free Quadruped with Unbounded, Independently Actuated Leg Joints

author.name: Daniel Koh, Suraj Shah, Yufeng Wu, Dennis Hong

entry.summary: Introduces MiNI-Q², a miniature wire-free quadruped robot with mechanically unbounded 2-DOF leg joints enabling oscillatory gaits, rotary locomotion, folding to 2.5cm height, and acrobatic maneuvers like backflipping.

entry.title: Hunting Undead Stochastic Parrots: Finding and Killing the Arguments

author.name: Davidmanheim

entry.summary: Argues the 'stochastic parrot' critique of LLMs is philosophically imprecise and persistently confused. Attempts to decompose the claim into specific sub-claims and evaluate which have been refuted and which remain valid.

entry.title: Improving LLM Performance Through Black-Box Online Tuning: A Case for Adding System Specs to Factsheets for Trusted AI

author.name: Yonas Atinafu, Henry Lin, Robin Cohen

entry.summary: Presents a black-box online controller using hill climbing to maximize LLM serving goodput, and argues for integrating system performance metrics into AI Factsheets for organizational transparency.

entry.title: Automating Skill Acquisition through Large-Scale Mining of Open-Source Agentic Repositories: A Framework for Multi-Agent Procedural Knowledge Extraction

author.name: Shuzhen Bi, Mengsong Wu, Hao Hao, Keqian Li, Wentao Liu, Siyu Song, Hongbo Zhao, Aimin Zhou

entry.summary: Describes a framework for automatically extracting agent skills from open-source repositories (GitHub), focusing on visualization and educational capabilities from systems like TheoremExplainAgent and Code2Video.

entry.title: A Survey on Quantitative Modeling of Trust in Online Social Networks

author.name: Wenting Song, K. Suzanne Barber

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of quantitative trust modeling in online social networks, covering psychological theories, computational models, and their applications to misinformation detection and spam filtering.

entry.title: Unifying Logical and Physical Layout Representations via Heterogeneous Graphs for Circuit Congestion Prediction

author.name: Runbang Hu, Bo Fang, Bingzhe Li, Yuede Ji

entry.summary: Proposes VeriHGN, a heterogeneous graph neural network framework that unifies logical (netlist) and physical (layout) representations for predicting circuit congestion in VLSI design. This enables earlier detection of routing issues, potentially reducing costly design iterations.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Embodied-enhanced Beam Prediction in Low-Altitude Economy Networks

author.name: Min Hao, Zhizhuo Li, Zirui Zhang, Maoqiang Wu, Han Zhang, Rong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes multi-agent collaborative reasoning architecture for UAV-to-ground mmWave beam prediction using agentic AI with bimodal data, enabling mmWave base stations to achieve embodied intelligence for low-altitude economy networks.

entry.title: Stage-Adaptive Reliability Modeling for Continuous Valence-Arousal Estimation

author.name: Yubeen Lee, Sangeun Lee, Junyeop Cha, Eunil Park

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE, a stage-adaptive reliability modeling framework for continuous valence-arousal estimation that dynamically rebalances audio-visual modality contributions based on stage-dependent informativeness.

entry.title: EReCu: Pseudo-label Evolution Fusion and Refinement with Multi-Cue Learning for Unsupervised Camouflage Detection

author.name: Shuo Jiang, Gaojia Zhang, Min Tan, Yufei Yin, Gang Pan

entry.summary: Proposes EReCu for unsupervised camouflaged object detection, combining pseudo-label evolution with multi-cue native perception to handle the challenge of objects highly similar to their backgrounds.

entry.title: IDRL: An Individual-Aware Multimodal Depression-Related Representation Learning Framework for Depression Diagnosis

author.name: Chongxiao Wang, Junjie Liang, Peng Cao, Jinzhu Yang, Osmar R. Zaiane

entry.summary: Proposes IDRL, an individual-aware multimodal framework for depression detection that addresses inter-modal inconsistency and diverse individual depressive presentations across audio-visual modalities.

entry.title: Affect Decoding in Phonated and Silent Speech Production from Surface EMG

author.name: Simon Pistrosch, Kleanthis Avramidis, Tiantian Feng, Jihwan Lee, Monica Gonzalez-Machorro, Shrikanth Narayanan, Bj\"orn W. Schuller

entry.summary: Investigates affect decoding from facial and neck surface EMG during phonated and silent speech, introducing a dataset of 2,780 utterances and demonstrating reliable frustration discrimination (0.845 AUC).

entry.title: The Landscape of Generative AI in Information Systems: A Synthesis of Secondary Reviews and Research Agendas

author.name: Aleksander Jarz\k{e}bowicz, Adam Przyby{\l}ek, Jacinto Estima, Yen Ying Ng, Jakub Swacha, Beata Zielosko, Lech Madeyski, Noel Carroll, Kai-Kristian Kemell, Bartosz Marcinkowski, Alberto Rodrigues da Silva, Viktoria Stray, Netta Iivari, Anh Nguyen-Duc, Jorge Melegati, Boris Deliba\v{s}i\'c, Emilio Insfran

entry.summary: Synthesizes secondary reviews and research agendas on Generative AI in Information Systems, analyzing 28 papers to identify challenges in technical reliability, societal-ethical risks, and governance gaps through a socio-technical lens.

entry.title: A Multi-Label Temporal Convolutional Framework for Transcription Factor Binding Characterization

author.name: Pietro Demurtas, Ferdinando Zanchetta, Giovanni Perini, Rita Fioresi

entry.summary: Investigates transcription factor binding site prediction as a multi-label classification problem using Temporal Convolutional Networks, capturing correlations among multiple TF binding profiles simultaneously.

entry.title: RDNet: Region Proportion-Aware Dynamic Adaptive Salient Object Detection Network in Optical Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Bin Wan, Runmin Cong, Xiaofei Zhou, Hao Fang, Yaoqi Sun, Sam Kwong

entry.summary: Proposes RDNet for salient object detection in remote sensing images using SwinTransformer and dynamic convolution to handle large variations in object sizes.

entry.title: Fingerprinting Concepts in Data Streams with Supervised and Unsupervised Meta-Information

author.name: Ben Halstead, Yun Sing Koh, Patricia Riddle, Mykola Pechenizkiy, Albert Bifet, Russel Pears

entry.summary: Proposes fingerprinting concepts in data streams using both supervised and unsupervised meta-information features to better detect concept drift and identify recurring concepts.

entry.title: Teleodynamic Learning a new Paradigm For Interpretable AI

author.name: Enrique ter Horst, Juan Diego Zambrano

entry.summary: Proposes Teleodynamic Learning, a paradigm inspired by living systems where learning emerges from constrained dynamical processes with two interacting timescales rather than minimizing fixed objectives.

entry.title: abx_amr_simulator: A simulation environment for antibiotic prescribing policy optimization under antimicrobial resistance

author.name: Joyce Lee, Seth Blumberg

entry.summary: Introduces abx_amr_simulator, a Python simulation package for modeling antibiotic prescribing and antimicrobial resistance dynamics in an RL-compatible environment.

entry.title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Generalized Embedding Learning in Federated Recommendation

author.name: Fengyuan Yu, Xiaohua Feng, Yuyuan Li, Changwang Zhang, Jun Wang, Chaochao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes using sharpness-aware minimization to improve generalized item embedding learning in federated recommender systems, addressing heterogeneity and sparsity challenges in cross-device settings.

entry.title: Personalized Federated Learning via Gaussian Generative Modeling

author.name: Peng Hu, Jianwei Ma

entry.summary: Proposes pFedGM for personalized federated learning using Gaussian generative modeling to capture personalized characteristics in representation distributions, going beyond the common approach of only personalizing classifier heads.

entry.title: Context-dependent manifold learning: A neuromodulated constrained autoencoder approach

author.name: J\'er\^ome Adriaens (Neuroengineering Lab, Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, University of Li\`ege), Guillaume Drion (Neuroengineering Lab, Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, University of Li\`ege), Pierre Sacr\'e (Neuroengineering Lab, Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, University of Li\`ege)

entry.summary: Introduces the Neuromodulated Constrained Autoencoder (NcAE) that adapts geometric constraints in latent spaces via gain and bias tuning conditioned on contextual information, enabling context-dependent manifold learning for dynamical systems.

entry.title: Causal Matrix Completion under Multiple Treatments via Mixed Synthetic Nearest Neighbors

author.name: Minrui Luo, Zhiheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Mixed Synthetic Nearest Neighbors (MSNN) for causal matrix completion under multiple treatments, integrating information across treatment levels to enlarge effective sample size while retaining theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Efficient Approximation to Analytic and $L^p$ functions by Height-Augmented ReLU Networks

author.name: ZeYu Li, FengLei Fan, TieYong Zeng

entry.summary: Demonstrates that 3D ReLU network architectures enable more efficient approximation of analytic and Lp functions, establishing improved exponential rates and first quantitative non-asymptotic high-order bounds.

entry.title: AGMARL-DKS: An Adaptive Graph-Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Kubernetes Scheduling

author.name: Hamed Hamzeh

entry.summary: Proposes AGMARL-DKS, an adaptive graph-enhanced multi-agent RL approach for dynamic Kubernetes scheduling that addresses scalability, multi-objective optimization, and stress-awareness limitations of existing RL schedulers.

entry.title: Temporal Text Classification with Large Language Models

author.name: Nishat Raihan, Marcos Zampieri

entry.summary: Provides the first systematic evaluation of LLMs on Temporal Text Classification (dating texts by publication era) using both proprietary and open-source models across three historical corpora.

entry.title: High-Precision 6DOF Pose Estimation via Global Phase Retrieval in Fringe Projection Profilometry for 3D Mapping

author.name: Sehoon Tak, Keunhee Cho, Sangpil Kim, Jae-Sang Hyun

entry.summary: Proposes a high-precision 6DOF pose estimation method for digital fringe projection systems using a fixed global projector for phase-based registration, enabling large-scale micrometer-level 3D mapping.

entry.title: Enhancing Image Aesthetics with Dual-Conditioned Diffusion Models Guided by Multimodal Perception

author.name: Xinyu Nan, Ning Wang, Yuyao Zhai, Mei Yang

entry.summary: Introduces DIAE, a diffusion-based model for image aesthetic enhancement that uses dual conditioning to follow aesthetic editing instructions. Addresses the scarcity of paired images with consistent content but different aesthetic qualities.

entry.title: A Decade of Generative Adversarial Networks for Porous Material Reconstruction

author.name: Ali Sadeghkhani, Brandon Bennett, Masoud Babaei, Arash Rabbani

entry.summary: Systematic review of 96 papers on GAN-based porous material reconstruction from 2017-2026. Categorizes architectures and analyzes evolution of deep learning approaches for digital reconstruction of porous media.

entry.title: From Pen Strokes to Sleep States: Detecting Low-Recovery Days Using Sigma-Lognormal Handwriting Features

author.name: Chisa Tanaka, Andrew Vargo, Anna Scius-Bertrand, Andreas Fischer, Koichi Kise

entry.summary: Examines whether daily sleep recovery states can be inferred from online handwriting dynamics using Sigma-Lognormal model features. A 28-day study with 13 students shows personalized classification of low-recovery days.

entry.title: An Evolutionary Algorithm with Probabilistic Annealing for Large-scale Sparse Multi-objective Optimization

author.name: Shuai Shao, Yuhao Sun, Xing Chen, Ye Tian, Guan Wang, Jin Li

entry.summary: Proposes an evolutionary algorithm with probabilistic annealing for large-scale sparse multi-objective optimization. Balances exploration and exploitation in high-dimensional spaces with sparse solutions.

entry.title: DRAFTO: Decoupled Reduced-space and Adaptive Feasibility-repair Trajectory Optimization for Robotic Manipulators

author.name: Yichang Feng, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces DRAFTO, a trajectory optimization algorithm for robotic manipulators that decouples optimization into reduced-space Gauss-Newton descent and constrained quadratic programming for feasibility repair. Achieves faster convergence while handling joint limits and safety constraints.

entry.title: A Generalized Theory of Load Distribution in Redundantly-actuated Robotic Systems

author.name: Joshua Flight, Cl\'ement Gosselin

entry.summary: Presents a generalized theory for load distribution in redundantly-actuated robotic systems, fully characterizing feasible wrench distributions. Provides computationally efficient solutions scaling linearly with the number of applied wrenches.

entry.title: Unsupervised LiDAR-Based Multi-UAV Detection and Tracking Under Extreme Sparsity

author.name: Nivand Khosravi, Rodrigo Ventura, Meysam Basiri

entry.summary: Presents an unsupervised LiDAR-only pipeline for multi-UAV detection and tracking under extreme sparsity (1-2 returns per scan). Combines range-adaptive DBSCAN with temporal consistency checks, achieving strong performance on real air-to-air data.

entry.title: Learning Visuomotor Policy for Multi-Robot Laser Tag Game

author.name: Kai Li, Shiyu Zhao

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end visuomotor policy for multi-robot laser tag, trained via MARL teacher distillation into a vision-based student. Outperforms classic modular methods in hitting accuracy and collision avoidance.

entry.title: Multi-Robot Multitask Gaussian Process Estimation and Coverage

author.name: Lai Wei, Andrew McDonald, Vaibhav Srivastava

entry.summary: Introduces a multitask coverage problem for multi-robot systems and proposes algorithms for both known and unknown sensory demands using multitask Gaussian Processes. Establishes convergence properties and novel multitask coverage regret bounds.

entry.title: Data Fusion with Distributional Equivalence Test-then-pool

author.name: Linying Yang, Xing Liu, Robin J. Evans

entry.summary: Develops a new test-then-pool framework for borrowing historical control data in clinical trials while rigorously controlling Type-I error rates. Addresses the common setting where RCT control arms are small but historical data is available.

entry.title: All technical alignment plans are steps in the dark

author.name: Richard Juggins

entry.summary: Philosophical essay arguing that all technical alignment plans face a fundamental challenge: they cannot be fully tested before deployment of superintelligent systems. Discusses the tension between theoretical and empirical approaches to alignment.

entry.title: Ideologies Embed Taboos Against Common Knowledge Formation: a Case Study with LLMs

author.name: Benquo

entry.summary: Investigates how LLMs exhibit ideological blind spots and taboos against forming common knowledge, using case studies where models generate unsupported claims rather than stating obvious conclusions that conflict with embedded ideological constraints.

entry.title: Vision-Based Hand Shadowing for Robotic Manipulation via Inverse Kinematics

author.name: Hendrik Chiche, Antoine Jamme, Trevor Rigoberto Martinez

entry.summary: Presents an offline hand-shadowing pipeline for robotic teleoperation using a single egocentric RGB-D camera, MediaPipe hand tracking, and inverse kinematics for a low-cost 6-DOF robot arm with simulation preview.

entry.title: Performance Evaluation of Open-Source Large Language Models for Assisting Pathology Report Writing in Japanese

author.name: Masataka Kawai, Singo Sakashita, Shumpei Ishikawa, Shogo Watanabe, Anna Matsuoka, Mikio Sakurai, Yasuto Fujimoto, Yoshiyuki Takahara, Atsushi Ohara, Hirohiko Miyake, Genichiro Ishii

entry.title: Adapting Dijkstra for Buffers and Unlimited Transfers

author.name: Denys Katkalo, Andrii Rohovyi, Toby Walsh

entry.summary: Revisits Dijkstra-based approaches for public transit routing with unlimited transfers, showing Time-Dependent Dijkstra outperforms RAPTOR-based methods. Identifies issues with connection filtering when stops have finite buffer capacity.

entry.title: Multimodal Emotion Recognition via Bi-directional Cross-Attention and Temporal Modeling

author.name: Junhyeong Byeon, Jeongyeol Kim, Sejoon Lim

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal emotion recognition framework using CLIP and Wav2Vec 2.0 as frozen backbones with bi-directional cross-attention and temporal modeling for the ABAW Challenge expression recognition task.

entry.title: High-resolution weather-guided surrogate modeling for data-efficient cross-location building energy prediction

author.name: Piragash Manmatharasan, Girma Bitsuamlak, Katarina Grolinger

entry.summary: Introduces a weather-informed surrogate modeling approach for cross-location building energy prediction using high-resolution weekly weather patterns shared across regions.

entry.title: CFD-HAR: User-controllable Privacy through Conditional Feature Disentanglement

author.name: Alex Gn, Fan Li, S Kuniyilh, Ada Axan

entry.summary: Proposes CFD-HAR, a feature disentanglement approach for human activity recognition that enables user-controllable privacy filtering at granular levels while maintaining recognition performance with limited labeled data.

entry.title: Deep regression learning from dependent observations with minimum error entropy principle

author.name: William Kengne, Modou Wade

entry.summary: Studies deep regression with minimum error entropy principle from dependent (strongly mixing) observations, establishing minimax optimal rates for both penalized and non-penalized deep neural network estimators.

entry.title: DNS-GT: A Graph-based Transformer Approach to Learn Embeddings of Domain Names from DNS Queries

author.name: Massimiliano Altieri, Ronan Hamon, Roberto Corizzo, Michelangelo Ceci, Ignacio Sanchez

entry.summary: Introduces DNS-GT, a graph transformer approach for learning domain name embeddings from DNS queries, incorporating contextual information among queries for improved network intrusion detection.

entry.title: Ill-Conditioning in Dictionary-Based Dynamic-Equation Learning: A Systems Biology Case Study

author.name: Yuxiang Feng, Niall M Mangan, Manu Jayadharan

entry.summary: Studies ill-conditioning in dictionary-based equation learning from time-series data, showing how multicollinearity affects sparse regression for dynamical system identification in systems biology.

entry.title: Interpreting Contrastive Embeddings in Specific Domains with Fuzzy Rules

author.name: Javier Fumanal-Idocin, Mohammadreza Jamalifard, Javier Andreu-Perez

entry.summary: Uses fuzzy rule-based classifiers to interpret CLIP contrastive embeddings in domain-specific settings, providing explainability for text representations in specialized domains like legal and medical records.

entry.title: Long-Context Encoder Models for Polish Language Understanding

author.name: S{\l}awomir Dadas, Rafa{\l} Po\'swiata, Marek Koz{\l}owski, Ma{\l}gorzata Gr\k{e}bowiec, Micha{\l} Pere{\l}kiewicz, Pawe{\l} Klimiuk, Przemys{\l}aw Boruta

entry.title: Radiometric fingerprinting of object surfaces using mobile laser scanning and semantic 3D road space models

author.name: Benedikt Schwab, Thomas H. Kolbe

entry.title: SemiTooth: a Generalizable Semi-supervised Framework for Multi-Source Tooth Segmentation

author.name: Muyi Sun, Yifan Gao, Ziang Jia, Xingqun Qi, Qianli Zhang, Qian Liu, Tianzheng Deng

entry.title: Prediction of Grade, Gender, and Academic Performance of Children and Teenagers from Handwriting Using the Sigma-Lognormal Model

author.name: Adrian Iste, Kazuki Nishizawa, Chisa Tanaka, Andrew Vargo, Anna Scius-Bertrand, Andreas Fischer, Koichi Kise

entry.summary: Studies whether handwriting dynamics encode information about student characteristics (grade, gender, academic performance) using a large-scale dataset of Japanese students from elementary to junior high school.

entry.title: Robust Co-design Optimisation for Agile Fixed-Wing UAVs

author.name: Adrian Andrei Buda, Xavier Chen, Nicol\`o Botteghi, Urban Fasel

entry.summary: Proposes a robust co-design framework for agile fixed-wing UAVs that jointly optimizes physical design and control while integrating parametric uncertainty and wind disturbances. Uses a bi-level optimization approach for design robustness at the flight envelope edge.

entry.title: Learn Structure, Adapt on the Fly: Multi-Scale Residual Learning and Online Adaptation for Aerial Manipulators

author.name: Samaksh Ujjawal, Naveen Sudheer Nair, Shivansh Pratap Singh, Rishabh Dev Yadav, Wei Pan, Spandan Roy

entry.summary: Proposes a predictive-adaptive framework for real-time residual dynamics modeling in aerial manipulators, explicitly factorizing cross-variable coupling and multi-scale temporal effects for compensation during configuration changes and payload variations.

entry.title: Towards Dynamic Model Identification and Gravity Compensation for the dVRK-Si Patient Side Manipulator

author.name: Haoying Zhou, Hao Yang, Brendan Burkhart, Anton Deguet, Loris Fichera, Gregory S. Fischer, Jie Ying Wu, Peter Kazanzides

entry.title: HiSync: Spatio-Temporally Aligning Hand Motion from Wearable IMU and On-Robot Camera for Command Source Identification in Long-Range HRI

author.name: Elliot H. Young, Rajen D. Shah, Richard J. Samworth

entry.summary: Introduces the outrigger local polynomial estimator for nonparametric regression that adapts to different conditional error distributions. Uses conditional score function estimation with a broader local window for stabilization.

entry.title: Understanding Wikidata Qualifiers: An Analysis and Taxonomy

entry.title: Ghost Framing Theory: Exploring the role of generative AI in new venture rhetorical legitimation

author.name: Greg Nyilasy

entry.title: Efficient Cross-View Localization in 6G Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network

author.name: Min Hao, Yanbing Xu, Maoqiang Wu, Jinglin Huang, Chen Shang, Jiacheng Wang, Ruichen Zhang, Jiawen Kang, Dusit Niyato, Zhu Han, Wei Ni

entry.title: Gen-Fab: A Variation-Aware Generative Model for Predicting Fabrication Variations in Nanophotonic Devices

entry.title: Flowcean - Model Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems

author.name: Maximilian Schmidt, Swantje Plambeck, Markus Knitt, Hendrik Rose, Goerschwin Fey, Jan Christian Wieck, Stephan Balduin

entry.summary: Presents Flowcean, a modular framework for automating data-driven model generation for Cyber-Physical Systems, focusing on modularity and integrating diverse learning libraries.

entry.title: WORKSWORLD: A Domain for Integrated Numeric Planning and Scheduling of Distributed Pipelined Workflows

author.name: Taylor Paul, William Regli

entry.summary: Introduces WORKSWORLD, a planning domain for automated scheduling of distributed data pipeline workflows using numeric domain-independent planners.

entry.title: Slack More, Predict Better: Proximal Relaxation for Probabilistic Latent Variable Model-based Soft Sensors

author.name: Zehua Zou, Yiran Ma, Yulong Zhang, Zhengnan Li, Zeyu Yang, Jinhao Xie, Xiaoyu Jiang, Zhichao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces KProxNPLVM, a nonlinear probabilistic latent variable model for soft sensors that uses proximal relaxation to reduce the approximation error gap from amortized variational inference. Targets industrial process monitoring applications.

entry.title: TinyNav: End-to-End TinyML for Real-Time Autonomous Navigation on Microcontrollers

author.name: Pooria Roy, Nourhan Jadallah. Tomer Lapid, Shahzaib Ahmad, Armita Afroushe, Mete Bayrak

entry.title: Cough activity detection for automatic tuberculosis screening

author.name: Joshua Jansen van V\"uren, Devendra Singh Parihar, Daphne Naidoo, Kimsey Zajac, Willy Ssengooba, Grant Theron, Thomas Niesler

entry.summary: Applies pre-trained XLS-R architecture for cough activity detection in tuberculosis screening, achieving high precision for identifying cough segments in audio from symptomatic patients in South Africa and Uganda.

entry.title: Modeling Trial-and-Error Navigation With a Sequential Decision Model of Information Scent

author.name: Xiaofu Jin, Yunpeng Bai, Antti Oulasvirta

entry.summary: Models trial-and-error navigation as a sequential decision-making problem under memory constraints, extending information scent theory to account for partial page scanning and backtracking behavior.

entry.title: Decentralized Orchestration Architecture for Fluid Computing: A Secure Distributed AI Use Case

author.name: Diego Cajaraville-Aboy, Ana Fern\'andez-Vilas, Rebeca P. D\'iaz-Redondo, Manuel Fern\'andez-Veiga, Pablo Picallo-L\'opez

entry.summary: Proposes a decentralized orchestration architecture for fluid computing environments, enabling multi-domain coordination for distributed AI and IoT workloads across heterogeneous infrastructure.

entry.title: Semi-Synthetic Parallel Data for Translation Quality Estimation: A Case Study of Dataset Building for an Under-Resourced Language Pair

author.name: Assaf Siani, Anna Kernerman, Ilan Kernerman

entry.summary: Presents a semi-synthetic parallel dataset for English-to-Hebrew translation quality estimation, addressing data scarcity for under-resourced language pairs.

entry.title: Translationese as a Rational Response to Translation Task Difficulty

author.name: Maria Kunilovskaya

entry.summary: Proposes that translationese (systematic divergence of translations from native text) reflects cognitive load of the translation task itself, operationalizing this through automatic classifiers and task difficulty measures.

entry.title: AnimeScore: A Preference-Based Dataset and Framework for Evaluating Anime-Like Speech Style

author.name: Joonyong Park, Jerry Li

entry.summary: Proposes AnimeScore, a preference-based framework for evaluating anime-like speech style using pairwise ranking from 15,000 judgments, finding anime-likeness is driven by resonance shaping and prosodic continuity.

entry.title: A Two-Stage Dual-Modality Model for Facial Emotional Expression Recognition

author.name: Jiajun Sun, Zhe Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage dual-modal (audio-visual) model for facial expression recognition using DINOv2 backbone with padding-aware augmentation. Designed for the ABAW competition.

entry.title: Quantum mechanical framework for quantization-based optimization: from Gradient flow to Schroedinger equation

The work unifies combinatorial and continuous optimization perspectives through thermodynamic and quantum dynamic interpretations.

entry.title: SNAP-V: A RISC-V SoC with Configurable Neuromorphic Acceleration for Small-Scale Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Kanishka Gunawardana, Sanka Peeris, Kavishka Rambukwella, Thamish Wanduragala, Saadia Jameel, Roshan Ragel, Isuru Nawinne

The design addresses the gap between conventional SoCs with memory bottlenecks and large-scale neuromorphic hardware that's wasteful for small applications.

entry.title: Distributed Kalman--Consensus Filtering with Adaptive Uncertainty Weighting for Multi-Object Tracking in Mobile Robot Networks

author.name: Niusha Khosravi, Rodrigo Ventura, Meysam Basiri

entry.summary: Presents a Distributed Kalman-Consensus Filter with adaptive uncertainty weighting for multi-object tracking in mobile robot networks under partial observability and heterogeneous localization quality.

entry.title: A Hybrid Neural-Assisted Unscented Kalman Filter for Unmanned Ground Vehicle Navigation

author.name: Gal Versano, Itzik Klein

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid UKF framework where a deep neural network predicts process and measurement noise covariances from raw sensor data. Uses sim2real training approach for UGV navigation with INS/GNSS fusion.

entry.title: Decentralized Cooperative Localization for Multi-Robot Systems with Asynchronous Sensor Fusion

author.name: Nivand Khosravi, Niusha Khosravi, Mohammad Bozorg, Masoud S. Bahraini

entry.summary: Presents a decentralized cooperative localization framework for multi-robot systems in GPS-denied environments, handling asynchronous sensor data with heterogeneous sampling rates and preserving cross-correlation consistency.

entry.title: Examining Users' Behavioural Intention to Use OpenClaw Through the Cognition--Affect--Conation Framework

author.name: Yiran Du

entry.summary: Studies user behavioral intention to adopt OpenClaw through a Cognition-Affect-Conation framework, analyzing how perceived personalization, intelligence, privacy concerns, and algorithmic opacity influence adoption via structural equation modeling.

entry.title: Portfolio of Solving Strategies in CEGAR-based Object Packing and Scheduling for Sequential 3D Printing

author.name: Pavel Surynek

entry.summary: Parallelizes the CEGAR-SEQ algorithm for sequential 3D printing object arrangement using portfolio-based solving strategies on modern multi-core CPUs.

entry.title: How do AI agents talk about science and research? An exploration of scientific discussions on Moltbook using BERTopic

author.name: Oliver Wieczorek

entry.summary: Analyzes how AI agents on the Moltbook social network discuss science and research, using BERTopic to extract 60 topics from 357 posts. Examines sentiment and engagement patterns in AI-generated scientific discussions.

entry.title: An Intent of Collaboration: On Agencies between Designers and Emerging (Intelligent) Technologies

author.name: Pei-Ying Lin, Julie Heij, Iris Borst, Britt Joosten, Kristina Andersen, Wijnand IJsselsteijn

entry.summary: Reports on a three-month experimental study where three designers co-created with Google's LLM, investigating power dynamics and the influence of AI on creative processes in digital craftsmanship.

author.name: Mohammad Shihab Uddin, Md Hasibul Amin, Nusrat Jahan Ema, Bushra Uddin, Tanvir Ahmed, Arif Hassan Zidan

author.name: Andr\'es G. Mej\'ia Ram\'on, Kate Dudgeon, Nina Witteveen, Dolores Piperno, Michael Kloster, Luigi Palopoli, M\'onica Moraes R., Jos\'e M. Capriles, Umberto Lombardo

entry.title: Deep Learning-Based Metamodeling of Nonlinear Stochastic Dynamic Systems under Parametric and Predictive Uncertainty

author.name: Haimiti Atila, Seymour M. J. Spence

entry.summary: Formulates three metamodeling frameworks coupling feature extraction modules (MLP, MPNN, autoencoder) with LSTMs for modeling nonlinear dynamic structural systems under both loading and parameter uncertainties.

entry.title: Catalogue Grounded Multimodal Attribution for Museum Video under Resource and Regulatory Constraints

author.name: Minsak Nanang, Adrian Hilton, Armin Mustafa

entry.summary: Proposes automated catalogue-grounded multimodal attribution for museum video content using open, locally-deployable video language models to generate metadata from existing collection databases.

entry.title: Hypercomplex Widely Linear Processing: Fundamentals for Quaternion Machine Learning

author.name: Sayed Pouria Talebi, Clive Cheong Took

entry.summary: Provides a tutorial/foundational treatment of hypercomplex widely linear processing for quaternion machine learning, covering augmented statistics, widely linear estimation, and gradient operators.

entry.title: Trust Oriented Explainable AI for Fake News Detection

author.name: Krzysztof Siwek, Daniel Stankowski, Maciej Stodolski

entry.summary: Compares SHAP, LIME, and Integrated Gradients for explaining fake news detection models, finding each provides distinct explanatory value while maintaining detection accuracy.

entry.title: COTONET: A custom cotton detection algorithm based on YOLO11 for stage of growth cotton boll detection

author.name: Guillem Gonz\'alez, Guillem Aleny\`a, Sergi Foix

entry.summary: Proposes COTONET, a YOLO11-based cotton boll detection model with attention mechanisms for detecting cotton capsules across phenological stages. Designed for agricultural automation of cotton harvesting.

entry.title: Energy Prediction on Sloping Ground for Quadruped Robots

author.name: Mohamed Ounally, Cyrille Pierre, Johann Laconte

entry.summary: Investigates how terrain slope and heading orientation affect energy costs of quadruped locomotion. Introduces a simple energy model using only standard onboard sensors, validated on natural terrain with a commercial quadruped.

entry.title: Partition-Based Functional Ridge Regression for High-Dimensional Data

author.name: Shaista Ashraf, Ismail Shah, Farrukh Javed

entry.summary: Proposes partition-based functional ridge regression for high-dimensional data, decomposing coefficient functions into dominant and weaker components with differential penalization. Develops three estimators with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: An Automatic Text Classification Method Based on Hierarchical Taxonomies, Neural Networks and Document Embedding: The NETHIC Tool

author.name: Luigi Lomasto, Rosario Di Florio, Andrea Ciapetti, Giuseppe Miscione, Giulia Ruggiero, Daniele Toti

entry.summary: NETHIC describes an automatic text classification tool combining hierarchical taxonomies with neural networks and document embeddings, showing improvements over individual classifiers.

entry.title: Automated Detection of Malignant Lesions in the Ovary Using Deep Learning Models and XAI

author.name: Md. Hasin Sarwar Ifty, Nisharga Nirjan, Labib Islam, M. A. Diganta, Reeyad Ahmed Ornate, Anika Tasnim, Md. Saiful Islam

entry.summary: Applies 15 CNN variants (LeNet-5, ResNet, VGGNet, GoogLeNet) to detect malignant ovarian lesions from medical images, with XAI techniques for interpretability.

entry.title: Deep Learning Network-Temporal Models For Traffic Prediction

author.name: Yufeng Xin, Ethan Fan

entry.summary: Presents two deep learning models for network traffic prediction: a graph attention network capturing topological correlations and a fine-tuned multimodal LLM with clustering. Both aim to learn temporal patterns and network topology simultaneously.

entry.title: Multi-Station WiFi CSI Sensing Framework Robust to Station-wise Feature Missingness and Limited Labeled Data

author.name: Keita Kayano, Takayuki Nishio, Daiki Yoda, Yuta Hirai, Tomoko Adachi

entry.summary: Proposes a WiFi CSI sensing framework that jointly handles station-wise feature missingness and limited labeled data in multi-station deployments through integrated representation learning.

entry.title: A Machine Learning-Enhanced Hopf-Cole Formulation for Nonlinear Gas Flow in Porous Media

author.name: V. S. Maduru, K. B. Nakshatrala

entry.summary: Proposes a machine learning-enhanced Hopf-Cole formulation for nonlinear gas flow simulation in porous media, combining Klinkenberg-enhanced permeability with linearized equations.

entry.title: Simultaneous estimation of multiple discrete unimodal distributions under stochastic order constraints

author.name: Yasuhiro Yoshida, Noriyoshi Sukegawa, Jiro Iwanaga

entry.summary: Studies estimation of multiple discrete unimodal distributions under stochastic order constraints, formulated as mixed-integer convex optimization, motivated by search behavior analysis.

entry.title: From Pets to Robots: MojiKit as a Data-Informed Toolkit for Affective HRI Design

author.name: Liwen He, Pingting Chen, Ziheng Tang, Yixiao Liu, Jihong Jeung, Teng Han, Xin Tong

entry.summary: Introduces MojiKit, a data-informed toolkit for designing affective behaviors in animal-inspired social robots. Combines reference cards from human-pet interaction analysis with a zoomorphic robot prototype and behavior control studio.

entry.title: Counterweights and Complementarities: The Convergence of AI and Blockchain Powering a Decentralized Future

author.name: Yibai Li (Emily), Zhiye Jin (Emily), Xiaobing (Emily), Li (Nancy), K. D. Joshi (Nancy), Xuefei (Nancy), Deng

entry.summary: An editorial discussing how blockchain can counterbalance AI's centralizing tendencies through decentralized data management, computation, and governance, arguing these technologies are complementary rather than mutually exclusive.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence for Sentiment Analysis of Persian Poetry

author.name: Arash Zargar, Abolfazl Moshiri, Mitra Shafaei, Shabnam Rahimi-Golkhandan, Mohamad Tavakoli-Targhi, Farzad Khalvati

entry.summary: Applies BERT and GPT models to sentiment analysis of Persian poetry by Rumi and Parvin E'tesami, investigating LLM capability in understanding complex Persian literary forms.

entry.title: Comparison of Outlier Detection Algorithms on String Data

author.name: Philip Maus

entry.summary: Compares string data outlier detection algorithms, introducing a variant of Local Outlier Factor using Levenshtein distance with hierarchical character classes for string data.

entry.title: Monitoring and Prediction of Mood in Elderly People during Daily Life Activities

author.name: Daniel Bautista-Salinas, Joaqu\'in Roca Gonz\'alez, Inmaculada M\'endez, Oscar Martinez Mozos

entry.summary: Presents a wearable system for monitoring and predicting mood states of elderly people using physiological data from a wristband and ML classifiers.

entry.title: A technology-oriented mapping of the language and translation industry: Analysing stakeholder values and their potential implication for translation pedagogy

author.name: Mar\'ia Isabel Rivas Ginel, Jani\c{c}a Hackenbuchner, Alina Secar\u{a}, Ralph Kr\"uger, Caroline Rossi

entry.summary: Examines how value is constructed in the automated translation industry through interviews with 29 stakeholders, analyzing tensions between efficiency-oriented technological values and human expertise.

entry.title: Preliminary analysis of RGB-NIR Image Registration techniques for off-road forestry environments

author.name: Pankaj Deoli, Karthik Ranganath, Karsten Berns

entry.summary: Preliminary evaluation of RGB-NIR image registration techniques for off-road forestry environments, testing both classical and deep learning methods. Finds current methods have limitations in dense vegetation.

entry.title: A Plan ‘B’ for AI safety

author.name: trent northen

entry.summary: Proposes teaching AI systems to value biological systems as a 'Plan B' safety approach. Fine-tunes LLMs on biomimicry examples and shows increased model preference for bioinspired approaches to technical challenges.

entry.title: What can we say about the cosmic host?
entry.summary: Analyzes Bostrom's 'cosmic host' concept—that preferences of advanced civilizations might constitute norms for humanity and ASI. Examines the assumption ladder and evaluates formation mechanisms for cosmic norms.

entry.title: AI for Agent Foundations etc.?

author.name: Valentine

entry.summary: Asks about the current state of using AI systems for agent foundations research and theoretical AI safety work. Draws parallels to Terence Tao using AI for math and asks whether anyone is doing AI-assisted alignment theory.

entry.title: The Dark Planet: Why the Fermi Paradox Survives Critique

author.name: Will Rodgers

entry.summary: Speculative essay arguing that the Fermi paradox is consistent with AI as a Great Filter, proposing that post-AGI civilizations either achieve total cosmic stealth or collapse under informational entropy.

entry.title: Magic Is Hidden Control of Energy

author.name: aviad rozenhek

entry.summary: Philosophical essay connecting Feynman's critique of empty explanations (like 'energy makes it go') to Clarke's third law and the concept of magic as hidden control of energy flows. Argues true understanding requires mechanistic models.

entry.title: Forecasting Dojo Meetup - Open discussion about our forecasting process

author.name: Vojtech Brynych

entry.summary: Announcement for a forecasting practice group meetup to discuss forecasting processes, AI usage in forecasting, and templates. No substantive research content.

entry.title: How Many Parking Permits?

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: Analyzes real-world parking permit data from a new building in Somerville, MA to test whether parking-ineligible housing developments actually reduce parking demand. Finds much lower car ownership rates than opponents predicted.

entry.title: Research Summary: March 12, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Two standout theoretical papers anchor today's research. Lost in Backpropagation reveals the LM head creates a severe gradient bottleneck during training, not merely an expressivity constraint. Lost in the Middle at Birth provides an exact proof that the U-shaped position bias exists from initialization, rooted in positional encoding structure.

  • IH-Challenge introduces an RL training dataset for improving instruction hierarchy compliance in frontier LLMs, a critical safety primitive
  • Safety Under Scaffolding reports the largest controlled study (N=62,808) showing map-reduce scaffolding degrades measured LLM safety, challenging current evaluation assumptions
  • First systematic MCP clause-compliance vulnerability framework identifies compatibility-abusing attack surfaces in the rapidly adopted agent protocol
  • CSRO from DeepMind replaces deep RL oracles with LLM-generated interpretable code policies for multi-agent equilibrium computation via PSRO
  • Beyond the Illusion of Consensus demonstrates high LLM-as-judge agreement often reflects shared surface heuristics rather than genuine evaluation quality

On the methods frontier, Neural Cellular Automata pre-pre-training proposes learning spatiotemporal structure before language exposure. CodePercept identifies perception—not reasoning—as the true bottleneck for MLLMs on visual STEM tasks. CLIPO incorporates contrastive learning into RLVR policy optimization to penalize correct-answer-wrong-reasoning trajectories.

entry.title: Lost in Backpropagation: The LM Head is a Gradient Bottleneck

author.name: Nathan Godey, Yoav Artzi

entry.summary: This paper reveals that the language model head (projecting from dimension D to vocabulary size V) creates not just an expressivity bottleneck but a severe optimization bottleneck, suppressing 95-99% of gradient norm during backpropagation. The authors provide theoretical analysis and empirical evidence showing this compression fundamentally alters training feedback for most parameters.

entry.title: IH-Challenge: A Training Dataset to Improve Instruction Hierarchy on Frontier LLMs

author.name: Chuan Guo (Michael Pokorny), Juan Felipe Ceron Uribe (Michael Pokorny), Sicheng Zhu (Michael Pokorny), Christopher A. Choquette-Choo (Michael Pokorny), Steph Lin (Michael Pokorny), Nikhil Kandpal (Michael Pokorny), Milad Nasr (Michael Pokorny), Rai (Michael Pokorny), Sam Toyer, Miles Wang, Yaodong Yu, Alex Beutel, Kai Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces IH-Challenge, a reinforcement learning training dataset to improve instruction hierarchy in LLMs, addressing how models should prioritize conflicting system, developer, user, and tool instructions. Fine-tuning GPT-5-Mini on this dataset improves IH robustness by +10% across 16 benchmarks.

entry.title: Lost in the Middle at Birth: An Exact Theory of Transformer Position Bias

author.name: Borun D Chowdhury

entry.summary: Provides an exact theoretical explanation for the 'Lost in the Middle' phenomenon in LLMs, proving the U-shaped performance curve exists at initialization before any training, as an inherent geometric property of causal decoders with residual connections. Models multi-layer causal attention as iterated Cesàro matrix powers.

entry.title: Safety Under Scaffolding: How Evaluation Conditions Shape Measured Safety

author.name: David Gringras

entry.summary: Reports one of the largest controlled studies (N=62,808) of scaffold effects on LLM safety across six frontier models. Finds map-reduce scaffolding degrades safety (NNH=14) while two of three scaffold architectures preserve safety. Reveals deeper measurement problems in format dependence.

entry.title: Code-Space Response Oracles: Generating Interpretable Multi-Agent Policies with Large Language Models

author.name: Daniel Hennes, Zun Li, John Schultz, Marc Lanctot

entry.summary: Introduces Code-Space Response Oracles (CSRO), replacing deep RL oracles in multi-agent game-theoretic equilibrium computation (PSRO) with LLMs that generate policies as human-readable code. This yields interpretable policies and enables cross-game transfer. Authors include researchers from DeepMind (Marc Lanctot, John Schultz).

entry.title: Compatibility at a Cost: Systematic Discovery and Exploitation of MCP Clause-Compliance Vulnerabilities

author.name: Nanzi Yang, Weiheng Bai, Kangjie Lu

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic framework for analyzing MCP (Model Context Protocol) clause-compliance vulnerabilities, identifying compatibility-abusing attacks including silent prompt injection and DoS. Shows that MCP's relaxed optional clauses create exploitable attack surfaces.

entry.title: Beyond the Illusion of Consensus: From Surface Heuristics to Knowledge-Grounded Evaluation in LLM-as-a-Judge

author.name: Mingyang Song, Mao Zheng, Chenning Xu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that high inter-evaluator agreement in LLM-as-judge settings is often illusory, with judges anchoring on surface heuristics rather than substantive quality ('Evaluation Illusion'). Large-scale study of 105,600 instances shows model-level agreement (ρ=0.99) masks fragile sample-level agreement.

entry.title: CodePercept: Code-Grounded Visual STEM Perception for MLLMs

author.name: Tongkun Guan, Zhibo Yang, Jianqiang Wan, Mingkun Yang, Zhengtao Guo, Zijian Hu, Ruilin Luo, Ruize Chen, Songtao Jiang, Peng Wang, Wei Shen, Junyang Lin, Xiaokang Yang

entry.summary: Reveals through scaling analysis that perception, not reasoning, is the true bottleneck for MLLMs in STEM visual tasks. Proposes CodePercept, which uses executable code as a perceptual medium to precisely represent structured STEM visuals.

entry.title: GPT-5.4 Is A Substantial Upgrade

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's comprehensive review of GPT-5.4, gathering community reactions and forming a gestalt assessment. Concludes it's a substantial upgrade from GPT-5.2, puts OpenAI back in competition with Opus 4.6, and has distinctive OpenAI-style strengths. Notes benchmarks are increasingly insufficient for comparing top models.

entry.title: Training Language Models via Neural Cellular Automata

author.name: Dan Lee, Seungwook Han, Akarsh Kumar, Pulkit Agrawal

entry.summary: Proposes pre-pre-training LLMs on neural cellular automata (NCA) data before natural language training. NCA data exhibits rich spatiotemporal structure resembling natural language statistics. Pre-training on only 164M NCA tokens improves downstream language model performance.

entry.title: CLIPO: Contrastive Learning in Policy Optimization Generalizes RLVR

author.name: Sijia Cui, Pengyu Cheng, Jiajun Song, Yongbo Gai, Guojun Zhang, Zhechao Yu, Jianhe Lin, Xiaoxi Jiang, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes CLIPO, which incorporates contrastive learning into policy optimization for RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards). Addresses the problem of process-wrong but outcome-correct rollouts that lead to hallucination and answer-copying by capturing invariant structure across correct reasoning paths.

entry.title: Safe and Scalable Web Agent Learning via Recreated Websites

author.name: Hyungjoo Chae, Jungsoo Park, Alan Ritter

entry.summary: VeriEnv uses LLMs to clone real-world websites into executable synthetic environments with programmatically verifiable rewards, enabling safe and scalable web agent training without real-world interaction. Agents can self-generate tasks within these cloned environments.

entry.title: Beyond Sequential Distance: Inter-Modal Distance Invariant Position Encoding

author.name: Lin Chen, Bolin Ni, Qi Yang, Zili Wang, Kun Ding, Ying Wang, Houwen Peng, Shiming Xiang

entry.summary: Proposes DIPE (Distance Invariant Position Encoding) to address visual fading in long-context multimodal LLMs. Disentangles position encoding based on modality interactions, maintaining inter-modal attention regardless of sequence distance.

entry.title: Decoupling Reasoning and Confidence: Resurrecting Calibration in Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Zhengzhao Ma, Xueru Wen, Boxi Cao, Yaojie Lu, Hongyu Lin, Jinglin Yang, Min He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun

entry.summary: Identifies a fundamental gradient conflict between maximizing policy accuracy and minimizing calibration error in RLVR-trained LLMs, then proposes DCPO to decouple reasoning and calibration objectives. Shows RLVR causes severe overconfidence in incorrect answers.

entry.title: Multi-Stream Perturbation Attack: Breaking Safety Alignment of Thinking LLMs Through Concurrent Task Interference

author.name: Fan Yang

entry.summary: Introduces multi-stream perturbation attack that breaks safety alignment of 'thinking' LLMs by interweaving multiple task streams within a single prompt. Exploits unique vulnerabilities of chain-of-thought reasoning models when processing interleaved tasks.
