author.name: Gyujun Jeong (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Sungwon Cho (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Minji Shon (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Namhoon Kim (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Woohyun Hwang (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Kwangyou Seo (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Suhwan Lim (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Wanki Kim (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Daewon Ha (Semiconductor Research and Development, Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd, South Korea), Prasanna Venkatesan (NVIDIA, Santa Clara, CA, USA), Kihang Youn (NVIDIA, Santa Clara, CA, USA), Ram Cherukuri (NVIDIA, Santa Clara, CA, USA), Yiyi Wang (NVIDIA, Santa Clara, CA, USA), Suman Datta (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Asif Khan (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA), Shimeng Yu (School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, GA, USA)

entry.summary: Develops a Physics-Informed Neural Operator surrogate model for ferroelectric VNAND retention analysis, reducing simulation time from days (TCAD) to seconds while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: Not All Neighbors Matter: Understanding the Impact of Graph Sparsification on GNN Pipelines

author.name: Yuhang Song, Naima Abrar Shami, Romaric Duvignau, Vasiliki Kalavri

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates whether graph sparsification can serve as a lightweight pre-processing step to accelerate GNN pipelines while preserving node classification accuracy, developing an extensible evaluation framework.

entry.title: LF2L: Loss Fusion Horizontal Federated Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces Using External Datasets Effectively: A Case Study in Second Primary Cancer Prediction

author.name: Chia-Fu Lin, Yi-Ju Tseng

entry.summary: Proposes LF2L, a federated learning approach for heterogeneous feature spaces using external datasets, applied to second primary cancer prediction across Taiwanese and US datasets.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-scale Framework for County-Level Crop Yield Prediction Across Large Regions

author.name: Yiming Sun, Qi Cheng, Licheng Liu, Runlong Yu, Yiqun Xie, Xiaowei Jia

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieval-augmented multi-scale framework for county-level crop yield prediction that captures both short-term and long-term temporal patterns across large geographic regions.

entry.title: Online Continual Learning for Anomaly Detection in IoT under Data Distribution Shifts

author.name: Matea Marinova, Shashi Raj Pandey, Junya Shiraishi, Martin Voigt Vejling, Valentin Rakovic, Petar Popovski

entry.summary: Presents OCLADS, a continual learning framework for IoT anomaly detection that tracks distribution shifts and strategically updates models through intelligent sample selection and shift detection.

entry.title: Generative prediction of laser-induced rocket ignition with dynamic latent space representations

author.name: Tony Zahtila, Ettore Saetta, Murray Cutforth, Davy Brouzet, Diego Rossinelli, Gianluca Iaccarino

entry.summary: Combines convolutional autoencoders with neural ODEs for surrogate modeling of laser-ignited rocket engine simulations, enabling rapid design space exploration.

entry.title: Adversarial Domain Adaptation Enables Knowledge Transfer Across Heterogeneous RNA-Seq Datasets

author.name: Kevin Dradjat, Massinissa Hamidi, Blaise Hanczar

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning domain adaptation framework for transferring knowledge across heterogeneous RNA-seq datasets with different preprocessing pipelines and target phenotypes for phenotype prediction.

entry.title: Mitigating Homophily Disparity in Graph Anomaly Detection: A Scalable and Adaptive Approach

author.name: Yunhui Liu, Qizhuo Xie, Yinfeng Chen, Xudong Jin, Tao Zheng, Bin Chong, Tieke He

entry.summary: Proposes SAGAD for graph anomaly detection, addressing homophily disparity and scalability through precomputed multi-hop embeddings with reparameterized Chebyshev filters and an anomaly-aware attention mechanism.

entry.title: SYNAPSE: Framework for Neuron Analysis and Perturbation in Sequence Encoding

author.name: Jes\'us S\'anchez Ochoa, Enrique Tom\'as Mart\'inez Beltr\'an, Alberto Huertas Celdr\'an

entry.summary: Proposes SYNAPSE, a training-free framework for neuron-level analysis and perturbation in sequence models, enabling systematic evaluation of internal robustness across architectures and domains.

entry.title: Data-Driven Priors for Uncertainty-Aware Deterioration Risk Prediction with Multimodal Data

author.name: L. Juli\'an Lechuga L\'opez, Tim G. J. Rudner, Farah E. Shamout

entry.summary: Proposes MedCertAIn, a multimodal clinical uncertainty framework using data-driven priors over neural network parameters for in-hospital risk prediction, combining structured and unstructured clinical data.

entry.title: DualFlexKAN: Dual-stage Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Independent Function Control

author.name: Andr\'es Ortiz, Nicol\'as J. Gallego-Molina, Carmen Jim\'enez-Mesa, Juan M. G\'orriz, Javier Ram\'irez

entry.summary: Introduces DualFlexKAN, a dual-stage Kolmogorov-Arnold Network architecture with independently controlled pre-linear and post-linear transformations, addressing parameter scaling and regularization issues in standard KANs.

entry.title: Don't Look Back in Anger: MAGIC Net for Streaming Continual Learning with Temporal Dependence

author.name: Federico Giannini, Sandro D'Andrea, Emanuele Della Valle

entry.summary: Introduces MAGIC Net for streaming continual learning that integrates continual learning architectural strategies with recurrent neural networks, handling temporal dependence while performing all operations online.

entry.title: T-REX: Transformer-Based Category Sequence Generation for Grocery Basket Recommendation

author.name: Soroush Mokhtari, Muhammad Tayyab Asif, Sergiy Zubatiy

entry.summary: Proposes T-REX, a transformer architecture for grocery basket recommendation at Amazon that generates personalized category-level suggestions by learning short-term basket dependencies and long-term user preferences.

entry.title: Topology-Aware Reinforcement Learning over Graphs for Resilient Power Distribution Networks

author.name: Roshni Anna Jacob, Prithvi Poddar, Jaidev Goel, Souma Chowdhury, Yulia R. Gel, Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a topology-aware graph RL framework for power distribution network outage management that embeds persistent homology features, achieving 9-18% higher rewards on IEEE test cases.

entry.title: Compressed Proximal Federated Learning for Non-Convex Composite Optimization on Heterogeneous Data

author.name: Pu Qiu, Chen Ouyang, Yongyang Xiong, Keyou You, Wanquan Liu, Yang Shi

entry.summary: Proposes FedCEF for federated composite optimization with non-convex objectives, introducing decoupled proximal updates that separate the proximal operator from communication to enable biased compression.

entry.title: Viewpoint-Agnostic Grasp Pipeline using VLM and Partial Observations

author.name: Dilermando Almeida, Juliano Negri, Guilherme Lazzarini, Thiago H. Segreto, Ranulfo Bezerra, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end pipeline for language-guided robotic grasping that handles partial observations through depth compensation, point cloud completion, and collision-free grasp planning on a real robot.

entry.title: Rel-MOSS: Towards Imbalanced Relational Deep Learning on Relational Databases

author.name: Jun Yin, Peng Huo, Bangguo Zhu, Hao Yan, Senzhang Wang, Shirui Pan, Chengqi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Rel-MOSS, the first method addressing class imbalance in relational deep learning on relational databases, using relation-centric minority oversampling with GNNs.

entry.title: FlowTouch: View-Invariant Visuo-Tactile Prediction

author.name: Seongjin Bien, Carlo Kneissl, Tobias J\"ulg, Frank Fundel, Thomas Ressler-Antal, Florian Walter, Bj\"orn Ommer, Gitta Kutyniok, Wolfram Burgard

entry.summary: Proposes FlowTouch for predicting tactile sensor readings from visual information in a view-invariant manner, bridging the gap between visual planning and contact-rich manipulation.

entry.title: Graph-Instructed Neural Networks for parametric problems with varying boundary conditions

author.name: Francesco Della Santa, Sandra Pieraccini, Maria Strazzullo

entry.summary: Proposes Graph-Instructed Neural Networks (GINNs) for parametric PDEs with varying boundary conditions, overcoming limitations of Galerkin-based reduced order methods that require reformulation for each boundary configuration.

entry.title: Taiwan Safety Benchmark and Breeze Guard: Toward Trustworthy AI for Taiwanese Mandarin

author.name: Po-Chun Hsu, Meng-Hsi Chen, Tsu Ling Chao, Chia Tien Han, Da-shan Shiu

entry.summary: Introduces TS-Bench, a safety benchmark for Taiwanese Mandarin with 400 human-curated prompts covering financial fraud, medical misinformation, social discrimination, and political manipulation, plus Breeze Guard, an 8B safety model.

entry.title: Bolbosh: Script-Aware Flow Matching for Kashmiri Text-to-Speech

author.name: Tajamul Ashraf, Burhaan Rasheed Zargar, Saeed Abdul Muizz, Ifrah Mushtaq, Nazima Mehdi, Iqra Altaf Gillani, Aadil Amin Kak, Janibul Bashir

entry.summary: Presents Bolbosh, the first open-source neural TTS system for Kashmiri, using script-aware flow matching with supervised cross-lingual adaptation. Shows zero-shot multilingual baselines fail with only 1.86 MOS.

entry.title: KohakuRAG: A simple RAG framework with hierarchical document indexing

author.name: Shih-Ying Yeh, Yueh-Feng Ku, Ko-Wei Huang, Buu-Khang Tu

entry.summary: Presents KohakuRAG, a hierarchical RAG framework with four-level tree document representation, LLM-powered query planning, and self-consistency based answer stabilization for high-precision citation tasks.

entry.title: Dual-Metric Evaluation of Social Bias in Large Language Models: Evidence from an Underrepresented Nepali Cultural Context

author.name: Ashish Pandey, Tek Raj Chhetri

entry.summary: Analyzes social biases in seven LLMs within the Nepali cultural context using a Dual-Metric Bias Assessment framework. Tests agreement with biased statements and stereotypical completion tendencies.

entry.title: Gender Bias in MT for a Genderless Language: New Benchmarks for Basque

author.name: Amaia Murillo, Olatz-Perez-de-Vi\~naspre, Naiara Perez

entry.summary: Introduces two new datasets for evaluating gender bias in machine translation involving Basque, a genderless language. WinoMTeus tests how gender-neutral occupations are translated into gendered languages.

entry.title: Do Language Models Know Theo Has a Wife? Investigating the Proviso Problem

author.name: Tara Azin, Daniel Dumitrescu, Diana Inkpen, Raj Singh

entry.summary: Investigates how language models handle the proviso problem in pragmatics, where presuppositions in conditional sentences diverge between theoretical and human interpretations. Finds models rely on shallow pattern matching.

entry.title: TimeSpot: Benchmarking Geo-Temporal Understanding in Vision-Language Models in Real-World Settings

author.name: Azmine Toushik Wasi, Shahriyar Zaman Ridoy, Koushik Ahamed Tonmoy, Kinga Tshering, S. M. Muhtasimul Hasan, Wahid Faisal, Tasnim Mohiuddin, Md Rizwan Parvez

entry.summary: Introduces TimeSpot, a benchmark of 1,455 ground-level images from 80 countries for evaluating VLMs on geo-temporal reasoning (season, month, time of day, etc.). Tests both spatial and temporal understanding from visual cues.

entry.title: SJD-PV: Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Phrase Verification for Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Zhehao Yu, Baoquan Zhang, Bingqi Shan, Xinhao Liu, Dongliang Zhou, Guotao Liang, Guangming Ye, Yunming Ye

entry.summary: Introduces SJD-PV, a training-free acceleration framework for autoregressive image generation that performs phrase-level speculative verification. Groups correlated tokens based on co-occurrence statistics for joint validation.

entry.title: RADAR: A Multimodal Benchmark for 3D Image-Based Radiology Report Review

author.name: Zhaoyi Sun, Minal Jagtiani, Wen-wai Yim, Fei Xia, Martin Gunn, Meliha Yetisgen, Asma Ben Abacha

entry.summary: Presents RADAR, a multimodal benchmark pairing 3D medical images with preliminary radiology reports and candidate edits. Reflects clinical workflow where trainee reports are reviewed by attending radiologists.

entry.title: ECHO: Event-Centric Hypergraph Operations via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Multimedia Event Extraction

author.name: Hailong Chu, Shuo Zhang, Yunlong Chu, Shutai Huang, Xingyue Zhang, Tinghe Yan, Jinsong Zhang, Lei Li

entry.summary: Proposes ECHO, a multi-agent framework for multimedia event extraction using event-centric hypergraph operations. Agents iteratively refine a shared multimedia event hypergraph to avoid cascading errors from linear pipelines.

entry.title: HARP: HARmonizing in-vivo diffusion MRI using Phantom-only training

author.name: Hwihun Jeong, Qiang Liu, Kathryn E. Keenan, Elisabeth A. Wilde, Walter Schneider, Sudhir Pathak, Anthony Zuccolotto, Lauren J. O'Donnell, Lipeng Ning, Yogesh Rathi

entry.summary: Introduces HARP, a deep learning framework for harmonizing multi-site diffusion MRI data trained only on easily transportable phantoms, eliminating the need for traveling human subjects. Uses voxel-wise 1D neural networks.

entry.title: PICS: Pairwise Image Compositing with Spatial Interactions

author.name: Hang Zhou, Xinxin Zuo, Sen Wang, Li Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces PICS, a self-supervised composition-by-decomposition paradigm for pairwise image compositing that preserves coherent spatial relations. Uses mask-guided Mixture-of-Experts to route background, exclusive, and overlap regions.

entry.title: SurgCUT3R: Surgical Scene-Aware Continuous Understanding of Temporal 3D Representation

author.name: Kaiyuan Xu, Fangzhou Hong, Daniel Elson, Baoru Huang

entry.summary: SurgCUT3R adapts general-purpose 3D reconstruction models to surgical scenes, addressing training data scarcity and long-sequence degradation through a data pipeline using stereo surgical datasets and hybrid supervision. Demonstrates improved surgical scene reconstruction from monocular endoscopy.

entry.title: Facial Expression Generation Aligned with Human Preference for Natural Dyadic Interaction

author.name: Xu Chen, Rui Gao, Xinjie Zhang, Haoyu Zhang, Che Sun, Zhi Gao, Yuwei Wu, Yunde Jia

entry.summary: Proposes facial expression generation for dyadic interaction aligned with human preference via human feedback, framing identity-independent expression generation as an action learning process.

entry.title: FreeFly-Thinking : Aligning Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Continuous UAV Navigation

author.name: Jiaxu Zhou, Shaobo Wang, Zhiyuan Yang, Zhenjun Yu, Tao Li

entry.summary: FreeFly-Thinking introduces a VLN framework for UAV navigation in outdoor urban settings with chain-of-thought reasoning, converting egocentric images and language instructions into action sequences.

entry.title: LEPA: Learning Geometric Equivariance in Satellite Remote Sensing Data with a Predictive Architecture

author.name: Erik Scheurer, Rocco Sedona, Stefan Kesselheim, Gabriele Cavallaro

entry.summary: LEPA proposes a learned equivariance-predicting architecture for handling geometric mismatches between user-defined areas of interest and fixed precomputed embedding grids in geospatial foundation models.

entry.title: QdaVPR: A novel query-based domain-agnostic model for visual place recognition

author.name: Shanshan Wan, Lai Kang, Yingmei Wei, Tianrui Shen, Haixuan Wang, Chao Zuo

entry.summary: QdaVPR proposes a query-based domain-agnostic visual place recognition model using dual-level adversarial learning for explicit domain supervision, generalizing to unseen domain shifts.

entry.title: Scale-Aware UAV-to-Satellite Cross-View Geo-Localization: A Semantic Geometric Approach

author.name: Yibin Ye, Shuo Chen, Kun Wang, Xiaokai Song, Jisheng Dang, Qifeng Yu, Xichao Teng, Zhang Li

entry.summary: Proposes a geometric framework for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization that recovers absolute metric scale from monocular UAV images using small vehicles as semantic anchors.

entry.title: Active Inference for Micro-Gesture Recognition: EFE-Guided Temporal Sampling and Adaptive Learning

author.name: Weijia Feng, Jingyu Yang, Ruojia Zhang, Fengtao Sun, Qian Gao, Chenyang Wang, Tongtong Su, Jia Guo, Xiaobai Li, Minglai Shao

entry.summary: Applies active inference with Expected Free Energy-guided temporal sampling for micro-gesture recognition, actively selecting discriminative temporal segments under uncertainty.

entry.title: Efficient RGB-D Scene Understanding via Multi-task Adaptive Learning and Cross-dimensional Feature Guidance

author.name: Guodong Sun, Junjie Liu, Gaoyang Zhang, Bo Wu, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient RGB-D scene understanding model performing semantic/instance/panoptic segmentation, orientation estimation, and classification with adaptive attention and cross-dimensional feature guidance.

entry.title: EmbedTalk: Triplane-Free Talking Head Synthesis using Embedding-Driven Gaussian Deformation

author.name: Arpita Saggar, Jonathan C. Darling, Duygu Sarikaya, David C. Hogg

entry.summary: EmbedTalk replaces tri-plane representations with learnt embeddings for 3D Gaussian Splatting-based talking head synthesis. Shows that direct embeddings can outperform tri-plane encoding for modeling speech-driven facial deformations.

entry.title: Learning Context-Adaptive Motion Priors for Masked Motion Diffusion Models with Efficient Kinematic Attention Aggregation

author.name: Junkun Jiang, Jie Chen, Ho Yin Au, Jingyu Xiang

entry.summary: Introduces Masked Motion Diffusion Model (MMDM) for reconstructing incomplete motion capture data using a diffusion-based framework with Kinematic Attention Aggregation. Handles occlusions and noisy data from both vision-based and wearable motion capture.

entry.title: Training-free Temporal Object Tracking in Surgical Videos

author.name: Subhadeep Koley, Abdolrahim Kadkhodamohammadi, Santiago Barbarisi, Danail Stoyanov, Imanol Luengo

entry.summary: Leverages pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model features for training-free object tracking in laparoscopic surgical videos. Uses cross-frame affinity matrices for temporal continuity without fine-tuning.

entry.title: Structure and Progress Aware Diffusion for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Siyuan Song, Guyue Hu, Chenglong Li, Dengdi Sun, Zhe Jin, Jin Tang

entry.summary: SPAD proposes structure and progress-aware diffusion for medical image segmentation that separates learning of coarse structures from fine boundaries. Uses curriculum-style progressive training to handle boundary ambiguity.

entry.title: RLPR: Radar-to-LiDAR Place Recognition via Two-Stage Asymmetric Cross-Modal Alignment for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhangshuo Qi, Jingyi Xu, Luqi Cheng, Shichen Wen, Guangming Xiong

entry.summary: RLPR addresses radar-to-LiDAR place recognition for autonomous driving, enabling localization of radar scans within existing LiDAR maps. Handles cross-modal alignment challenges and scarcity of paired training data.

entry.title: It's Time to Get It Right: Improving Analog Clock Reading and Clock-Hand Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jaeha Choi, Jin Won Lee, Siwoo You, Jangho Lee

entry.summary: Reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with analog clock reading in real-world environments despite success on complex reasoning tasks. Introduces real-world clock dataset exposing spatial-temporal reasoning failures.

entry.title: Adaptive MLP Pruning for Large Vision Transformers

author.name: Chengchao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive MLP Pruning for large Vision Transformers using Taylor-based importance evaluation with knowledge distillation loss. Targets MLP modules as the largest parameter component.

entry.title: VesselFusion: Diffusion Models for Vessel Centerline Extraction from 3D CT Images

author.name: Soichi Mita, Shumpei Takezaki, Ryoma Bise

entry.summary: VesselFusion uses diffusion models for vessel centerline extraction from 3D CT images with coarse-to-fine representation and voting-based aggregation. Achieves more natural vessel structures than deterministic approaches.

entry.title: Novel Semantic Prompting for Zero-Shot Action Recognition

author.name: Salman Iqbal, Waheed Rehman

entry.summary: SP-CLIP introduces structured semantic prompts at multiple abstraction levels (intent, motion, object interaction) for zero-shot action recognition without modifying the visual encoder. Demonstrates that enriched semantic prompting alone can significantly improve performance.

entry.title: Real-Time Drone Detection in Event Cameras via Per-Pixel Frequency Analysis

author.name: Michael Bezick, Majid Sahin

entry.summary: DDHF uses Non-uniform Discrete Fourier Transform for per-pixel frequency analysis of event camera data to detect drones via their rotor frequency signatures. Purely analytical approach without neural networks.

entry.title: Information Maximization for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Domain Generalization

author.name: Leo Fillioux, Omprakash Chakraborty, Quentin Gop\'ee, Pierre Marza, Paul-Henry Courn\`ede, Stergios Christodoulidis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Ismail Ben Ayed, Jose Dolz

entry.summary: IMaX applies the InfoMax principle to semi-supervised domain generalization under long-tailed class distributions, maximizing mutual information between learned features and latent labels to handle class imbalance.

entry.title: Improving Continual Learning for Gaussian Splatting based Environments Reconstruction on Commercial Off-the-Shelf Edge Devices

author.name: Ivan Zaino, Matteo Risso, Daniele Jahier Pagliari, Miguel de Prado, Toon Van de Maele, Alessio Burrello

entry.summary: Presents a precision-adaptive optimization framework for running Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting on edge devices, enabling continual 3D scene learning on resource-constrained hardware through mixed-precision and kernel fusion.

entry.title: BioGait-VLM: A Tri-Modal Vision-Language-Biomechanics Framework for Interpretable Clinical Gait Assessment

author.name: Erdong Chen, Yuyang Ji, Jacob K. Greenberg, Benjamin Steel, Faraz Arkam, Abigail Lewis, Pranay Singh, Feng Liu

entry.summary: BioGait-VLM proposes a tri-modal Vision-Language-Biomechanics framework for clinical gait assessment, incorporating temporal evidence distillation and biomechanical tokenization to reason about joint mechanics independent of visual shortcuts.

entry.title: CAST: Modeling Visual State Transitions for Consistent Video Retrieval

author.name: Yanqing Liu, Yingcheng Liu, Fanghong Dong, Budianto Budianto, Cihang Xie, Yan Jiao

entry.summary: CAST formalizes Consistent Video Retrieval (CVR) and proposes a plug-and-play adapter that predicts state-conditioned residual updates from visual history for coherent storyline composition from short clips.

entry.title: ProFocus: Proactive Perception and Focused Reasoning in Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Wei Xue, Mingcheng Li, Xuecheng Wu, Jingqun Tang, Dingkang Yang, Lihua Zhang

entry.summary: ProFocus is a training-free VLN framework combining proactive perception via ego-centric semantic maps with focused reasoning through LLM-VLM collaboration for navigation decision-making.

entry.title: StructBiHOI: Structured Articulation Modeling for Long--Horizon Bimanual Hand--Object Interaction Generation

author.name: Zhi Wang, Liu Liu, Ruonan Liu, Dan Guo, Meng Wang

entry.summary: StructBiHOI proposes structured articulation modeling for long-horizon bimanual hand-object interaction generation, disentangling temporal joint planning from frame-level manipulation refinement.

entry.title: HybridMimic: Hybrid RL-Centroidal Control for Humanoid Motion Mimicking

author.name: Ludwig Chee-Ying Tay, I-Chia Chang, Yan Gu

entry.summary: Introduces HybridMimic, a framework combining reinforcement learning with centroidal model-based control for humanoid motion mimicking. The learned policy dynamically modulates centroidal control without requiring predefined contact timing, improving versatility over existing hybrid approaches.

entry.title: SurgSync: Time-Synchronized Multi-Modal Data Collection Framework and Dataset for Surgical Robotics

author.name: Haoying Zhou, Chang Liu, Yimeng Wu, Junlin Wu, Zijian Wu, Yu Chung Lee, Sara Martuscelli, Spetimiu E. Salcudean, Gregory S. Fischer, Peter Kazanzides

entry.summary: Presents SurgSync, a multi-modal data collection framework with offline and online synchronization for surgical robotics, implemented on the da Vinci Research Kit with modern stereo endoscope and comprehensive data recording.

entry.title: TacDexGrasp: Compliant and Robust Dexterous Grasping with Tactile Feedback

author.name: Yubin Ke, Jiayi Chen, Hang Lv, Xiao Zhou, He Wang

entry.summary: Addresses compliant dexterous grasping with tactile feedback using SOCP-based control without explicit torque modeling or slip detection. Key insight: rotational slip induces detectable translational slip at contact points.

entry.title: RoTri-Diff: A Spatial Robot-Object Triadic Interaction-Guided Diffusion Model for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Zixuan Chen, Nga Teng Chan, Yiwen Hou, Chenrui Tie, Zixuan Liu, Haonan Chen, Junting Chen, Jieqi Shi, Yang Gao, Jing Huo, Lin Shao

entry.summary: Proposes RoTri-Diff, a diffusion model for bimanual manipulation that explicitly models the triadic spatial relationship (Robot-Object Triadic Interaction) between two arms and the manipulated object using relative 6D poses.

entry.title: Approximate Imitation Learning for Event-based Quadrotor Flight in Cluttered Environments

author.name: Nico Messikommer, Jiaxu Xing, Leonard Bauersfeld, Marco Cannici, Elie Aljalbout, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Enables quadrotor flight through cluttered environments using only a single event camera, with an end-to-end neural network mapping event data to control commands. From Davide Scaramuzza's group at UZH.

entry.title: Omnidirectional Humanoid Locomotion on Stairs via Unsafe Stepping Penalty and Sparse LiDAR Elevation Mapping

author.name: Yuzhi Jiang, Yujun Liang, Junhao Li, Han Ding, Lijun Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a single-stage training framework for omnidirectional humanoid stair locomotion using a dense unsafe stepping penalty and sparse LiDAR elevation mapping for 360° terrain perception. Addresses blind zones from forward-facing cameras.

entry.title: DeReCo: Decoupling Representation and Coordination Learning for Object-Adaptive Decentralized Multi-Robot Cooperative Transport

author.name: Kazuki Shibata, Ryosuke Sota, Shandil Dhiresh Bosch, Yuki Kadokawa, Tsurumine Yoshihisa, Takamitsu Matsubara

entry.summary: Introduces DeReCo, which decouples representation learning from coordination learning for decentralized multi-robot cooperative transport across diverse objects. Addresses bidirectional interference between representation and policy learning in MARL.

entry.title: LAR-MoE: Latent-Aligned Routing for Mixture of Experts in Robotic Imitation Learning

author.name: Ariel Rodriguez, Chenpan Li, Lorenzo Mazza, Rayan Younis, Ortrun Hellig, Sebastian Bodenstedt, Martin Wagner, Stefanie Speidel

entry.summary: Introduces LAR-MoE, a two-stage framework decoupling unsupervised skill discovery from policy learning in imitation learning via Mixture-of-Experts with latent-aligned routing for handling heterogeneous task dynamics.

entry.title: EquiBim: Learning Symmetry-Equivariant Policy for Bimanual Manipulation

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhang, Aditya Mohan, Seungho Han, Wan Shou, Dongyi Wang, Yu She

entry.summary: Introduces EquiBim, a symmetry-equivariant policy learning framework for bimanual manipulation that enforces bilateral equivariance between observations and actions during training.

entry.title: Bilevel Planning with Learned Symbolic Abstractions from Interaction Data

author.name: Fatih Dogangun, Burcu Kilic, Serdar Bahar, Emre Ugur

entry.summary: Proposes a bilevel neuro-symbolic framework where learned probabilistic symbolic rules generate candidate plans at high level and learned continuous models verify plans and resolve parameter values at low level.

entry.title: Kernel Methods for Some Transport Equations with Application to Learning Kernels for the Approximation of Koopman Eigenfunctions: A Unified Approach via Variational Methods, Green's Functions and the Method of Characteristics

author.name: Boumediene Hamzi, Houman Owhadi, Umesh Vaidya

entry.summary: Presents a unified theoretical framework for constructing reproducing kernels for transport equations and Koopman eigenfunctions, proving equivalence of three construction methods: variational, Green's function, and characteristic flow-based.

entry.title: Sensivity of LLMs' Explanations to the Training Randomness:Context, Class & Task Dependencies

author.name: Romain Loncour, J\'er\'emie Bogaert, Fran\c{c}ois-Xavier Standaert

entry.summary: Investigates how syntactic context, class labels, and task type affect the sensitivity of transformer explanations to training randomness. Shows all factors have statistically significant impact, with tasks having the largest effect.

entry.title: Asymmetric Distillation and Information Retention in Capacity-Constrained Cross-Modal Transfer

author.name: Kabir Thayani

entry.summary: Investigates dimensional collapse when distilling CLIP ViT-B/32 into capacity-constrained CNNs. Finds a capacity-agnostic phase transition where all student models experience severe dimensional collapse regardless of size.

entry.title: Single Image Super-Resolution via Bivariate `A Trous Wavelet Diffusion

author.name: Heidari Maryam, Anantrasirichai Nantheera, Achim Alin

entry.summary: Proposes a wavelet-domain diffusion approach for single image super-resolution using bivariate à trous wavelets, avoiding spatial-domain hallucinations by operating in the frequency domain.

entry.title: Compressed-Domain-Aware Online Video Super-Resolution

author.name: Yuhang Wang, Hai Li, Shujuan Hou, Zhetao Dong, Xiaoyao Yang

entry.summary: CDA-VSR leverages compressed-domain information (motion vectors, residual maps, frame types) for efficient online video super-resolution in bandwidth-limited streaming. Proposes motion-vector-guided deformable alignment to reduce computational overhead.

entry.title: VSDiffusion: Taming Ill-Posed Shadow Generation via Visibility-Constrained Diffusion

author.name: Jing Li, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: VSDiffusion generates realistic cast shadows for composited objects using visibility-constrained diffusion in two stages: coarse shadow mask prediction followed by conditional diffusion guided by lighting and depth cues.

entry.title: From Reactive to Map-Based AI: Tuned Local LLMs for Semantic Zone Inference in Object-Goal Navigation

author.name: Yudai Noda, Kanji Tanaka

entry.summary: Proposes transitioning from reactive LLM-based navigation to map-based approach using fine-tuned Llama-2 for semantic zone inference. Integrates LLM reasoning with hybrid topological-grid mapping.

entry.title: CAR: Cross-Vehicle Kinodynamics Adaptation via Mobility Representation

author.name: Tong Xu, Chenhui Pan, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes CAR, a framework for cross-vehicle kinodynamics adaptation using a Transformer encoder with Adaptive Layer Normalization to embed vehicle trajectory transitions into a shared mobility latent space, enabling rapid transfer to new platforms.

entry.title: Towards Scalable Probabilistic Human Motion Prediction with Gaussian Processes for Safe Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Jinger Chong, Xiaotong Zhang, Kamal Youcef-Toumi

entry.summary: Proposes a structured multitask variational Gaussian Process framework for full-body human motion prediction using 6D rotation representation, achieving strong uncertainty calibration and up to 50x better KDE NLL than baselines on Human3.6M.

entry.title: FeasibleCap: Real-Time Embodiment Constraint Guidance for In-the-Wild Robot Demonstration Collection

author.name: Zi Yin, Fanhong Li, Yun Gui, Jia Liu

entry.summary: Presents FeasibleCap, a gripper-in-hand data collection system providing real-time executability feedback during demonstration collection, eliminating the need for separate replay-and-validation stages to verify robot feasibility.

entry.title: Failure Detection in Chemical Processes using Symbolic Machine Learning: A Case Study on Ethylene Oxidation

author.name: Julien Amblard, Niklas Groll, Matthew Tait, Mark Law, G\"urkan Sin, Alessandra Russo

entry.summary: Investigates symbolic machine learning for failure prediction in chemical processes (ethylene oxidation), using probabilistic rule learning as an explainable alternative to neural approaches in safety-critical industrial settings.

entry.title: FusionRegister: Every Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Deserves Registration

author.name: Congcong Bian, Haolong Ma, Hui Li, Zhongwei Shen, Xiaoqing Luo, Xiaoning Song, Xiao-Jun Wu

entry.summary: FusionRegister proposes a general cross-modality registration method for infrared-visible image fusion guided by visual priors, eliminating need for extensive pre-registration. Learns misregistration representations rather than forcing alignment of all differences.

entry.title: ViSA-Enhanced Aerial VLN: A Visual-Spatial Reasoning Enhanced Framework for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Haoyu Tong, Xiangyu Dong, Xiaoguang Ma, Haoran Zhao, Yaoming Zhou, Chenghao Lin

entry.summary: ViSA proposes a visual-spatial reasoning enhanced framework for aerial vision-language navigation using structured visual prompting. Enables VLMs to perform direct spatial reasoning on image planes without additional training.

entry.title: SRNeRV: A Scale-wise Recursive Framework for Neural Video Representation

author.name: Jia Wang, Jun Zhu, Xinfeng Zhang

entry.summary: SRNeRV proposes scale-wise recursive framework for implicit neural video representation, sharing channel mixing modules across scales while keeping spatial mixing scale-specific. Reduces parameter redundancy.

entry.title: Rectified flow-based prediction of post-treatment brain MRI from pre-radiotherapy priors for patients with glioma

author.name: Selena Huisman, Nordin Belkacemi, Vera Keil, Joost Verhoeff, Szabolcs David

entry.summary: Uses rectified flow models conditioned on pre-treatment MRI and radiation dose maps to predict post-radiotherapy brain MRI in glioma patients, enabling treatment optimization through realistic simulation.

entry.title: Learning-Based Robust Control: Unifying Exploration and Distributional Robustness for Reliable Robotics via Free Energy

author.name: Hozefa Jesawada, Giovanni Russo, Abdalla Swikir, Fares Abu-Dakka

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based robust control method inspired by the free energy principle that jointly learns environment dynamics and rewards while ensuring robustness to epistemic uncertainties. Modifies the maximum diffusion learning framework with distributional robustness.

entry.title: Kinematics-Aware Latent World Models for Data-Efficient Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jiazhuo Li, Linjiang Cao, Qi Liu, Xi Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes a kinematics-aware latent world model for autonomous driving that incorporates vehicle kinematic information into the RSSM observation encoder and uses geometry-aware supervision for data-efficient learning.

entry.title: DAISS: Phase-Aware Imitation Learning for Dual-Arm Robotic Ultrasound-Guided Interventions

author.name: Feng Li, Pei Liu, Shiting Wang, Ning Wang, Zhongliang Jiang, Nassir Navab, Yuan Bi

entry.summary: Presents DAISS, a dual-arm interventional surgical system for ultrasound-guided needle insertion that collects teleoperation demonstrations and learns phase-aware imitation policies for the asymmetric bimanual workflow.

entry.title: The EpisTwin: A Knowledge Graph-Grounded Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Personal AI

author.name: Giovanni Servedio, Potito Aghilar, Alessio Mattiace, Gianni Carmosino, Francesco Musicco, Gabriele Conte, Vito Walter Anelli, Tommaso Di Noia, Francesco Maria Donini

entry.summary: Introduces EpisTwin, a neuro-symbolic framework that grounds generative reasoning in a user-centric Personal Knowledge Graph. Uses multimodal language models to convert heterogeneous data into semantic triples for personal AI applications.

entry.title: From Toil to Thought: Designing for Strategic Exploration and Responsible AI in Systematic Literature Reviews

author.name: Runlong Ye, Naaz Sibia, Angela Zavaleta Bernuy, Tingting Zhu, Carolina Nobre, Viktoria Pammer-Schindler, Michael Liut

entry.summary: Investigates friction points in systematic literature reviews through a design study with 20 researchers, then develops ARC, a design probe for AI-assisted literature review with multi-database integration.

entry.title: Human-Data Interaction, Exploration, and Visualization in the AI Era: Challenges and Opportunities

author.name: Jean-Daniel Fekete, Yifan Hu, Dominik Moritz, Arnab Nandi, Senjuti Basu Roy, Eugene Wu, Nikos Bikakis, George Papastefanatos, Panos K. Chrysanthis, Guoliang Li, Lingyun Yu

entry.summary: Position paper examining how AI transforms human-data interaction, data exploration, and visualization, identifying challenges including perceptually misaligned latency, scalability constraints, and uncertainty in AI-generated insights.

entry.title: PVminerLLM: Structured Extraction of Patient Voice from Patient-Generated Text using Large Language Models

author.name: Samah Fodeh, Linhai Ma, Ganesh Puthiaraju, Srivani Talakokkul, Afshan Khan, Ashley Hagaman, Sarah Lowe, Aimee Roundtree

entry.summary: Introduces PVminerLLM, a supervised fine-tuned LLM for structured extraction of patient voice signals from patient-generated text, addressing the gap in capturing lived experience data for health outcomes research.

entry.title: Learning to Solve Orienteering Problem with Time Windows and Variable Profits

author.name: Songqun Gao, Zanxi Ruan, Patrick Floor, Marco Roveri, Luigi Palopoli, Daniele Fontanelli

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based two-stage approach (DeCoST) for the orienteering problem with time windows and variable profits, decoupling discrete routing from continuous service time optimization.

entry.title: Kinetic-based regularization: Learning spatial derivatives and PDE applications

author.name: Abhisek Ganguly, Santosh Ansumali, Sauro Succi

entry.summary: Extends kinetic-based regularization for learning spatial derivatives from discrete noisy data with provable second-order accuracy. Proposes explicit and implicit schemes for derivative estimation.

entry.title: A Reference Architecture of Reinforcement Learning Frameworks

author.name: Xiaoran Liu, Istvan David

entry.summary: Proposes a reference architecture for RL frameworks based on grounded theory analysis of 18 state-of-practice frameworks, identifying recurring architectural components and patterns.

entry.title: Khatri-Rao Clustering for Data Summarization

author.name: Martino Ciaperoni, Collin Leiber, Aristides Gionis, Heikki Mannila

entry.summary: Proposes Khatri-Rao clustering, extending centroid-based clustering to produce more compact data summaries by modeling centroids as arising from interactions (Khatri-Rao products). Addresses redundancy in traditional clustering summaries for datasets with many clusters.

entry.title: ERP-RiskBench: Leakage-Safe Ensemble Learning for Financial Risk

author.name: Sanjay Mishra

entry.summary: Presents ERP-RiskBench, a rebuilt experimental framework for financial risk detection in ERP systems, addressing common methodological flaws (leakage, inflated metrics) in prior published studies with proper nested cross-validation.

entry.title: Enhancing SHAP Explainability for Diagnostic and Prognostic ML Models in Alzheimer Disease

author.name: Pablo Guill\'en, Enrique Frias-Martinez

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-level SHAP explainability framework for Alzheimer's disease ML models, measuring coherence, stability, and consistency of explanations across disease stages and model architectures.

entry.title: HGT-Scheduler: Deep Reinforcement Learning for the Job Shop Scheduling Problem via Heterogeneous Graph Transformers

author.name: Bulent Soykan

entry.summary: Proposes HGT-Scheduler, a reinforcement learning framework for job shop scheduling that models the problem as a heterogeneous graph, using Heterogeneous Graph Transformers to capture distinct job-precedence and machine-contention relations.

entry.title: IGLU: The Integrated Gaussian Linear Unit Activation Function

author.name: Mingi Kang, Zai Yang, Jeova Farias Sales Rocha Neto

entry.summary: Introduces IGLU, a parametric activation function derived as a scale mixture of GELU gates under half-normal mixing, offering a principled mathematical derivation connecting various smooth activation functions.

entry.title: A Dual-Graph Spatiotemporal GNN Surrogate for Nonlinear Response Prediction of Reinforced Concrete Beams under Four-Point Bending

author.name: Zhaoyang Ren, Qilin Li

entry.summary: Develops a dual-graph spatiotemporal GNN surrogate for simulating nonlinear response of reinforced concrete beams, replacing costly finite element simulations.

entry.title: Generalizing Linear Autoencoder Recommenders with Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss

author.name: Ruixin Guo, Xinyu Li, Hao Zhou, Yang Zhou, Ruoming Jin

entry.summary: Generalizes the EDLAE recommender system objective into Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss, revealing closed-form solutions in broader hyperparameter ranges.

entry.title: Enhanced Random Subspace Local Projections for High-Dimensional Time Series Analysis

author.name: Eman Khalid, Moimma Ali Khan, Zarmeena Ali, Abdullah Illyas, Muhammad Usman, Saoud Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes an enhanced Random Subspace Local Projection framework for high-dimensional time series with weighted aggregation, category-aware sampling, and adaptive subspace selection.

entry.title: Step-Size Decay and Structural Stagnation in Greedy Sparse Learning

author.name: Pablo M. Bern\'a

entry.summary: Studies failure of greedy algorithms with over-decaying step sizes in sparse approximation, deriving explicit lower bounds showing structural stagnation even in low-dimensional settings.

entry.title: PSTNet: Physically-Structured Turbulence Network

author.name: Boris Kriuk, Fedor Kriuk

entry.summary: Introduces PSTNet, a lightweight neural architecture for atmospheric turbulence estimation that embeds Monin-Obukhov scaling theory directly into its structure, coupling physics-derived components with learned corrections.

entry.title: GCGNet: Graph-Consistent Generative Network for Time Series Forecasting with Exogenous Variables

author.name: Zhengyu Li, Xiangfei Qiu, Yuhan Zhu, Xingjian Wu, Jilin Hu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes GCGNet for time series forecasting with exogenous variables, using a graph-based approach to jointly model temporal and channel correlations rather than treating them separately.

entry.title: FedPrism: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning under Non-IID Data

author.name: Prakash Kumbhakar, Shrey Srivastava, Haroon R Lone

entry.summary: Proposes FedPrism, a federated learning framework using 'Prism Decomposition' that separates client models into global, group, and private components to handle non-IID data through automatic client grouping.

entry.title: Towards plausibility in time series counterfactual explanations

author.name: Marcin Kostrzewa, Krzysztof Galus, Maciej Zi\k{e}ba

entry.summary: Presents a method for generating plausible counterfactual explanations for time series classification using gradient-based optimization with soft-DTW alignment to ensure temporal realism.

entry.title: Meta-RL with Shared Representations Enables Fast Adaptation in Energy Systems

author.name: Th\'eo Zangato, Aomar Osmani, Pegah Alizadeh

entry.summary: Introduces a Meta-RL framework with shared state feature extractors jointly optimized across actor and critic networks, featuring bi-level optimization and parameter sharing for improved sample efficiency in energy systems.

entry.title: Towards Effective and Efficient Graph Alignment without Supervision

author.name: Songyang Chen, Youfang Lin, Yu Liu, Shuai Zheng, Lei Zou

entry.summary: Proposes GlobAlign, an unsupervised graph alignment method using a 'global representation and alignment' paradigm with optimal transport, addressing accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs of existing approaches.

entry.title: Split Federated Learning Architectures for High-Accuracy and Low-Delay Model Training

author.name: Yiannis Papageorgiou, Yannis Thomas, Ramin Khalili, Iordanis Koutsopoulos

entry.summary: Investigates how model partitioning in Split Federated Learning architectures affects training accuracy and delay. Proposes optimized Hierarchical SFL architectures that improve both accuracy and communication efficiency.

entry.title: XInsight: Integrative Stage-Consistent Psychological Counseling Support Agents for Digital Well-Being

author.name: Fei Wang, Jiangnan Yang, Junjie Chen, Yuxin Liu, Kun Li, Yanyan Wei, Dan Guo, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Presents XInsight, a multi-agent LLM framework for psychological counseling that follows the Exploration-Insight-Action therapeutic paradigm. Orchestrates specialized agents in a structured workflow for digital mental health support.

entry.title: Scaling Strategy, Not Compute: A Stand-Alone, Open-Source StarCraft II Benchmark for Accessible Reinforcement Learning Research

author.name: Sourav Panda, Shreyash Kale, Tanmay Ambadkar, Abhinav Verma, Jonathan Dodge

entry.summary: Introduces the Two-Bridge Map Suite for StarCraft II as an intermediate benchmark between full games and mini-games, designed to be accessible under realistic compute budgets while testing strategic RL capabilities.

entry.title: RECAP: Local Hebbian Prototype Learning as a Self-Organizing Readout for Reservoir Dynamics

author.name: Heng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces RECAP, a bio-inspired learning system coupling untrained reservoir dynamics with Hebbian prototype readout for image classification, avoiding backpropagation entirely.

author.name: Yunmei Chen, Chi Ding, Xiaojing Ye

entry.title: An Interpretable Generative Framework for Anomaly Detection in High-Dimensional Financial Time Series

author.name: Waldyn G Martinez

entry.title: Tau-BNO: Brain Neural Operator for Tau Transport Model

author.name: Nuutti Barron, Heng Rao, Urmi Saha, Yu Gu, Zhenghao Liu, Ge Yu, Defu Yang, Ashish Raj, Minghan Chen

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Gaussian Avatars: Improving Expression Generalization

entry.title: RILEC: Detection and Generation of L1 Russian Interference Errors in English Learner Texts

entry.title: A Joint Neural Baseline for Concept, Assertion, and Relation Extraction from Clinical Text

author.name: Fei Cheng, Ribeka Tanaka, Sadao Kurohashi

entry.title: Supporting Artifact Evaluation with LLMs: A Study with Published Security Research Papers

This addresses the challenge of generating high-fidelity, globally consistent textures for 3D garments without expensive multi-step optimization.

entry.title: ColonSplat: Reconstruction of Peristaltic Motion in Colonoscopy with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting

entry.title: DLRMamba: Distilling Low-Rank Mamba for Edge Multispectral Fusion Object Detection

entry.title: TrajPred: Trajectory-Conditioned Joint Embedding Prediction for Surgical Instrument-Tissue Interaction Recognition in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jiajun Cheng, Xiaofan Yu, Subarna, Sainan Liu, Shan Lin

entry.title: FabricGen: Microstructure-Aware Woven Fabric Generation

author.name: Yingjie Tang, Di Luo, Zixiong Wang, Xiaoli Ling, jian Yang, Beibei Wang

entry.title: SiamGM: Siamese Geometry-Aware and Motion-Guided Network for Real-Time Satellite Video Object Tracking

author.name: Zixiao Wen, Zhen Yang, Jiawei Li, Xiantai Xiang, Guangyao Zhou, Yuxin Hu, Yuhan Liu

entry.title: Geometric Knowledge-Assisted Federated Dual Knowledge Distillation Approach Towards Remote Sensing Satellite Imagery

author.name: Luyao Zou, Fei Pan, Jueying Li, Yan Kyaw Tun, Apurba Adhikary, Zhu Han, Hayoung Oh

entry.title: A Multi-Layer Sim-to-Real Framework for Gaze-Driven Assistive Neck Exoskeletons

author.name: Colin Rubow, Eric Brewer, Ian Bales, Haohan Zhang, Daniel S. Brown

entry.title: Vision-Guided MPPI for Agile Drone Racing: Navigating Arbitrary Gate Poses via Neural Signed Distance Fields

author.name: Fangguo Zhao, Hanbing Zhang, Zhouheng Li, Xin Guan, Shuo Li

entry.title: PanoDP: Learning Collision-Free Navigation with Panoramic Depth and Differentiable Physics

author.name: Hao Zhong, Pei Chi, Jiang Zhao, Shenghai Yuan, Xuyang Gao, Thien-Minh Nguyen, Lihua Xie

entry.summary: Presents PanoDP, a collision-free navigation framework combining panoramic depth perception with differentiable physics-based training. Uses dense differentiable collision terms rather than sparse terminal signals for policy optimization.

entry.title: AeroPlace-Flow: Language-Grounded Object Placement for Aerial Manipulators via Visual Foresight and Object Flow

author.name: Sarthak Mishra, Rishabh Dev Yadav, Naveen Nair, Wei Pan, Spandan Roy

entry.summary: Presents AeroPlace-Flow, a training-free framework for language-grounded aerial object placement using visual foresight (goal image synthesis) with 3D geometric reasoning and object flow for precise placement from language instructions.

entry.title: A Robust Antenna Provides Tactile Feedback in a Multi-legged Robot

author.name: Zhaochen J. Xu, Juntao He, Delfin Aydan, Malaika Taylor, Tianyu Wang, Jianfeng Lin, Wesley Dyer, Daniel I. Goldman

entry.title: Reasoning Knowledge-Gap in Drone Planning via LLM-based Active Elicitation

author.name: Zeyu Fang, Beomyeol Yu, Cheng Liu, Zeyuan Yang, Rongqian Chen, Yuxin Lin, Mahdi Imani, Tian Lan

entry.title: Contrastive-to-Self-Supervised: A Two-Stage Framework for Script Similarity Learning

entry.title: OptiRoulette Optimizer: A New Stochastic Meta-Optimizer for up to 5.3x Faster Convergence

author.name: Stamatis Mastromichalakis

entry.title: Metalearning traffic assignment for network disruptions with graph convolutional neural networks

entry.title: Adaptive Double-Booking Strategy for Outpatient Scheduling Using Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ninda Nurseha Amalina, Heungjo An

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive outpatient double-booking framework combining individualized no-show prediction with multi-objective RL for clinic scheduling.

entry.title: Deterministic Fuzzy Triage for Legal Compliance Classification and Evidence Retrieval

author.name: Rian Atri

entry.summary: Studies deterministic dual encoders with fuzzy triage bands for legal compliance classification, emphasizing reproducibility and transparency for regulatory frameworks like HIPAA.

entry.title: Bayesian Transformer for Probabilistic Load Forecasting in Smart Grids

author.name: Sajib Debnath, Md. Uzzal Mia

entry.title: Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation with Neural-Network-Augmented Online Calibration

entry.title: Calibrated Credit Intelligence: Shift-Robust and Fair Risk Scoring with Bayesian Uncertainty and Gradient Boosting

author.name: Srikumar Nayak

entry.title: Fast and Flexible Audio Bandwidth Extension via Vocos

entry.title: Learning embeddings of non-linear PDEs: the Burgers' equation

entry.title: Sandpiper: Orchestrated AI-Annotation for Educational Discourse at Scale

author.name: Daryl Hedley, Doug Pietrzak, Jorge Dias, Ian Burden, Bakhtawar Ahtisham, Zhuqian Zhou, Kirk Vanacore, Josh Marland, Rachel Slama, Justin Reich, Kenneth Koedinger, Ren\'e Kizilcec

entry.title: Virtual Try-On for Cultural Clothing: A Benchmarking Study

Develops a robot-terrain interaction model predicting anchoring timing, step length, and speed as functions of terrain properties.

author.name: Aurelio Raffa Ugolini, Jessica Leoni, Valentina Breschi, Damiano Paniccia, Francesco Aldo Tucci, Luigi Capone, Mara Tanelli

entry.title: Revisiting Gradient Staleness: Evaluating Distance Metrics for Asynchronous Federated Learning Aggregation

author.name: Patrick Wilhelm, Odej Kao

author.name: Zahra Jafari, Azadeh Zamanifar, Amirfarhad Farhadi

It demonstrates how shared learning principles can explain many features of early language development.

entry.title: Real-Time Glottis Detection Framework via Spatial-decoupled Feature Learning for Nasal Transnasal Intubation

author.name: Jinyu Liu, Gaoyang Zhang, Yang Zhou, Ruoyi Hao, Yang Zhang, Hongliang Ren

entry.summary: Mobile GlottisNet is a lightweight glottis detection framework for real-time nasotracheal intubation on edge devices. Uses spatial awareness and alignment mechanisms for robust detection under complex anatomical conditions.

entry.title: Tracking Phenological Status and Ecological Interactions in a Hawaiian Cloud Forest Understory using Low-Cost Camera Traps and Visual Foundation Models

author.name: Luke Meyers, Anirudh Potlapally, Yuyan Chen, Mike Long, Tanya Berger-Wolf, Hari Subramoni, Remi Megret, Daniel Rubenstein

entry.summary: Uses foundation vision models with camera traps to track plant phenology and flora-faunal interactions in a Hawaiian cloud forest. Demonstrates practical ecological monitoring without supervised learning.

entry.title: Synthetic Defect Image Generation for Power Line Insulator Inspection Using Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Xuesong Wang, Caisheng Wang

entry.summary: Uses multimodal LLMs as training-free generators to synthesize defect images for power line insulator inspection, addressing data scarcity. Includes embedding-based selection filtering for quality control.

entry.title: Alignment-Aware and Reliability-Gated Multimodal Fusion for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Detection Across Heterogeneous Thermal-Visual Sensors

author.name: Ishrat Jahan, Molla E Majid, M Murugappan, Muhammad E. H. Chowdhury, N. B. Prakash, Saad Bin Abul Kashem, Balamurugan Balusamy, Amith Khandakar

entry.summary: Proposes two fusion strategies (RGIF and RGMAF) for UAV detection across heterogeneous thermal-visual sensors. Uses registration-aware fusion and reliability-gated attention for cross-modal alignment.

entry.title: Exploring Deep Learning and Ultra-Widefield Imaging for Diabetic Retinopathy and Macular Edema

author.name: Pablo Jimenez-Lizcano, Sergio Romero-Tapiador, Ruben Tolosana, Aythami Morales, Guillermo Gonz\'alez de Rivera, Ruben Vera-Rodriguez, Julian Fierrez

entry.summary: Explores deep learning methods for diabetic retinopathy and macular edema detection using ultra-widefield imaging instead of traditional color fundus photography. Evaluates on the UWF4DR Challenge dataset from MICCAI 2024.

entry.title: Event-based Motion & Appearance Fusion for 6D Object Pose Tracking

author.name: Zhichao Li, Chiara Bartolozzi, Lorenzo Natale, Arren Glover

entry.summary: Proposes a 6D object pose tracking method using event cameras that combines motion propagation with pose correction, leveraging the high temporal resolution of event cameras for fast-moving objects in robotics applications.

entry.title: Alfa: Attentive Low-Rank Filter Adaptation for Structure-Aware Cross-Domain Personalized Gaze Estimation

author.name: He-Yen Hsieh, Wei-Te Mark Ting, H. T. Kung

entry.summary: Alfa proposes attentive low-rank filter adaptation for cross-domain personalized gaze estimation, designed for test-time personalization with few unlabeled samples on resource-constrained devices.

entry.title: Online Sparse Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging

author.name: Conor Flynn, Radoslav Ivanov, Birsen Yazici

entry.summary: Proposes Online FISTA for SAR imaging on autonomous drones, enabling incremental scene reconstruction with limited data through sparse coding with recursive storage matrix updates.

entry.title: ACCURATE: Arbitrary-shaped Continuum Reconstruction Under Robust Adaptive Two-view Estimation

author.name: Yaozhi Zhang, Shun Yu, Yugang Zhang, Yang Liu

entry.summary: ACCURATE proposes a 3D reconstruction framework for deformable continuum bodies (guidewires, catheters) combining image segmentation with geometry-constrained topology traversal and dynamic programming.

entry.title: Visualizing Coalition Formation: From Hedonic Games to Image Segmentation

author.name: Pedro Henrique de Paula Fran\c{c}a, Lucas Lopes Felipe, Daniel Sadoc Menasch\'e

entry.summary: Proposes image segmentation as a visual diagnostic testbed for coalition formation in hedonic games, modeling pixels as agents and studying how parameters shape equilibrium fragmentation.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust Geometric Joint Chance-Constrained Optimization: Neurodynamic Approaches

author.name: Ange Valli (L2S), Siham Tassouli (OPTIM), Abdel Lisser (L2S)

entry.summary: Proposes neurodynamic duplex approaches for distributionally robust geometric joint chance-constrained optimization, using neural networks to converge to global optima without standard solvers.

entry.title: Structure from Rank: Rank-Order Coding as a Bridge from Sequence to Structure

author.name: Xiaodan Chen, Alexandre Pitti, Mathias Quoy, Nancy Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a rank-order based neural network inspired by brain pathways (STG-LIFG-PMC) that models the transition from acoustic input to abstract rank representations and back to motor execution. The model demonstrates efficient compression of input while retaining ability to reconstruct utterances from partial cues, showing emergent structure-sensitive generation.

entry.title: Nonlinear Performance Degradation of Vision-Based Teleoperation under Network Latency

author.name: Aws Khalil, Jaerock Kwon

entry.summary: Investigates nonlinear degradation of vision-based teleoperation under network latency, finding a sharp stability collapse between 150-225ms delay. Develops the LAVT testbed for reproducible latency measurement in ROS 2.

entry.title: Collaborative Planning with Concurrent Synchronization for Operationally Constrained UAV-UGV Teams

author.name: Zihao Deng, Qianhuang Li, Peng Gao, Maggie Wigness, John Rogers, Donghyun Kim, Hao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a collaborative planning framework for UAV-UGV teams with concurrent synchronization, addressing energy-constrained multi-UAV task planning and traversability-constrained UGV path planning with timely in-mission recharging.

entry.title: LIPP: Load-Aware Informative Path Planning with Physical Sampling

author.name: Hojune Kim, Guangyao Shi, Gaurav S. Sukhatme

entry.summary: Addresses informative path planning for physical sample collection where collected samples add mass and increase energy costs for subsequent motion. Proposes load-aware planning that accounts for coupling between information gain and load-dependent traversal cost.

entry.title: GuideTWSI: A Diverse Tactile Walking Surface Indicator Dataset from Synthetic and Real-World Images for Blind and Low-Vision Navigation

author.name: Hochul Hwang, Soowan Yang, Anh N. H. Nguyen, Parth Goel, Krisha Adhikari, Sunghoon I. Lee, Joydeep Biswas, Nicholas A. Giudice, Donghyun Kim

entry.summary: Creates GuideTWSI, a dataset of Tactile Walking Surface Indicators for blind/low-vision navigation assistance, combining synthetic and real-world images with diverse viewpoints and geographic coverage beyond existing East Asian-biased datasets.

entry.title: Tutorial on Aided Inertial Navigation Systems: A Modern Treatment Using Lie-Group Theoretical Methods

author.name: Soulaimane Berkane

entry.summary: Presents a tutorial on aided inertial navigation using Lie-group formulation centered on SE_2(3), covering geometric framework for fusing inertial measurements with aiding information, and discussing recent extensions including equivariant filtering.

entry.title: Underwater Embodied Intelligence for Autonomous Robots: A Constraint-Coupled Perspective on Planning, Control, and Deployment

author.name: Jingzehua Xu, Guanwen Xie, Jiwei Tang, Shuai Zhang, Xiaofan Li

entry.summary: Reviews autonomous underwater robot challenges through a constraint-coupled perspective, arguing that planning and control must be understood within tightly coupled physical constraints including hydrodynamics, partial observability, and energy scarcity.

entry.title: Cable-driven Continuum Robotics: Proprioception via Proximal-integrated Force Sensing

author.name: Gang Zhang, Junyan Yan, Jibiao Chen, Shing Shin Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces proprioception method for cable-driven continuum robots using proximal force sensing (cable tension and 6-axis F/T sensor), inspired by human finger tendon-joint sensing. Achieves 3D contact force perception and shape estimation.

entry.title: Low-Cost Teleoperation Extension for Mobile Manipulators

author.name: Danil Belov, Artem Erkhov, Yaroslav Savotin, Tatiana Podladchikova, Pavel Osinenko

entry.summary: Presents an open-source teleoperation framework for mobile bimanual manipulators using commodity hardware: smartphone for head tracking, leader arms for manipulation, and foot pedals for base navigation.

entry.title: C$^2$-Explorer: Contiguity-Driven Task Allocation with Connectivity-Aware Task Representation for Decentralized Multi-UAV Exploration

author.name: Xinlu Yan, Mingjie Zhang, Yuhao Fang, Yanke Sun, Jun Ma, Youmin Gong, Boyu Zhou, Jie Mei

entry.summary: Proposes C²-Explorer for decentralized multi-UAV exploration using connectivity-aware task representation and contiguity-driven allocation to avoid non-contiguous assignments and cross-region detours under limited communication.

entry.title: Physics-infused Learning for Aerial Manipulator in Winds and Near-Wall Environments

author.name: Yiming Zhang, Junyi Geng

entry.summary: Proposes physics-infused learning for aerial manipulators combining blade-element theory with learning to capture wind disturbances and near-wall aerodynamic effects that simplified thrust models miss.

entry.title: Dual-Horizon Hybrid Internal Model for Low-Gravity Quadrupedal Jumping with Hardware-in-the-Loop Validation

author.name: Haozhe Xu, Yifei Zhao, Wenhao Feng, Zhipeng Wang, Hongrui Sang, Cheng Cheng, Xiuxian Li, Zhen Yin, Bin He

entry.summary: Presents a Dual-Horizon Hybrid Internal Model for continuous quadrupedal jumping under lunar gravity using proprioceptive sensing only. Two temporal encoders capture short-horizon vertical dynamics and long-horizon attitude regulation.

entry.title: Less is More: Robust Zero-Communication 3D Pursuit-Evasion via Representational Parsimony

author.name: Jialin Ying, Zhihao Li, Zicheng Dong, Guohua Wu, Yihuan Liao

entry.summary: Studies whether representational parsimony improves communication-free coordination in 3D pursuit-evasion tasks. Shows that reducing observation dimensionality from 83-D to 50-D can improve robustness in zero-communication multi-agent settings.

entry.title: EndoSERV: A Vision-based Endoluminal Robot Navigation System

author.name: Junyang Wu, Fangfang Xie, Minghui Zhang, Hanxiao Zhang, Jiayuan Sun, Yun Gu, Guang-Zhong Yang

entry.summary: Presents EndoSERV, a vision-based endoluminal robot navigation system that divides complex luminal structures into sub-segments and maps from real to virtual views for localization without external tracking.

entry.title: Tactile Recognition of Both Shapes and Materials with Automatic Feature Optimization-Enabled Meta Learning

author.name: Hongliang Zhao, Wenhui Yang, Yang Chen, Zhuorui Wang, Baiheng Liu, Longhui Qin

entry.summary: Proposes AFOP-ML, a meta-learning framework for tactile recognition of shapes and materials with automatic feature optimization, addressing data scarcity in tactile sensing through few-shot learning.

entry.title: Fr\'echet regression of multivariate distributions with nonparanormal transport

author.name: Junyoung Park, Irina Gaynanova

entry.summary: Proposes a regression approach for multivariate distributional responses using the nonparanormal transport metric as a closed-form surrogate for Wasserstein distance within the Fréchet regression framework.

entry.title: Decoupling Distance and Networks: Hybrid Graph Attention-Geostatistical Methods for Spatio-temporal Risk Mapping

author.name: Toba Temitope Bamidele, Ezra Gayawan, Femi Barnabas Adebola, Olatunji Johnson

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid framework combining Graph Attention Networks (GATv2) with model-based geostatistics for spatial risk mapping, capturing both relational and continuous spatial dependence.

entry.title: Promoting enmity and bad vibes around AI safety

author.name: Andrew_Critch

entry.summary: Argues that promoting enmity between groups (e.g., AI labs and government) increases AI risk through a Promoting Enmity → Conflict → Catastrophe causal pathway, and proposes mitigation strategies.

entry.title: Aggregative Semantics for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks

author.name: Yann Munro, Isabelle Bloch, Marie-Jeanne Lesot

entry.summary: Introduces aggregative semantics for Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks, proposing to aggregate attackers and supporters separately rather than treating them symmetrically. Provides theoretical analysis of properties.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Heterogeneity of AI-Driven Traffic Flow Patterns and Land Use Interaction: A GeoAI-Based Analysis of Multimodal Urban Mobility

author.name: Olaf Yunus Laitinen Imanov

entry.summary: Proposes a GeoAI hybrid framework combining MGWR, Random Forest, and Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks to model spatiotemporal heterogeneity of traffic flow patterns across multiple mobility modes.

entry.title: Trust Aware Federated Learning for Secure Bone Healing Stage Interpretation in e-Health

author.name: Paul Shepherd, Tasos Dagiuklas, Bugra Alkan, Joaquim Bastos, Jonathan Rodriguez

entry.summary: Presents a trust-aware federated learning framework for bone healing stage interpretation, with adaptive trust scoring to filter unreliable or adversarial client contributions.

entry.title: Reinforcement learning-based dynamic cleaning scheduling framework for solar energy system

author.name: Heungjo An

entry.summary: Proposes RL-based framework for optimizing solar panel cleaning schedules using PPO and SAC algorithms, demonstrating improved efficiency in Abu Dhabi case study.

entry.title: LeJOT-AutoML: LLM-Driven Feature Engineering for Job Execution Time Prediction in Databricks Cost Optimization

author.name: Lizhi Ma, Yi-Xiang Hu, Yihui Ren, Feng Wu, Xiang-Yang Li

entry.summary: Presents LeJOT-AutoML, an LLM-agent-driven AutoML framework that automates feature engineering for predicting job execution times in Databricks, reducing cloud costs by better selecting compute configurations.

entry.title: Oracle-Guided Soft Shielding for Safe Move Prediction in Chess

author.name: Prajit T Rajendran, Fabio Arnez, Huascar Espinoza, Agnes Delaborde, Chokri Mraidha

entry.summary: Proposes Oracle-Guided Soft Shielding for safer decision-making in chess, learning a probabilistic safety model from oracle feedback in an imitation learning setting to enable safe exploration.

entry.title: GNN For Muon Particle Momentum estimation

author.name: Vishak K Bhat, Eric A. F. Reinhardt, Sergei Gleyzer

entry.summary: Applies GNNs for muon particle momentum estimation at the CMS experiment at the LHC, showing improvements over TabNet using graph-structured detector data.

entry.title: High-Resolution Image Reconstruction with Unsupervised Learning and Noisy Data Applied to Ion-Beam Dynamics for Particle Accelerators

author.name: Francis Osswald (IPHC), Mohammed Chahbaoui (UNISTRA), Xinyi Liang (SU)

entry.summary: Applies unsupervised neural network methods with optimized early-stopping for high-resolution image reconstruction in beam diagnostics for particle accelerators, without requiring training datasets.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Solar Flare Regression

author.name: Jinsu Hong, Chetraj Pandey, Berkay Aydin

entry.summary: Applies conformal prediction to solar flare regression to provide calibrated prediction intervals, addressing the lack of uncertainty quantification in space weather forecasting.

entry.title: Pushing Bistatic Wireless Sensing toward High Accuracy at the Sub-Wavelength Scale

author.name: Wenwei Li, Jiarun Zhou, Qinxiao Quan, Fusang Zhang, Daqing Zhang

entry.summary: Derives the first quantitative mapping between distorted channel ratio features and ideal channel features in bistatic wireless sensing, overcoming sub-wavelength accuracy limitations from clock asynchronism.

entry.title: GRD-Net: Generative-Reconstructive-Discriminative Anomaly Detection with Region of Interest Attention Module

author.name: Niccol\`o Ferrari, Michele Fraccaroli, Evelina Lamma

entry.title: Outlier-robust Autocovariance Least Square Estimation via Iteratively Reweighted Least Square

author.name: Jiahong Li, Fang Deng

entry.title: Electrocardiogram Classification with Transformers Using Koopman and Wavelet Features

author.name: Sucheta Ghosh, Zahra Monfared

entry.title: Position: LLMs Must Use Functor-Based and RAG-Driven Bias Mitigation for Fairness

author.name: Ravi Ranjan, Utkarsh Grover, Agorista Polyzou

entry.title: COACH meets QUORUM: A Framework and Pipeline for Aligning User, Expert and Developer Perspectives in LLM-generated Health Counselling

author.name: Yee Man Ng, Bram van Dijk, Pieter Beynen, Otto Boekesteijn, Joris Jansen, Gerard van Oortmerssen, Max van Duijn, Marco Spruit

entry.summary: Presents QUORUM, an evaluation framework unifying developer, expert, and user perspectives for LLM-based health counselling, and COACH, an LLM pipeline for lifestyle counselling. Demonstrated with a real case study on chronic disease management.

entry.title: Quantifying Cross-Lingual Transfer in Paralinguistic Speech Tasks

entry.summary: Introduces the Cross-Lingual Transfer Matrix (CLTM) to systematically quantify cross-lingual interactions for paralinguistic speech tasks. Applies it to gender identification and speaker verification across multiple languages.

entry.title: Parameterized Brushstroke Style Transfer

author.name: Uma Meleti, Siyu Huang

entry.summary: Proposes brush stroke domain style transfer that represents images as parameterized brush strokes instead of pixel modifications. More natural representation for artistic styles compared to pixel-based approaches.

entry.title: A Hybrid Vision Transformer Approach for Mathematical Expression Recognition

author.name: Anh Duy Le, Van Linh Pham, Vinh Loi Ly, Nam Quan Nguyen, Huu Thang Nguyen, Tuan Anh Tran

entry.summary: Uses Hybrid Vision Transformer with 2D positional encoding for mathematical expression recognition, combined with a coverage attention decoder. Addresses two-dimensional structure complexity in math expressions.

entry.title: PCFEx: Point Cloud Feature Extraction for Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Abdullah Al Masud, Shi Xintong, Mondher Bouazizi, Ohtsuki Tomoaki

entry.title: mmGAT: Pose Estimation by Graph Attention with Mutual Features from mmWave Radar Point Cloud

author.name: Abdullah Al Masud, Shi Xintong, Mondher Bouazizi, Ohtsuki Tomoaki

entry.summary: mmGAT uses graph attention networks with mutual features for human pose estimation from mmWave radar point clouds, targeting privacy-preserving alternatives to camera-based systems.

entry.title: A Pivot-Based Kirigami Utensil for Hand-Held and Robot-Assisted Feeding

author.name: Keone Leao, Grace Brotherson, Iain Mischel, Sagar Parekh, Dylan P. Losey

entry.summary: Introduces a pivot-based kirigami spoon (kiri-spoon) designed for both hand-held use and robot-assisted feeding, targeting 60+ million adults with essential tremors. The pivot design enables the utensil to function as chopsticks that secure food items while remaining usable by people with mobility limitations.

entry.title: A Contrastive Fewshot RGBD Traversability Segmentation Framework for Indoor Robotic Navigation

author.name: Qiyuan An, Tuan Dang, Fillia Makedon

entry.title: Energy-Efficient Collaborative Transport of Tether-Suspended Payloads via Rotating Equilibrium

entry.title: Unifying Sidewinding and Rolling: A Wave-Based Framework for Self-Righting in Elongated Limbless and Multi-Legged Robots

author.name: Hangjun Liu, Jiarui Geng, Jinxuan Ding, Gengzhi He, Xiyuan Wang, Melisa Arukgoda, Joe DiGennaro, George Ubertalli, Grigoriy Blekherman, Baxi Chong

entry.summary: Presents a unified wave-based framework connecting sidewinding and rolling as self-righting strategies for elongated multi-legged robots, investigating how morphological parameters affect strategy selection through biomechanics and robophysics.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Off-World Exploration for Sparse Evidence Discovery via Gaussian Belief Mapping and Dual-Domain Coverage

author.name: Zhuoran Qiao, Tianxin Hu, Thien-Minh Nguyen, Shenghai Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent informative path planning framework for off-world exploration using Gaussian belief mapping and dual-domain coverage for sparse evidence discovery in hazardous terrain with limited communication.

entry.title: Adaptive Vision-Based Control of Redundant Robots with Null-Space Interaction for Human-Robot Collaboration

author.name: Xiangjie Yan, Chen Chen, Xiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive vision-based control scheme for redundant robots with null-space interaction for human-robot collaboration, combining task-space visual servoing with null-space interactive control.
