author.name: Satheeshkumar Veeramani, Anna Kisil, Abigail Bentley, Hatem Fakhruldeen, Gabriella Pizzuto, Andrew I. Cooper

entry.summary: Addresses human-aware robot behavior in self-driving laboratories where human and robot chemists share equipment. Proposes moving beyond simple LiDAR obstruction detection to more intelligent shared workspace management.

entry.title: Tree-Based Predictive Models for Noisy Input Data

author.name: Kevin McCoy, Zachary Wooten, Christine B. Peterson

entry.summary: Addresses measurement error in Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART), proposing extensions to handle noisy input data. Applied to microbiome diversity prediction.

entry.title: Payorian cooperation is easy with Kripke frames

author.name: transhumanist_atom_understander

entry.summary: Explains how Kripke frames provide a cleaner approach to proving Payorian cooperation in MIRI's open-source game theory setting, comparing it to Löbian cooperation via Löb's theorem.

entry.title: Efficient Trajectory Optimization for Autonomous Racing via Formula-1 Data-Driven Initialization

author.name: Samir Shehadeh, Lukas Kutsch, Nils Dengler, Sicong Pan, Maren Bennewitz

entry.summary: Proposes using real Formula 1 telemetry data to initialize trajectory optimization for autonomous racing, constructing a multi-track dataset from noisy GPS data across 17 tracks and training a neural network for trajectory prediction.

entry.title: An Interactive Multi-Agent System for Evaluation of New Product Concepts

author.name: Bin Xuan, Ruo Ai, Hakyeon Lee

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based multi-agent system for evaluating new product concepts, with eight virtual agents representing different business domains. Uses RAG to incorporate domain knowledge for assessing technical and market feasibility.

entry.title: Molecular Representations for AI in Chemistry and Materials Science: An NLP Perspective

author.name: Sanjanasri JP, Pratiti Bhadra, N. Sukumar, Soman KP

entry.summary: Survey paper reviewing molecular representations inspired by NLP for use in chemical informatics and AI-based applications in chemistry and materials science.

entry.title: Remote Sensing Image Classification Using Deep Ensemble Learning

author.name: Niful Islam, Md. Rayhan Ahmed, Nur Mohammad Fahad, Salekul Islam, A. K. M. Muzahidul Islam, Saddam Mukta, Swakkhar Shatabda

entry.summary: Proposes deep ensemble learning combining CNNs and Vision Transformers for remote sensing image classification, showing ensemble outperforms standalone architectures.

entry.title: Stock Market Prediction Using Node Transformer Architecture Integrated with BERT Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Mohammad Al Ridhawi, Mahtab Haj Ali, Hussein Al Osman

entry.summary: Proposes an integrated stock market prediction framework combining node transformers with BERT sentiment analysis, representing the market as a graph with sector and supply chain connections.

entry.title: Facial Expression Recognition Using Residual Masking Network

author.name: Luan Pham, The Huynh Vu, Tuan Anh Tran

entry.summary: Proposes a Residual Masking Network combining ResNet with UNet-like segmentation for facial expression recognition, using attention-like masking to focus on relevant facial features. Claims SOTA on FER2013 and VEMO datasets.

entry.title: Looking Through Glass Box

author.name: Alexis Kafantaris

entry.summary: Presents a neural implementation of fuzzy cognitive maps (FHM) using Langevin dynamics for inverse solving, providing interpretable modification criteria.

entry.title: CLAIRE: Compressed Latent Autoencoder for Industrial Representation and Evaluation -- A Deep Learning Framework for Smart Manufacturing

author.name: Mohammadhossein Ghahramani, Mengchu Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces CLAIRE, a hybrid autoencoder + classifier framework for fault detection in smart manufacturing, using compressed latent representations from high-dimensional sensor data.

entry.title: Bi Directional Feedback Fusion for Activity Aware Forecasting of Indoor CO2 and PM2.5

author.name: Harshala Gammulle, Lidia Morawska, Sridha Sridharan, Clinton Fookes

entry.summary: Presents a dual-stream bi-directional feedback fusion framework for indoor air quality forecasting that jointly models environmental evolution and occupant activity patterns for CO2 and PM2.5 prediction.

entry.title: Semantic Risk Scoring of Aggregated Metrics: An AI-Driven Approach for Healthcare Data Governance

author.name: Mohammed Omer Shakeel Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes an AI framework for evaluating privacy risks in aggregated healthcare metrics by analyzing SQL-based metric definitions for potential data overexposure using semantic and syntactic analysis.

entry.title: Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for Multivariate Clinical Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Irene Iele, Floriano Caprio, Paolo Soda, Matteo Tortora

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid quantum-classical architecture for clinical time series forecasting that integrates a Variational Quantum Circuit within a GRU-based recurrent neural network for predicting vital signs.

entry.title: Exploration Space Theory: Formal Foundations for Prerequisite-Aware Location-Based Recommendation

author.name: Madjid Sadallah

entry.summary: Introduces Exploration Space Theory, applying Knowledge Space Theory's lattice-theoretic framework to location-based recommendation, modeling prerequisite dependencies among points of interest.

entry.title: How the Graph Construction Technique Shapes Performance in IoT Botnet Detection

author.name: Hassan Wasswa, Hussein Abbass, Timothy Lynar

entry.summary: Evaluates how different graph construction methods (k-NN, Gabriel Graph, etc.) affect GNN performance for IoT botnet detection on tabular NetFlow data.

entry.title: XAI and Few-shot-based Hybrid Classification Model for Plant Leaf Disease Prognosis

author.name: Diana Susan Joseph, Pranav M Pawar, Raja Muthalagu, Mithun Mukharjee

entry.summary: Combines Siamese and Prototypical Networks with Grad-CAM for few-shot classification of crop leaf diseases in maize, rice, and wheat under limited data conditions.

entry.title: Towards Objective Gastrointestinal Auscultation: Automated Segmentation and Annotation of Bowel Sound Patterns

author.name: Zahra Mansour, Verena Uslar, Dirk Weyhe, Danilo Hollosi, Nils Strodthoff

entry.summary: Develops an automated pipeline for bowel sound segmentation and classification using wearable acoustic sensors, providing objective and quantitative feedback on bowel activity.

entry.title: Integration of deep generative Anomaly Detection algorithm in high-speed industrial line

author.name: Niccol\`o Ferrari, Nicola Zanarini, Michele Fraccaroli, Alice Bizzarri, Evelina Lamma

entry.summary: Presents deployment of a semi-supervised anomaly detection framework based on GANs with residual autoencoders on a high-speed pharmaceutical production line. Focuses on practical industrial deployment constraints.

entry.title: Exoskeleton Control through Learning to Reduce Biological Joint Moments in Simulations

author.name: Zihang You, Xianlian Zhou

entry.summary: Presents an RL framework for learning exoskeleton assistance policies to reduce biological joint moments, with validation using open-source gait data.

entry.title: Hospitality-VQA: Decision-Oriented Informativeness Evaluation for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jeongwoo Lee, Baek Duhyeong, Eungyeol Han, Soyeon Shin, Gukin han, Seungduk Kim, Jaehyun Jeon, Taewoo Jeong

entry.summary: Introduces Hospitality-VQA benchmark evaluating VLMs on decision-oriented visual question answering about hotel images, proposing 'informativeness' as a formal evaluation framework.

entry.title: SMGI: A Structural Theory of General Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Aomar Osmani

entry.summary: Introduces SMGI, a structural theory of general AI that formalizes intelligence as a typed meta-model with dynamic components, separating structural ontology from behavioral semantics.

entry.title: IronEngine: Towards General AI Assistant

author.name: Xi Mo

entry.summary: Presents IronEngine, a general AI assistant platform with unified orchestration connecting UI, APIs, model backends, memory, tools, and hardware integration through a three-phase Discussion-Switch-Execution pipeline.

entry.title: Characterization and upgrade of a quantum graph neural network for charged particle tracking

author.name: Matteo Argenton, Laura Cappelli, Concezio Bozzi

entry.summary: Characterizes and upgrades a quantum graph neural network (QGNN) for charged particle tracking in high-luminosity LHC experiments. The model operates on event graphs built from detector hits, exploring quantum ML approaches for HEP tasks.

entry.title: Fanar-Sadiq: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Grounded Islamic QA

author.name: Ummar Abbas, Mourad Ouzzani, Mohamed Y. Eltabakh, Omar Sinan, Gagan Bhatia, Hamdy Mubarak, Majd Hawasly, Mohammed Qusay Hashim, Kareem Darwish, Firoj Alam

entry.title: calibfusion: Transformer-Based Differentiable Calibration for Radar-Camera Fusion Detection in Water-Surface Environments

author.name: Yuting Wan, Liguo Sun, Jiuwu Hao, Pin LV

entry.summary: Proposes CalibFusion, a calibration-conditioned radar-camera fusion detector for water-surface environments that learns implicit extrinsic calibration. Addresses challenges of sparse targets and wave-induced clutter in maritime settings.

entry.title: Spectral Gaps and Spatial Priors: Studying Hyperspectral Downstream Adaptation Using TerraMind

author.name: Julia Anna Leonardi, Johannes Jakubik, Paolo Fraccaro, Maria Antonia Brovelli

entry.title: Research Summary: March 09, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's top research centers on AI safety limitations and efficient inference, with strong contributions in generative modeling and theoretical foundations.

  • The CoT-Control evaluation suite reveals that reasoning models fundamentally struggle to control chain-of-thought verbalization, undermining CoT monitoring as a safety strategy
  • The Disentangled Safety Hypothesis uncovers that LLM safety operates on two separable subspaces—recognition vs. refusal—with direct implications for robustness of alignment
  • A substantive critique highlights that GPT-5.4 Pro was released without adequate safety evaluations for catastrophic-risk-relevant capabilities

Self-Flow from Stability AI and MIT introduces self-supervised flow matching with Dual-Timestep Denoising, unifying representation learning and generation. Omni-Diffusion presents the first fully diffusion-based any-to-any multimodal model, while PSIVG enforces physical consistency in video generation by integrating physics simulators into diffusion loops.

  • FlashPrefill achieves ultra-fast prefilling via instantaneous sparse attention pattern discovery
  • Theoretical work proves weak-to-strong generalization can improve scaling law exponents in random feature ridge regression
  • Scaling PPO to 1M parallel environments resolves training plateaus caused by poor sample-based loss approximations
  • MultiHaystack fills a key evaluation gap with retrieval-and-reasoning benchmarks over 40K heterogeneous multimodal documents

entry.title: Reasoning Models Struggle to Control their Chains of Thought

author.name: Chen Yueh-Han, Robert McCarthy, Bruce W. Lee, He He, Ian Kivlichan, Bowen Baker, Micah Carroll, Tomek Korbak

entry.summary: Introduces CoT-Control evaluation suite showing that reasoning models struggle to control what they verbalize in chain-of-thought much more than they struggle to control final outputs. Claude Sonnet 4.5 can control CoT only 2.7% of the time vs 61.9% for final output, suggesting CoT monitoring may be more reliable than feared.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Flow Matching for Scalable Multi-Modal Synthesis

author.name: Hila Chefer, Patrick Esser, Dominik Lorenz, Dustin Podell, Vikash Raja, Vinh Tong, Antonio Torralba, Robin Rombach

entry.summary: Introduces Self-Flow, a self-supervised flow matching paradigm that integrates representation learning within the generative framework via Dual-Timestep Scheduling. This creates information asymmetry across tokens, forcing the model to learn strong semantic representations without external pretrained models like CLIP.

entry.title: Improved Scaling Laws via Weak-to-Strong Generalization in Random Feature Ridge Regression

author.name: Diyuan Wu, Lehan Chen, Theodor Misiakiewicz, Marco Mondelli

entry.summary: Proves that weak-to-strong generalization in random feature ridge regression can yield substantial improvements that affect the scaling law exponent, not just constant factors. Derives deterministic equivalents for student test error when trained on weak teacher labels.

entry.title: Knowing without Acting: The Disentangled Geometry of Safety Mechanisms in Large Language Models

author.name: Jinman Wu, Yi Xie, Shen Lin, Shiqian Zhao, Xiaofeng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes the Disentangled Safety Hypothesis (DSH) showing that LLM safety computation operates on two distinct subspaces: a Recognition Axis ('Knowing' harmful content) and an Execution Axis ('Acting' to refuse), which transition from entangled to independent across layers.

entry.title: Preventing Learning Stagnation in PPO by Scaling to 1 Million Parallel Environments

author.name: Michael Beukman, Khimya Khetarpal, Zeyu Zheng, Will Dabney, Jakob Foerster, Michael Dennis, Clare Lyle

entry.summary: Shows that PPO training plateaus arise from sample-based loss estimates becoming poor proxies for the true objective, and demonstrates that scaling to 1 million parallel environments prevents this stagnation. Provides theoretical framing as stochastic optimization of the outer loop.

entry.title: FlashPrefill: Instantaneous Pattern Discovery and Thresholding for Ultra-Fast Long-Context Prefilling

author.name: Qihang Fan, Huaibo Huang, Zhiying Wu, Juqiu Wang, Bingning Wang, Ran He

entry.summary: FlashPrefill proposes a framework for ultra-fast long-context prefilling by using instantaneous pattern discovery to find dynamic vertical, slash, and block-sparse attention patterns, combined with a dynamic thresholding mechanism that avoids expensive sorting. This addresses the quadratic attention bottleneck in LLMs during the compute-intensive prefilling phase.

entry.title: Physical Simulator In-the-Loop Video Generation

author.name: Lin Geng Foo, Mark He Huang, Alexandros Lattas, Stylianos Moschoglou, Thabo Beeler, Christian Theobalt

entry.summary: Introduces PSIVG, a framework that integrates a physical simulator into the video diffusion process to enforce physical consistency (gravity, inertia, collisions). Reconstructs 4D scenes from template videos, simulates physically plausible trajectories, and uses them to guide diffusion generation.

entry.title: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Masked Discrete Diffusion

author.name: Lijiang Li, Zuwei Long, Yunhang Shen, Heting Gao, Haoyu Cao, Xing Sun, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Chaoyou Fu

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-Diffusion, the first any-to-any multimodal model built entirely on masked discrete diffusion, unifying understanding and generation across text, speech, and images. Challenges the dominance of autoregressive architectures for multimodal LLMs.

entry.title: The current SOTA model was released without safety evals

author.name: Parv Mahajan

entry.summary: Building on yesterday's News coverage of the GPT-5.4 release, Highlights that OpenAI released GPT-5.4 Pro—likely the current most capable model for catastrophic-risk-relevant tasks including bioweapons R&D and cyberoffense—on March 5, 2026 without a system card or any publicly known safety evaluations. The post argues this is a recurring pattern (seen with o3-pro and GPT-5.2 Pro) and provides recommendations for fast independent post-deployment risk assessments.

entry.title: MultiHaystack: Benchmarking Multimodal Retrieval and Reasoning over 40K Images, Videos, and Documents

author.name: Dannong Xu, Zhongyu Yang, Jun Chen, Yingfang Yuan, Ming Hu, Lei Sun, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel, Chun-Mei Feng

entry.summary: Introduces MultiHaystack, the first benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs on both retrieval and reasoning over large-scale heterogeneous corpora (46K+ items across documents, images, and videos with 747 verifiable questions). Reveals that current MLLMs struggle with cross-modal retrieval at scale.

entry.title: Proof-of-Guardrail in AI Agents and What (Not) to Trust from It

author.name: Xisen Jin, Michael Duan, Qin Lin, Aaron Chan, Zhenglun Chen, Junyi Du, Xiang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes proof-of-guardrail, a system using Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to provide cryptographic proof that an AI agent's response was generated after a specific guardrail was applied, enabling verifiable safety claims.

entry.title: Restoring Linguistic Grounding in VLA Models via Train-Free Attention Recalibration

author.name: Ninghao Zhang, Bin Zhu, Shijie Zhou, Jingjing Chen

entry.summary: Reveals a critical 'linguistic blindness' failure mode in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models where policies ignore language instructions and rely on visual priors. Introduces ICBench diagnostic benchmark and a training-free attention recalibration fix.

entry.title: Gradient Flow Polarizes Softmax Outputs towards Low-Entropy Solutions

author.name: Aditya Varre, Mark Rofin and Nicolas Flammarion

entry.summary: Analyzes gradient flow dynamics of the value-softmax model (core building block of self-attention) and proves that gradient flow inherently drives optimization toward low-entropy outputs. Demonstrates this polarization effect across multiple objectives.

entry.title: Penguin-VL: Exploring the Efficiency Limits of VLM with LLM-based Vision Encoders

author.name: Boqiang Zhang, Lei Ke, Ruihan Yang, Qi Gao, Tianyuan Qu, Rossell Chen, Dong Yu, Leoweiliang

entry.summary: Presents Penguin-VL, a compact VLM (2B/8B) that replaces CLIP/SigLIP vision encoders with ones initialized from text-only LLMs. Argues that contrastive pretraining enforces coarse invariances that suppress fine-grained visual cues needed for complex reasoning.

entry.title: When Rubrics Fail: Error Enumeration as Reward in Reference-Free RL Post-Training for Virtual Try-On

author.name: Wisdom Ikezogwo, Mehmet Saygin Seyfioglu, Ranjay Krishna, Karim Bouyarmane

entry.summary: Proposes Implicit Error Counting (IEC) as a reward mechanism for RL post-training in reference-free settings like virtual try-on, where multiple valid outputs exist and traditional rubric-based rewards fail. Instead of checking correctness against a reference, IEC enumerates what's wrong with severity-weighted penalties.

entry.title: Revisiting the (Sub)Optimality of Best-of-N for Inference-Time Alignment

author.name: Ved Sriraman, Adam Block

entry.summary: Revisits the theoretical sub-optimality of Best-of-N sampling for LLM alignment, showing that under more realistic assumptions (particularly focusing on worst-case rather than expected reward), BoN is more competitive than prior theory suggests and more robust to reward hacking.

entry.title: Depth Charge: Jailbreak Large Language Models from Deep Safety Attention Heads

author.name: Jinman Wu, Yi Xie, Shiqian Zhao, Xiaofeng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SAHA, an attention-head-level jailbreak framework that exploits deeper, insufficiently aligned safety attention heads in open-source LLMs. Reveals that safety mechanisms are concentrated in specific attention heads that can be targeted.

entry.title: Lyapunov Probes for Hallucination Detection in Large Foundation Models

author.name: Bozhi Luan, Gen Li, Yalan Qin, Jifeng Guo, Yun Zhou, Faguo Wu, Hongwei Zheng, Wenjun Wu, Zhaoxin Fan

entry.summary: Frames LLM hallucination detection through dynamical systems stability theory, proposing Lyapunov Probes that enforce monotonic confidence decay under perturbations to distinguish factual from hallucinated outputs.

entry.title: Stem: Rethinking Causal Information Flow in Sparse Attention

author.name: Lin Niu, Xin Luo, Linchuan Xie, Yifu Sun, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, and S Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Stem rethinks causal attention through information flow perspective, proposing position-dependent top-k selection that accounts for the cumulative dependency of tokens in causal architectures. Initial positions attend everywhere, while later positions are more selective.

entry.title: CaTok: Taming Mean Flows for One-Dimensional Causal Image Tokenization

author.name: Yitong Chen, Zuxuan Wu, Xipeng Qiu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Presents CaTok, a 1D causal image tokenizer using a MeanFlow decoder for autoregressive visual generation. Addresses the challenge of extending causal next-token prediction to vision by learning causal 1D representations that support both fast one-step and high-fidelity multi-step generation.

entry.title: NOBLE: Accelerating Transformers with Nonlinear Low-Rank Branches

author.name: Ethan Smith (Canva Research)

entry.summary: Introduces NOBLE, an architectural augmentation adding nonlinear low-rank branches to transformer layers for pretraining from scratch (unlike LoRA which is for fine-tuning). Uses a CosNet activation with learnable frequency/phase, achieving up to 1.47x step speedup to reach baseline perplexity.

entry.title: Why Depth Matters in Parallelizable Sequence Models: A Lie Algebraic View

author.name: Gyuryang Heo, Timothy Ngotiaoco, Kazuki Irie, Samuel J. Gershman, Bernardo Sabatini

entry.summary: Provides a Lie-algebraic analysis of why depth matters in parallelizable sequence models (Transformers, SSMs), showing that error diminishes exponentially with depth through a correspondence with Lie algebra extensions.

entry.title: The Fragility Of Moral Judgment In Large Language Models

author.name: Tom van Nuenen, Pratik S. Sachdeva

entry.summary: Introduces a perturbation framework testing how stable LLM moral judgments are when surface-level features change while the underlying moral dilemma stays the same. Using ~3K Reddit AITA dilemmas, they show that lexical edits, POV shifts, and persuasion cues can flip model verdicts, revealing fragility in LLM moral reasoning.

entry.title: TumorChain: Interleaved Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Traceable Clinical Tumor Analysis

author.name: Sijing Li, Zhongwei Qiu, Jiang Liu, Wenqiao Zhang, Tianwei Lin, Yihan Xie, Jianxiang An, Boxiang Yun, Chenglin Yang, Jun Xiao, Guangyu Guo, Jiawen Yao, Wei Liu, Yuan Gao, Ke Yan, Weiwei Cao, Zhilin Zheng, Tony C. W. Mok, Kai Cao, Yu Shi, Jiuyu Zhang, Jian Zhou, Beng Chin Ooi, Yingda Xia, Ling Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces TumorChain, a multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning system for clinical tumor analysis with TumorCoT, a 1.5M CoT-labeled VQA dataset paired with 3D CT scans. Enables traceable step-by-step interpretation from imaging findings to pathology conclusions.

entry.title: EvoESAP: Non-Uniform Expert Pruning for Sparse MoE

author.name: Zongfang Liu, Shengkun Tang, Boyang Sun, Zhiqiang Shen, Xin Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces EvoESAP for non-uniform expert pruning in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models, decoupling within-layer ranking from across-layer budget allocation. Uses a speculative-decoding-inspired metric (ESAP) for pruning decisions.

entry.title: SPOT: Span-level Pause-of-Thought for Efficient and Interpretable Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yunlong Chu, Minglai Shao, Yuhang Liu, Bing Hao, Yumeng Lin, Jialu Wang, Ruijie Wang

entry.summary: SPOT proposes span-level pause-of-thought for latent reasoning in LLMs, enabling efficient and interpretable reasoning by operating at span granularity rather than point-to-point token alignment. This captures variable-length reasoning semantics while maintaining interpretability.

entry.title: From Entropy to Calibrated Uncertainty: Training Language Models to Reason About Uncertainty

author.name: Azza Jenane, Nassim Walha, Lukas Kuhn, Florian Buettner

entry.summary: Proposes a three-stage pipeline to post-train LLMs for calibrated uncertainty estimation: computing entropy-based uncertainty scores, calibrating via Platt scaling, then using RL to align the model with calibrated signals. Addresses the critical need for reliable uncertainty in high-stakes domains.

entry.title: SAHOO: Safeguarded Alignment for High-Order Optimization Objectives in Recursive Self-Improvement

author.name: Subramanyam Sahoo, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain, Divya Chaudhary

entry.summary: SAHOO introduces a framework to monitor and control alignment drift in recursive self-improvement systems through a Goal Drift Index, constraint preservation checks, and regression-risk quantification. Evaluated across 189 tasks showing quality gains while maintaining alignment.

entry.title: Efficient, Property-Aligned Fan-Out Retrieval via RL-Compiled Diffusion

author.name: Pengcheng Jiang, Judith Yue Li, Moonkyung Ryu, R. Lily Hu, Kun Su, Zhong Yi Wan, Liam Hebert, Hao Peng, Jiawei Han, Dima Kuzmin, Craig Boutilier

entry.summary: Proposes a method combining reinforcement learning with diffusion-based generative retrieval for set-valued (fan-out) retrieval problems. RL optimizes set-level objectives like diversity and coverage, while diffusion models enable efficient inference by distilling RL-tuned policies. This addresses the tension between RL's optimization power and its high inference cost.

entry.title: Data Analogies Enable Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer

author.name: Jonathan Yang, Chelsea Finn, Dorsa Sadigh

entry.summary: Studies how to best organize heterogeneous robot demonstration data for cross-embodiment transfer. Finds that perceptual shifts benefit from broad diversity while morphology shifts benefit more from structured 'data analogies'—demonstrations specifically crafted to bridge embodiment gaps.

entry.title: Causal Interpretation of Neural Network Computations with Contribution Decomposition

author.name: Joshua Brendan Melander, Zaki Alaoui, Shenghua Liu, Surya Ganguli, Stephen A. Baccus

entry.summary: Introduces CODEC (Contribution Decomposition), using sparse autoencoders to decompose neural network behavior into sparse motifs of hidden-neuron contributions, revealing causal processes beyond what activation analysis alone can show. Finds contributions grow in sparsity and dimensionality across layers.

entry.title: Ambiguity Collapse by LLMs: A Taxonomy of Epistemic Risks

author.name: Shira Gur-Arieh, Angelina Wang, Sina Fazelpour

entry.summary: Introduces 'ambiguity collapse' as a phenomenon where LLMs produce singular resolutions of genuinely ambiguous terms (like 'hate speech' or 'biased'), bypassing the human practices through which meaning is negotiated. Provides a taxonomy of epistemic risks.

entry.title: Confidence Before Answering: A Paradigm Shift for Efficient LLM Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Changcheng Li, Jiancan Wu, Hengheng Zhang, Zhengsu Chen, Guo An, Junxiang Qiu, Xiang Wang, Qi Tian

entry.summary: Proposes CoCA, a confidence-first paradigm where LLMs output confidence scores before generating answers, using GRPO reinforcement learning with segmented credit assignment to jointly optimize confidence calibration and answer accuracy.

entry.title: Improved high-dimensional estimation with Langevin dynamics and stochastic weight averaging

author.name: Stanley Wei, Alex Damian, Jason D. Lee

entry.summary: Shows that Langevin dynamics with stochastic weight averaging can circumvent information exponent barriers in high-dimensional estimation problems like tensor PCA and single-index models, matching or improving upon previous SGD results.

entry.title: Do Foundation Models Know Geometry? Probing Frozen Features for Continuous Physical Measurement

author.name: Yakov Pyotr Shkolnikov

entry.summary: Demonstrates that vision-language models encode continuous geometry far better than their text output can express: a simple linear probe extracts hand joint angles at 6.1° MAE from frozen features while text output achieves only 20°. LoRA fine-tuning narrows this gap, suggesting a pathway-training deficit rather than representational one.

entry.title: Transducing Language Models

author.name: V\'esteinn Sn{\ae}bjarnarson, Samuel Kiegeland, Tianyu Liu, Reda Boumasmoud, Ryan Cotterell, Tim Vieira

entry.summary: Formalizes 'transducing' language models—applying deterministic string-to-string transformations to convert model outputs between formats (e.g., BPE tokens to words, DNA to amino acids) while maintaining valid language model properties.

entry.title: Safer Reasoning Traces: Measuring and Mitigating Chain-of-Thought Leakage in LLMs

author.name: Patrick Ahrend, Tobias Eder, Xiyang Yang, Zhiyi Pan, Georg Groh

entry.summary: Studies Chain-of-Thought PII leakage in LLMs, finding CoT consistently increases privacy risk. Proposes a framework measuring risk-weighted token-level leakage across 11 PII types as a function of reasoning budget.

entry.title: Warm Starting State-Space Models with Automata Learning

author.name: William Fishell, Sam Nicholas Kouteili, and Mark Santolucito

entry.summary: Proves that Moore machines can be exactly realized as state-space models (SSMs), establishing formal correspondence between symbolic automata and continuous ML architectures. Shows SSMs require orders of magnitude more data than symbolic methods, and proposes warm-starting SSMs with automata learning.

entry.title: Unlocking ImageNet's Multi-Object Nature: Automated Large-Scale Multilabel Annotation

author.name: Junyu Chen, Md Yousuf Harun, Christopher Kanan

entry.summary: Presents an automated pipeline to convert ImageNet's training set into a multi-label dataset without human annotations, using self-supervised Vision Transformers for object discovery and semantic grouping to address the single-label assumption.

entry.title: Sparse Crosscoders for diffing MoEs and Dense models

author.name: Marmik Chaudhari, Nishkal Hundia, Idhant Gulati

entry.summary: Compares MoE and dense model internals using crosscoders (sparse autoencoder variant), finding that MoEs learn fewer unique features with higher activation density than dense model-specific features, and that shared features dominate representation.

entry.title: ReflexiCoder: Teaching Large Language Models to Self-Reflect on Generated Code and Self-Correct It via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Juyong Jiang, Jiasi Shen, Sunghun Kim, Kang Min Yoo, Jeonghoon Kim, Sungju Kim

entry.summary: Proposes ReflexiCoder, an RL framework that internalizes structured reasoning (generation, reflection, self-correction) directly into model weights for code generation, eliminating dependence on external oracles or execution feedback at inference time.

entry.title: DeepFact: Co-Evolving Benchmarks and Agents for Deep Research Factuality

author.name: Yukun Huang, Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro, Momchil Hardalov, Bhuwan Dhingra, Markus Dreyer, Venkatesh Saligrama

entry.summary: Proposes DeepFact, an evolving benchmarking framework for verifying claim-level factuality in deep research reports. Shows PhD experts achieve only 60.8% accuracy on verifiable claims, and proposes Audit-then-Score with revisable labels.

entry.title: Learning Next Action Predictors from Human-Computer Interaction

author.name: Omar Shaikh, Valentin Teutschbein, Kanishk Gandhi, Yikun Chi, Nick Haber, Thomas Robinson, Nilam Ram, Byron Reeves, Sherry Yang, Michael S. Bernstein, Diyi Yang

entry.summary: Formalizes next action prediction (NAP) from multimodal human-computer interactions, releasing a pipeline for labeling computer use and a dataset of 360K actions across 1,800 hours of phone usage from 20 users.

entry.title: Agnostic learning in (almost) optimal time via Gaussian surface area

author.name: Lucas Pesenti, Lucas Slot, Manuel Wiedmer

entry.summary: Improves the polynomial degree bound for agnostic learning under Gaussian marginals from O(Γ²/ε⁴) to Õ(Γ²/ε²), yielding near-optimal bounds for agnostically learning polynomial threshold functions in the SQ model.

entry.title: Diffusion Language Models Are Natively Length-Aware

author.name: Vittorio Rossi, Giacomo Cir\`o, Davide Beltrame, Luca Gandolfi, Paul R\"ottger and Dirk Hovy

entry.summary: Shows that Diffusion Language Models inherently encode output length information in latent prompt representations, enabling zero-shot dynamic context window cropping for computational savings.

entry.title: VLM-RobustBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robustness of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Rohit Saxena, Alessandro Suglia, Pasquale Minervini

entry.summary: Presents VLM-RobustBench, a comprehensive robustness benchmark with 49 augmentation types across 133 corrupted settings, revealing that visual severity is a weak predictor of VLM difficulty.

entry.title: Dynamic Chunking Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Akash Haridas, Utkarsh Saxena, Parsa Ashrafi Fashi, Mehdi Rezagholizadeh, Vikram Appia, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: DC-DiT introduces Dynamic Chunking for Diffusion Transformers, learning to adaptively compress 2D inputs into variable-length token sequences by allocating fewer tokens to uniform regions and more to detail-rich areas, learned end-to-end with diffusion training.

entry.title: What if? Emulative Simulation with World Models for Situated Reasoning

author.name: Ruiping Liu, Yufan Chen, Yuheng Zhang, Junwei Zheng, Kunyu Peng, Chengzhi Wu, Chenguang Huang, Di Wen, Jiaming Zhang, Kailun Yang, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: Introduces WanderDream, a large-scale dataset for mental exploration simulation in embodied AI—enabling models to reason about spatial 'what-if' questions without active exploration. Contains 15.8K panoramic videos and 158K QA pairs covering spatial reasoning tasks.

entry.title: COLD-Steer: Steering Large Language Models via In-Context One-step Learning Dynamics

author.name: Kartik Sharma, Rakshit S. Trivedi

entry.summary: Introduces COLD-Steer, a training-free activation steering method for LLMs that approximates the effect of fine-tuning on in-context examples without parameter updates. Offers two approaches: unit kernel approximation and gradient-based approximation, achieving better sample efficiency than existing methods.

entry.title: A recipe for scalable attention-based MLIPs: unlocking long-range accuracy with all-to-all node attention

author.name: Eric Qu, Brandon M. Wood, Aditi S. Krishnapriyan, Zachary W. Ulissi

entry.summary: Proposes AllScAIP, an attention-based machine learning interatomic potential that scales to O(100M) training samples with an all-to-all node attention component for long-range interactions. Shows that physics-based inductive biases help in low-data regimes but diminish with scale.

entry.title: Traversal-as-Policy: Log-Distilled Gated Behavior Trees as Externalized, Verifiable Policies for Safe, Robust, and Efficient Agents

author.name: Peiran Li, Jiashuo Sun, Fangzhou Lin, Shuo Xing, Tianfu Fu, Suofei Feng, Chaoqun Ni, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Proposes Traversal-as-Policy, which distills LLM agent execution logs into executable Gated Behavior Trees with deterministic safety gates, treating tree traversal rather than unconstrained generation as the control policy.

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Privacy Control for Sequential Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Sadia Asif, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri

entry.summary: Studies compositional privacy leakage in sequential multi-agent LLM systems, formalizing leakage via mutual information and deriving bounds on how local leakage amplifies across agents. Proposes privacy-regularized training.

entry.title: Attention Meets Reachability: Structural Equivalence and Efficiency in Grammar-Constrained LLM Decoding

author.name: Faruk Alpay, Bilge Senturk

entry.summary: Studies grammar-constrained decoding as coupling between autoregressive distributions and pushdown reachability oracles. Proves that language-equivalent grammars yield identical token masks but different computational costs, introducing structural ambiguity cost metrics.

entry.title: Thinking with Spatial Code for Physical-World Video Reasoning

author.name: Jieneng Chen, Wenxin Ma, Ruisheng Yuan, Yunzhi Zhang, Jiajun Wu, Alan Yuille

entry.summary: Introduces Thinking with Spatial Code, transforming RGB video into temporally coherent 3D representations with oriented bounding boxes for physical-world video QA, using RL fine-tuning with spatial rubric rewards.

entry.title: The DSA's Blind Spot: Algorithmic Audit of Advertising and Minor Profiling on TikTok

author.name: Sara Solarova, Matej Mosnar, Matus Tibensky, Jan Jakubcik, Adrian Bindas, Simon Liska, Filip Hossner, Mat\'u\v{s} Mesar\v{c}\'ik, Ivan Srba

entry.summary: Provides first empirical evidence that TikTok's algorithmic recommendations effectively profile minors for advertising-equivalent content despite DSA prohibitions, using sock-puppet auditing methodology. Reveals a regulatory blind spot where influencer/promotional content bypasses the DSA's narrow 'advertisement' definition.

entry.title: Contact-Grounded Policy: Dexterous Visuotactile Policy with Generative Contact Grounding

author.name: Zhengtong Xu, Yeping Wang, Ben Abbatematteo, Jom Preechayasomboon, Sonny Chan, Nick Colonnese, Amirhossein H. Memar

entry.summary: Presents Contact-Grounded Policy (CGP) for dexterous manipulation that predicts actual robot state and tactile feedback, using a learned contact-consistency mapping to convert predictions into controller-executable targets. Supports both dense tactile arrays and vision-based tactile sensors.

entry.title: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery for Ptychography via Evolutionary LLM Reasoning

author.name: Xiangyu Yin, Ming Du, Junjing Deng, Zhi Yang, Yimo Han, Yi Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Ptychi-Evolve, a framework using LLMs with evolutionary mechanisms to autonomously discover regularization algorithms for ptychographic image reconstruction. Discovered regularizers outperform conventional approaches on challenging imaging datasets.

entry.title: Structured Multidimensional Representation Learning for Large Language Models

author.name: Alaa El Ichi, Khalide Jbilou, Mohamed El Guide and Franck Dufrenois

entry.summary: Introduces structured spectral factorization of transformer embedding spaces using L-product tensor decomposition, creating a Tensor Transformer that decomposes the encoder into independent spectral sub-transformers while preserving standard Transformer semantics.

entry.title: EmboAlign: Aligning Video Generation with Compositional Constraints for Zero-Shot Manipulation

author.name: Gehao Zhang, Zhenyang Ni, Payal Mohapatra, Han Liu, Ruohan Zhang, Qi Zhu

entry.summary: Presents EmboAlign, a data-free framework that aligns video generation model outputs with compositional constraints from vision-language models for zero-shot robotic manipulation, using VLM spatial reasoning to complement VGM dynamics.

entry.title: Score-Guided Proximal Projection: A Unified Geometric Framework for Rectified Flow Editing

author.name: Vansh Bansal, James G Scott

entry.summary: Proposes Score-Guided Proximal Projection (SGPP), a unified framework for controlling rectified flow models that bridges deterministic optimization and stochastic sampling through proximal optimization balancing fidelity and realism.

entry.title: Visual Words Meet BM25: Sparse Auto-Encoder Visual Word Scoring for Image Retrieval

author.name: Donghoon Han, Eunhwan Park, Seunghyeon Seo

entry.summary: Presents BM25-V, applying Okapi BM25 scoring to sparse visual-word activations from Sparse Auto-Encoders on Vision Transformer features for interpretable image retrieval. Achieves Recall@200 ≥ 0.993 across seven benchmarks as an efficient first-stage retriever.

entry.title: StreamWise: Serving Multi-Modal Generation in Real-Time at Scale

author.name: Haoran Qiu, Gohar Irfan Chaudhry, Chaojie Zhang, \'I\~nigo Goiri, Esha Choukse, Rodrigo Fonseca, Ricardo Bianchini

entry.summary: Presents StreamWise, an adaptive serving system for real-time multi-modal generation workflows (podcast video generation) that dynamically manages quality-resource tradeoffs across LLMs, text-to-speech, and video-audio models under strict latency constraints.

entry.title: Evolving Medical Imaging Agents via Experience-driven Self-skill Discovery

author.name: Lin Fan, Pengyu Dai, Zhipeng Deng, Haolin Wang, Xun Gong, Yefeng Zheng, and Yafei Ou

entry.summary: Proposes MACRO, a self-evolving medical imaging agent that autonomously discovers and composes new tools from verified execution trajectories, shifting from static tool composition to experience-driven tool discovery for clinical image interpretation.

entry.title: The World Won't Stay Still: Programmable Evolution for Agent Benchmarks

author.name: Guangrui Li, Yaochen Xie, Yi Liu, Ziwei Dong, Xingyuan Pan, Tianqi Zheng, Jason Choi, Michael J. Morais, Binit Jha, Shaunak Mishra, Bingrou Zhou, Chen Luo, Monica Xiao Cheng, Dawn Song

entry.summary: Proposes ProEvolve, a graph-based framework for programmable evolution of agent benchmarks, addressing the problem that most benchmarks assume static environments while real-world tool sets and schemas change over time.

entry.title: A Persistent-State Dataflow Accelerator for Memory-Bound Linear Attention Decode on FPGA

author.name: Neelesh Gupta and Peter Wang and Rajgopal Kannan and Viktor K. Prasanna

entry.summary: Presents an FPGA accelerator for Gated DeltaNet linear attention decode that holds the full recurrent state in on-chip BRAM, converting the workload from memory-bound to compute-bound. Shows subquadratic sequence models are inherently more memory-bound than transformers at decode.

entry.title: Omni-Masked Gradient Descent: Memory-Efficient Optimization via Mask Traversal with Improved Convergence

author.name: Hui Yang, Tao Ren, Jinyang Jiang, Wan Tian, Yijie Peng

entry.summary: Proposes Omni-Masked Gradient Descent (OMGD) for memory-efficient LLM training with improved convergence guarantee of O(ε^-3) in nonconvex settings, better than the standard O(ε^-4) of existing memory-efficient methods.

entry.title: TADPO: Reinforcement Learning Goes Off-road

author.name: Zhouchonghao Wu, Raymond Song, Vedant Mundheda, Luis E. Navarro-Serment, Christof Schoenborn, Jeff Schneider

entry.summary: Proposes TADPO, a novel policy gradient method extending PPO for off-road autonomous driving that uses teacher-guided off-policy trajectories combined with on-policy student exploration. Develops an end-to-end vision-based RL system for high-speed off-road driving.

entry.title: Learning to Generate via Understanding: Understanding-Driven Intrinsic Rewarding for Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Jiadong Pan, Liang Li, Yuxin Peng, Yu-Ming Tang, Shuohuan Wang, Yu Sun, Hua Wu, Qingming Huang, Haifeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes using unified multimodal models' internal understanding capability to enhance generation quality through a token-level intrinsic text-image alignment reward, addressing the gap between understanding and generation in UMMs.

entry.title: Devil is in Narrow Policy: Unleashing Exploration in Driving VLA Models

author.name: Canyu Chen, Yuguang Yang, Zhewen Tan, Yizhi Wang, Ruiyi Zhan, Haiyan Liu, Xuanyao Mao, Jason Bao, Xinyue Tang, Linlin Yang, Bingchuan Sun, Yan Wang, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies a 'Narrow Policy' limitation in autonomous driving VLA models where imitation learning collapses exploration. Proposes Curious-VLA with trajectory expansion during IL and diversity-aware sampling during RL.

entry.title: Lifelong Embodied Navigation Learning

author.name: Xudong Wang, Jiahua Dong, Baichen Liu, Qi Lyu, Lianqing Liu, Zhi Han

entry.summary: Formalizes Lifelong Embodied Navigation Learning (LENL) where agents must continually learn new navigation tasks without catastrophic forgetting. Proposes Uni-Walker with Decoder Extension LoRA to decouple task-shared and task-specific knowledge.

entry.title: Partial Policy Gradients for RL in LLMs

author.name: Puneet Mathur, Branislav Kveton, Subhojyoti Mukherjee, Viet Dac Lai

entry.summary: Proposes partial policy gradients for RL in LLMs, optimizing over subsets of future rewards to enable modeling and comparison of different policy classes (greedy, K-step, segment policies) for persona-alignment conversations.

entry.title: Reflective Flow Sampling Enhancement

author.name: Zikai Zhou, Muyao Wang, Shitong Shao, Lichen Bai, Haoyi Xiong, Bo Han, Zeke Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Reflective Flow Sampling (RF-Sampling), a training-free inference enhancement framework for flow-matching models like FLUX, bridging the gap where existing enhancement techniques fail on flow models.

entry.title: CRIMSON: A Clinically-Grounded LLM-Based Metric for Generative Radiology Report Evaluation

author.name: Mohammed Baharoon, Thibault Heintz, Siavash Raissi, Mahmoud Alabbad, Mona Alhammad, Hassan AlOmaish, Sung Eun Kim, Oishi Banerjee, Pranav Rajpurkar

entry.summary: Introduces CRIMSON, a clinically grounded evaluation framework for chest X-ray report generation that assesses diagnostic correctness, contextual relevance, and patient safety with clinical significance levels.

entry.title: MAPO: Mixed Advantage Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Dialogue

author.name: Naifan Zhang, Ruihan Sun, Jinwei Su, Hengjie Yang, Zhengyuan Pan, Zhaohan Chen, Xiaofan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MAPO, a critic-free RL algorithm for multi-turn dialogue using dense process feedback from a judge model with Monte Carlo returns and mixed advantage estimation for turn-level optimization.

entry.title: Mind the Gap: Pitfalls of LLM Alignment with Asian Public Opinion

author.name: Hari Shankar, Vedanta S P, Sriharini Margapuri, Debjani Mazumder, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Abhijnan Chakraborty

entry.summary: Conducts a comprehensive multilingual audit of cultural alignment of LLMs (GPT-4o-Mini, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Llama 3.2, Mistral, Gemma 3) across Asian countries, focusing on religious attitudes. Finds significant misalignment between model distributions and public opinion.

entry.title: Agentic retrieval-augmented reasoning reshapes collective reliability under model variability in radiology question answering

author.name: Mina Farajiamiri, Jeta Sopa, Saba Afza, Lisa Adams, Felix Barajas Ordonez, Tri-Thien Nguyen, Mahshad Lotfinia, Sebastian Wind, Keno Bressem, Sven Nebelung, Daniel Truhn, Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh

entry.summary: Evaluates 34 LLMs on radiology questions comparing zero-shot inference with agentic retrieval-augmented reasoning. Finds that agentic RAG pipelines can synchronize errors across models and affect collective reliability in ways not captured by accuracy alone.

entry.title: MoEless: Efficient MoE LLM Serving via Serverless Computing

author.name: Hanfei Yu, Bei Ouyang, Shwai He, Ang Li, Hao Wang

entry.summary: MoEless proposes serverless computing for MoE LLM serving to address expert load imbalance in expert parallelism. Leverages serverless elasticity to dynamically scale overloaded experts while keeping idle experts dormant.

entry.title: Pinterest Canvas: Large-Scale Image Generation at Pinterest

author.name: Yu Wang, Eric Tzeng, Raymond Shiau, Jie Yang, Dmitry Kislyuk, Charles Rosenberg

entry.summary: Describes Pinterest Canvas, a large-scale image generation system for production image editing and enhancement. Uses a foundational diffusion model fine-tuned into task-specific variants, addressing the gap between flexible research models and strict product requirements.

entry.title: Training Flow Matching: The Role of Weighting and Parameterization

author.name: Anne Gagneux, S\'egol\`ene Martin, R\'emi Gribonval, Mathurin Massias

entry.summary: Systematically studies how loss weighting and output parameterization choices in flow matching training interact with data manifold dimensionality, model architecture, and dataset size. Provides practical insights for training design rather than proposing new methods.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence for Detecting Fetal Orofacial Clefts and Advancing Medical Education

author.name: Yuanji Zhang, Yuhao Huang, Haoran Dou, Xiliang Zhu, Chen Ling, Zhong Yang, Lianying Liang, Jiuping Li, Siying Liang, Rui Li, Yan Cao, Yuhan Zhang, Jiewei Lai, Yongsong Zhou, Hongyu Zheng, Xinru Gao, Cheng Yu, Liling Shi, Mengqin Yuan, Honglong Li, Xiaoqiong Huang, Chaoyu Chen, Jialin Zhang, Wenxiong Pan, Alejandro F. Frangi, Guangzhi He, Xin Yang, Yi Xiong, Linliang Yin, Xuedong Deng, Dong Ni

entry.summary: Presents an AI system for prenatal detection of fetal orofacial clefts, trained on 45K+ ultrasound images from 22 hospitals. Achieves >93% sensitivity and >95% specificity, matching senior radiologists and boosting junior radiologists' sensitivity by 6%+ as a copilot.

entry.title: SUREON: A Benchmark and Vision-Language-Model for Surgical Reasoning

author.name: Alejandra Perez, Anita Rau, Lee White, Busisiwe Mlambo, Chinedu Nwoye, Muhammad Abdullah Jamal, and Omid Mohareri

entry.summary: Introduces SUREON, a large-scale surgical reasoning benchmark and VLM harvested from surgical video lectures, defining 12 reasoning categories. Leverages expert narrations as a natural source of intent, rationale, and anticipation that current surgical AI lacks.

entry.title: Multimodal Large Language Models as Image Classifiers

author.name: Nikita Kisel, Illia Volkov, Klara Janouskova, Jiri Matas

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates MLLMs as image classifiers, showing that conflicting conclusions in prior work stem from evaluation protocol issues. Identifies and fixes key problems including output mapping, weak distractors, and overlooked design choices that substantially affect accuracy.

entry.title: The Generative AI Paradox on Evaluation: What It Can Solve, It May Not Evaluate

author.name: Juhyun Oh, Eunsu Kim, Inha Cha, Alice Oh

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs skilled at generation are equally good as evaluators, finding significant performance gaps on TriviaQA. Discovers 'unfaithful evaluation' where models correctly evaluate areas outside their competence.

entry.title: On the Reliability of AI Methods in Drug Discovery: Evaluation of Boltz-2 for Structure and Binding Affinity Prediction

author.name: Shunzhou Wan, Xibei Zhang, Xiao Xue, Peter V. Coveney

entry.summary: Extensively evaluates Boltz-2 AI model for protein-ligand structure and binding affinity prediction on 38K+ compounds, comparing with traditional docking and physics-based methods. Finds significant limitations despite AI hype.

entry.title: On the Value of Tokeniser Pretraining in Physics Foundation Models

author.name: Hadi Sotoudeh, Payel Mukhopadhyay, Ruben Ohana, Michael McCabe, Neil D. Lawrence, Shirley Ho, Miles Cranmer

entry.summary: Investigates whether pretraining the tokeniser separately before training physics foundation models improves accuracy and efficiency. Shows significant benefits from decoupling representation learning from dynamics learning.

entry.title: Gabor Primitives for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Wenqi Huang, Veronika Spieker, Nil Stolt-Ans\'o, Natascha Niessen, Maik Dannecker, Sevgi Gokce Kafali, Sila Kurugol, Julia A. Schnabel, and Daniel Rueckert

entry.summary: Proposes Gabor primitives for accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction, modulating Gaussian envelopes with complex exponentials to represent high-frequency structures. Extends the Gaussian splatting paradigm to MRI by enabling spectral support at arbitrary k-space locations.

entry.title: The Rise of AI in Weather and Climate Information and its Impact on Global Inequality

author.name: Amirpasha Mozaffari, Amanda Duarte, Lina Teckentrup, Stefano Materia, Gina E. C. Charnley, Lluis Palma, Eulalia Baulenas Serra, Dragana Bojovic, Paula Checchia, Aude Carreric, Francisco Doblas-Reyes

entry.summary: Examines how AI adoption in climate science risks amplifying North-South global inequality due to concentration of computing infrastructure, data, and model development in the Global North. Demonstrates systematic performance biases in weather/climate models for underserved regions.

entry.title: Any to Full: Prompting Depth Anything for Depth Completion in One Stage

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhou, Ruofeng Liu, Taichi Liu, Weijian Zuo, Shanshan Wang, Zhiqing Hong, and Desheng Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Any2Full, a one-stage depth completion framework that reformulates the task as scale-prompting adaptation of the Depth Anything foundation model. Achieves domain-general and pattern-agnostic depth completion without explicit relative-to-metric alignment.

entry.title: CodeScout: Contextual Problem Statement Enhancement for Software Agents

author.name: Manan Suri, Xiangci Li, Mehdi Shojaie, Songyang Han, Chao-Chun Hsu, Shweta Garg, Aniket Anand Deshmukh, Varun Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces CodeScout, a query refinement approach that converts underspecified coding requests into comprehensive problem statements through lightweight pre-exploration of the target codebase. Shows that structured analysis before task execution improves software agent performance.

entry.title: MoE Lens -- An Expert Is All You Need

author.name: Marmik Chaudhari, Idhant Gulati, Nishkal Hundia, Pranav Karra, Shivam Raval

entry.summary: Analyzes expert specialization in DeepSeek MoE model, revealing that despite 64 routed experts, the model predominantly relies on a few specialized experts whose outputs closely approximate the full ensemble prediction.

entry.title: Hierarchical Latent Action Model

author.name: Hanjung Kim, Lerrel Pinto, Seon Joo Kim

entry.summary: Presents HiLAM, a hierarchical latent action model that discovers latent skills from actionless video data by aggregating low-level latent action sequences into high-level temporal abstractions using a pretrained LAM.

entry.title: AnyCamVLA: Zero-Shot Camera Adaptation for Viewpoint Robust Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Hyeongjun Heo, Seungyeon Woo, Sang Min Kim, Junho Kim, Junho Lee, Yonghyeon Lee, Young Min Kim

entry.summary: Proposes AnyCamVLA, a zero-shot camera adaptation framework for Vision-Language-Action models that virtually adjusts test-time camera views to match training configuration using novel view synthesis, requiring no additional data or fine-tuning.

entry.title: LUMINA: LLM-Guided GPU Architecture Exploration via Bottleneck Analysis

author.name: Tao Zhang, Rui Ma, Shuotao Xu, Peng Cheng, Yongqiang Xiong

entry.summary: Presents LUMINA, an LLM-driven GPU architecture design space exploration framework that extracts architectural knowledge from simulator code and performs sensitivity studies to compose DSE rules, achieving significant speedups over traditional methods.

entry.title: InfoGatherer: Principled Information Seeking via Evidence Retrieval and Strategic Questioning

author.name: Maksym Taranukhin, Shuyue Stella Li, Evangelos Milios, Geoff Pleiss, Yulia Tsvetkov, Vered Shwartz

entry.summary: Proposes InfoGatherer, a framework for principled information seeking in high-stakes LLM deployments that combines evidence retrieval with strategic follow-up questioning, determining what remains unknown and when to stop asking.

entry.title: RAC: Rectified Flow Auto Coder

author.name: Sen Fang, Yalin Feng, Yanxin Zhang, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Proposes Rectified Flow Auto Coder (RAC) to replace traditional VAEs, achieving multi-step decoding via flow timesteps, bidirectional inference (reducing parameters by 41%), and improved generation quality at 70% lower computational cost.

entry.title: Moving Through Clutter: Scaling Data Collection and Benchmarking for 3D Scene-Aware Humanoid Locomotion via Virtual Reality

author.name: Beichen Wang, Yuanjie Lu, Linji Wang, Liuchuan Yu, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces Moving Through Clutter (MTC), an open-source VR-based dataset coupling full-body human locomotion with 3D cluttered scene geometry. Addresses a significant gap in humanoid locomotion research which has focused on open/flat environments rather than realistic cluttered spaces.

entry.title: ViewFusion: Structured Spatial Thinking Chains for Multi-View Reasoning

author.name: Xingjian Tao, Yiwei Wang, Yujun Cai, Yifan Song, Jing Tang

entry.summary: Proposes ViewFusion, a two-stage framework for multi-view spatial reasoning in VLMs that explicitly separates cross-view spatial pre-alignment from question answering. Addresses the problem of models underutilizing cross-view relations.

entry.title: StruVis: Enhancing Reasoning-based Text-to-Image Generation via Thinking with Structured Vision

author.name: Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Kaiyu Lei, Ziqiao Weng, Xu Zheng, Lutao Jiang, Teng Li, Yangfu Li, Ziyuan Huang, Linfeng Zhang, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Proposes StruVis, a framework enhancing text-to-image generation through structured visual thinking that uses lightweight visual representations (layouts, sketches) instead of full image generation during reasoning.

entry.title: Latent Diffusion-Based 3D Molecular Recovery from Vibrational Spectra

author.name: Wenjin Wu, Ale\v{s} Leonardis, Linjiang Chen, Jianbo Jiao

entry.summary: Introduces IR-GeoDiff, a latent diffusion model that recovers 3D molecular geometries from infrared spectra, addressing the limitation of existing methods that only work with 1D SMILES or 2D molecular graphs.

entry.title: Cross-Resolution Distribution Matching for Diffusion Distillation

author.name: Feiyang Chen, Hongpeng Pan, Haonan Xu, Xinyu Duan, Yang Yang, Zhefeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-Resolution Distribution Matching Distillation (RMD) for diffusion model acceleration, bridging cross-resolution distribution gaps using logSNR-based mapping for multi-resolution cascaded inference.

entry.title: Towards Motion Turing Test: Evaluating Human-Likeness in Humanoid Robots

author.name: Mingzhe Li, Mengyin Liu, Zekai Wu, Xincheng Lin, Junsheng Zhang, Ming Yan, Zengye Xie, Changwang Zhang, Chenglu Wen, Lan Xu, Siqi Shen, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes the Motion Turing Test framework to evaluate whether humans can distinguish humanoid robot poses from human poses using only kinematic (SMPL-X) information, with the HHMotion dataset of 1,000 motion sequences.

entry.title: DreamToNav: Generalizable Navigation for Robots via Generative Video Planning

author.name: Valerii Serpiva, Jeffrin Sam, Chidera Simon, Hajira Amjad, Iana Zhura, Artem Lykov, and Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: Presents DreamToNav, using generative video models (NVIDIA Cosmos 2.5) as planning engines for robot navigation, translating natural language prompts into executable motion through synthesized video sequences.

entry.title: Whisper-CD: Accurate Long-Form Speech Recognition using Multi-Negative Contrastive Decoding

author.name: Hoseong Ahn, Jeongyun Chae, Yoonji Park, Kyuhong Shim

entry.summary: Proposes Whisper-CD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework for Whisper that reduces hallucinations and repetitions in long-form speech recognition by contrasting clean audio against acoustically perturbed negatives.

entry.title: DC-Merge: Improving Model Merging with Directional Consistency

author.name: Han-Chen Zhang, Zi-Hao Zhou, Mao-Lin Luo, Shimin Di, Min-Ling Zhang, Tong Wei

entry.summary: DC-Merge improves model merging by maintaining directional consistency of singular spaces between merged multi-task vectors and individual task vectors. Addresses imbalanced energy distribution and geometric inconsistency through spectral normalization and alignment.

entry.title: WorldCache: Accelerating World Models for Free via Heterogeneous Token Caching

author.name: Weilun Feng, Guoxin Fan, Haotong Qin, Chuanguang Yang, Mingqiang Wu, Yuqi Li, Xiangqi Li, Zhulin An, Libo Huang, Dingrui Wang, Longlong Liao, Michele Magno, Yongjun Xu

entry.summary: WorldCache proposes a caching framework for diffusion-based world models that addresses token heterogeneity from multi-modal coupling and non-uniform temporal dynamics. Uses curvature-guided prediction for heterogeneous token caching.

entry.title: CHMv2: Improvements in Global Canopy Height Mapping using DINOv3

author.name: John Brandt, Seungeun Yi, Jamie Tolan, Xinyuan Li, Peter Potapov, Jessica Ertel, Justine Spore, Huy V. Vo, Micha\"el Ramamonjisoa, Patrick Labatut, Piotr Bojanowski, Camille Couprie

entry.summary: CHMv2 presents a global meter-resolution canopy height map from satellite imagery using DINOv3-based depth estimation trained against airborne laser scanning data. Substantially improves accuracy over existing products, especially for tall forests.

entry.title: Locating and Editing Figure-Ground Organization in Vision Transformers

author.name: Stefan Arnold, Ren\'e Gr\"obner

entry.summary: Investigates where Vision Transformers (BEiT) implement figure-ground organization, specifically the Gestalt convexity prior. Uses synthetic stimuli to create perceptual conflicts and logit attribution to identify functional units responsible for convex completion preferences.

entry.title: GreenRFM: Toward a resource-efficient radiology foundation model

author.name: Yingtai Li, Shuai Ming, Mingyue Zhao, Haoran Lai, Rongsheng Wang, Rui Zhou, Rundong Wang, Yujia Li, Wei Wei, Shaohua Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Presents GreenRFM, a resource-efficient pre-training framework for radiology foundation models that achieves SOTA performance while reducing computational requirements by orders of magnitude. Uses principled supervision design rather than brute-force scaling.

entry.title: When One Modality Rules Them All: Backdoor Modality Collapse in Multimodal Diffusion Models

author.name: Qitong Wang, Haoran Dai, Haotian Zhang, Christopher Rasmussen, Binghui Wang

entry.summary: Investigates 'Backdoor Modality Collapse' in multimodal diffusion models—where backdoor attacks degenerate to rely on a subset of modalities. Introduces metrics (TMA, CTI) to quantify this phenomenon and shows that attacking multiple modalities doesn't necessarily strengthen backdoor attacks.

entry.title: NEGATE: Constrained Semantic Guidance for Linguistic Negation in Text-to-Video Diffusion

author.name: Taewon Kang, Ming C. Lin

entry.summary: Presents a formal treatment of linguistic negation in diffusion-based video generation by modeling it as a semantic constraint on classifier-free guidance. Handles object absence, graded non-inversion, multi-negation composition, and scope-sensitive disambiguation without retraining.

entry.title: Omni-C: Compressing Heterogeneous Modalities into a Single Dense Encoder

author.name: Kin Wai Lau, Yasar Abbas Ur Rehman, Lai-Man Po, Pedro Porto Buarque de Gusm\~ao

entry.summary: Proposes Omni-C, a single dense Transformer encoder that learns shared representations across images, audio, and text through unimodal contrastive pretraining, avoiding MoE overhead while remaining competitive.

entry.title: Bias In, Bias Out? Finding Unbiased Subnetworks in Vanilla Models

author.name: Ivan Luiz De Moura Matos, Abdel Djalil Sad Saoud, Ekaterina Iakovleva, Vito Paolo Pastore, Enzo Tartaglione

entry.summary: Introduces BISE, a method to extract bias-free subnetworks from standard trained models via pruning without retraining, showing that fair subnetworks already exist within vanilla models.

entry.title: RACAS: Controlling Diverse Robots With a Single Agentic System

author.name: Dylan R. Ashley, Jan Przepi\'ora, Yimeng Chen, Ali Abualsaud, Nurzhan Yesmagambet, Shinkyu Park, Eric Feron, J\"urgen Schmidhuber

entry.summary: Introduces RACAS, a robot-agnostic control architecture using three LLM/VLM-based modules communicating via natural language for closed-loop control of diverse robots, validated across structurally different platforms.

entry.title: Making Reconstruction FID Predictive of Diffusion Generation FID

author.name: Tongda Xu, Mingwei He, Shady Abu-Hussein, Jose Miguel Hernandez-Lobato, Haotian Zhang, Kai Zhao, Chao Zhou, Ya-Qin Zhang, Yan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes interpolated FID (iFID) as a variant of reconstruction FID that strongly correlates with generation FID in latent diffusion models, and explains why rFID correlates poorly with gFID through phase-specific analysis.

entry.title: Random Dot Product Graphs as Dynamical Systems: Limitations and Opportunities

author.name: Giulio Valentino Dalla Riva

entry.summary: Investigates learning differential equations governing temporal network evolution within Random Dot Product Graphs, identifying three fundamental obstructions (gauge freedom, realizability constraints, trajectory recovery artifacts) and developing a geometric framework using principal fiber bundles.

entry.title: Safe-Night VLA: Seeing the Unseen via Thermal-Perceptive Vision-Language-Action Models for Safety-Critical Manipulation

author.name: Dian Yu, Qingchuan Zhou, Bingkun Huang, Majid Khadiv, Zewen Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Safe-Night VLA, a multimodal manipulation framework integrating thermal infrared perception into vision-language-action models with explicit safety constraints for thermal-aware manipulation in unstructured environments.

entry.title: Bridging Domains through Subspace-Aware Model Merging

author.name: Levy Chaves, Chao Zhou, Rebekka Burkholz, Eduardo Valle, Sandra Avila

entry.summary: Proposes SCORE, a model merging method that resolves subspace conflicts between models fine-tuned on different domains using singular value decomposition analysis of parameter competition in the task matrix.

entry.title: Training-free Latent Inter-Frame Pruning with Attention Recovery

author.name: Dennis Menn, Yuedong Yang, Bokun Wang, Xiwen Wei, Mustafa Munir, Feng Liang, Radu Marculescu, Chenfeng Xu, Diana Marculescu

entry.summary: Proposes LIPAR, a training-free framework that prunes temporally redundant latent patches in video generation with a novel attention recovery mechanism, achieving 1.45x throughput improvement without quality degradation.

entry.title: HART: Data-Driven Hallucination Attribution and Evidence-Based Tracing for Large Language Models

author.name: Shize Liang, Hongzhi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes HART, a data-driven framework for hallucination attribution that establishes structured span-level correspondences between hallucination types, error generation mechanisms, and external factual evidence for improved interpretability.

entry.title: Shifting Adaptation from Weight Space to Memory Space: A Memory-Augmented Agent for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Bowen Chen, Qiaohui Gao, Shaowen Wan, Shanhui Sun, Wei Liu, Xiang Li, Tianming Liu, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes MemSeg-Agent, a memory-augmented segmentation agent that shifts adaptation from weight space to memory space, enabling few-shot learning, federated learning, and test-time adaptation within a unified architecture for medical image segmentation.

entry.title: Reference-guided Policy Optimization for Molecular Optimization via LLM Reasoning

author.name: Xuan Li, Zhanke Zhou, Zongze Li, Jiangchao Yao, Yu Rong, Lu Zhang, Bo Han

entry.summary: Introduces Reference-guided Policy Optimization (RePO) for molecular optimization using LLMs, balancing exploration of new molecules with exploitation of reference molecules. Addresses failures of standard SFT and RLVR in molecular optimization.

entry.title: CORE-Seg: Reasoning-Driven Segmentation for Complex Lesions via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yuxin Xie, Yuming Chen, Yishan Yang, Yi Zhou, Tao Zhou, Zhen Zhao, Jiacheng Liu, Huazhu Fu

entry.summary: Introduces CORE-Seg for reasoning-driven complex lesion segmentation with ComLesion-14K, the first diverse CoT benchmark. Uses reinforcement learning to align reasoning with segmentation via a Semantic-Guided Prompt Adapter.

entry.title: OVGGT: O(1) Constant-Cost Streaming Visual Geometry Transformer

author.name: Si-Yu Lu, Po-Ting Chen, Hui-Che Hsu, Sin-Ye Jhong, Wen-Huang Cheng, Yung-Yao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces OVGGT, a training-free framework that bounds both memory and compute to O(1) for streaming 3D reconstruction from video, using Self-Selective Caching to compress KV cache based on FFN residual magnitudes.

entry.title: MM-ISTS: Cooperating Irregularly Sampled Time Series Forecasting with Multimodal Vision-Text LLMs

author.name: Zhi Lei, Chenxi Liu, Hao Miao, Wanghui Qiu, Bin Yang, Chenjuan Guo

entry.summary: Presents MM-ISTS, a multimodal framework using vision-text LLMs to forecast irregularly sampled time series by bridging temporal, visual, and textual modalities. Uses a two-stage encoding mechanism with cross-modal vision-text encoding.

entry.title: MOSIV: Multi-Object System Identification from Videos

author.name: Chunjiang Liu, Xiaoyuan Wang, Qingran Lin, Albert Xiao, Haoyu Chen, Shizheng Wen, Hao Zhang, Lu Qi, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Laszlo A. Jeni, Min Xu, Yizhou Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces MOSIV, a framework for multi-object system identification from videos that optimizes continuous per-object material parameters using a differentiable simulator guided by geometric objectives from video.

entry.title: Agentic LLM Planning via Step-Wise PDDL Simulation: An Empirical Characterisation

author.name: Kai G\"obel, Pierrick Lorang, Patrik Zips, and Tobias Gl\"uck

entry.summary: Presents PyPDDLEngine, an open-source PDDL simulation engine exposing planning operations as LLM tool calls. Evaluates LLMs as interactive search policies that select one action at a time on Blocksworld instances.

entry.title: Dynamic Momentum Recalibration in Online Gradient Learning

author.name: Zhipeng Yao, Rui Yu, Guisong Chang, Ying Li, Yu Zhang, Dazhou Li

entry.summary: Proposes SGDF (SGD with Filter), an optimizer using optimal linear filtering principles to dynamically compute time-varying momentum gains that minimize mean-squared error in gradient estimation.

entry.title: Spatial Colour Mixing Illusions as a Perception Stress Test for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Nicoleta-Nina Basoc, Adrian Cosma, Emilian Radoi

entry.summary: Studies how spatial colour mixing distortions expose systematic perceptual weaknesses in VLMs, finding that accuracy degrades sharply with distortion and scaling language models doesn't reliably help.

entry.title: FreeOcc: Training-free Panoptic Occupancy Prediction via Foundation Models

author.name: Andrew Caunes, Thierry Chateau, Vincent Fremont

entry.summary: Proposes FreeOcc, a training-free pipeline using pretrained foundation models for panoptic occupancy prediction from multi-view images, eliminating the need for costly 3D supervision or domain-specific training.

entry.title: Making Training-Free Diffusion Segmentors Scale with the Generative Power

author.name: Benyuan Meng, Qianqian Xu, Zitai Wang, Xiaochun Cao, Longtao Huang, Qingming Huang

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses the failure of training-free diffusion segmentors to scale with generative model power, proposing solutions for cross-attention map quality issues across attention layers and timesteps.

entry.title: LIT-RAGBench: Benchmarking Generator Capabilities of Large Language Models in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Koki Itai, Shunichi Hasegawa, Yuta Yamamoto, Gouki Minegishi, and Masaki Otsuki

entry.summary: Introduces LIT-RAGBench, evaluating LLM generator capabilities across five categories (Integration, Reasoning, Logic, Table, Abstention) under unified RAG conditions. Addresses gaps in existing RAG benchmarks.

entry.title: NOVA: Next-step Open-Vocabulary Autoregression for 3D Multi-Object Tracking in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kai Luo, Xu Wang, Rui Fan, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: NOVA reformulates 3D multi-object tracking as autoregressive spatio-temporal semantic sequence completion using LLMs, enabling open-vocabulary tracking beyond closed-set assumptions. Combines physical motion continuity with linguistic priors.

entry.title: AI End-to-End Radiation Treatment Planning Under One Second

author.name: Simon Arberet, Riqiang Gao, Martin Kraus, Florin C. Ghesu, Wilko Verbakel, Mamadou Diallo, Anthony Magliari, Venkatesan Karuppusamy, Sushil Beriwal, REQUITE Consortium, Ali Kamen, Dorin Comaniciu

entry.summary: AIRT introduces an end-to-end deep learning framework for radiation therapy planning that generates deliverable VMAT prostate plans from CT images in under one second, including leaf sequencing. Uses differentiable dose feedback and adversarial fluence map shaping.

entry.title: LATO: 3D Mesh Flow Matching with Structured TOpology Preserving LAtents

author.name: Tianhao Zhao, Youjia Zhang, Hang Long, Jinshen Zhang, Wenbing Li, Yang Yang, Gongbo Zhang, Jozef Hladk\'y, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner, and Wei Yang

entry.summary: LATO introduces a topology-preserving latent representation for 3D mesh generation using Vertex Displacement Fields, sparse voxel VAE, and flow matching. A dedicated connection head predicts edge connectivity directly without isosurface extraction.

entry.title: Certified and accurate computation of function space norms of deep neural networks

author.name: Johannes Gr\"undler, Moritz Maibaum, Philipp Petersen

entry.summary: Presents a framework for certified computation of function space norms (Lebesgue, Sobolev) for deep neural networks, combining interval arithmetic with adaptive refinement and quadrature. Provides guaranteed upper and lower bounds by exploiting neural network structure directly.

entry.title: Boosting deep Reinforcement Learning using pretraining with Logical Options

author.name: Zihan Ye, Phil Chau, Raban Emunds, Jannis Bl\"uml, Cedric Derstroff, Quentin Delfosse, Oleg Arenz, Kristian Kersting

entry.summary: Proposes H²RL, a hybrid approach combining symbolic logical option-based pretraining with deep reinforcement learning to avoid reward exploitation. Uses two-stage framework that injects symbolic structure into neural agents without sacrificing expressivity.

entry.title: Can LLM Aid in Solving Constraints with Inductive Definitions?

author.name: Weizhi Feng, Shidong Shen, Jiaxiang Liu, Taolue Chen, Fu Song and Zhilin Wu

entry.summary: Leverages LLMs to generate auxiliary lemmas for solving constraints with inductive definitions, proposing a neuro-symbolic approach that integrates LLMs with constraint solvers iteratively.

entry.title: Towards Neural Graph Data Management

author.name: Yufei Li, Yisen Gao, Jiaxin Bai, Jiaxuan Xiong, Haoyu Huang, Zhongwei Xie, Hong Ting Tsang, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: Introduces NGDBench, a benchmark for evaluating neural graph database capabilities across five domains with full Cypher query support, noise injection, and dynamic operations. Reveals significant limitations of current LLMs and RAG methods.

entry.title: JAWS: Enhancing Long-term Rollout of Neural Operators via Spatially-Adaptive Jacobian Regularization

author.name: Fengxiang Nie, Yasuhiro Suzuki

entry.summary: Proposes JAWS, a spatially-adaptive Jacobian regularization method for neural operators that addresses the contraction-dissipation dilemma in long-horizon autoregressive rollouts through probabilistic, heteroscedastic uncertainty.

entry.title: FuseDiff: Symmetry-Preserving Joint Diffusion for Dual-Target Structure-Based Drug Design

author.name: Jianliang Wu, Anjie Qiao, Zhen Wang, Zhewei Wei and Sheng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes FuseDiff, an end-to-end diffusion model for dual-target drug design that jointly generates a ligand and two pocket-specific binding poses, using Dual-target Local Context Fusion for message passing.

entry.title: Tool-Genesis: A Task-Driven Tool Creation Benchmark for Self-Evolving Language Agent

author.name: Bowei Xia, Mengkang Hu, Shijian Wang, Jiarui Jin, Wenxiang Jiao, Yuan Lu, Kexin Li and Ping Luo

entry.summary: Introduces Tool-Genesis, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' tool creation capabilities across interface compliance, functional correctness, and downstream utility dimensions.

entry.title: DreamCAD: Scaling Multi-modal CAD Generation using Differentiable Parametric Surfaces

author.name: Mohammad Sadil Khan, Muhammad Usama, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Didier Stricker, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal, Jiankang Deng, and Ismail Elezi

entry.summary: Proposes DreamCAD, a multimodal generative framework producing editable BRep CAD models from point-level supervision using differentiable parametric surfaces, enabling training on millions of unannotated 3D meshes.

entry.title: Rethinking Concept Bottleneck Models: From Pitfalls to Solutions

author.name: Merve Tapli and Quentin Bouniot and Wolfgang Stammer and Zeynep Akata and Emre Akbas

entry.summary: Introduces CBM-Suite to address fundamental limitations of Concept Bottleneck Models, including an entropy-based metric for concept relevance, a fix for the 'linearity problem', and systematic study of visual backbones.

entry.title: Keeping the Evidence Chain: Semantic Evidence Allocation for Training-Free Token Pruning in Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Jiaqi Li, Shuntian Zheng, Yixian Shen, Jia-Hong Huang, Xiaoman Lu, Minzhe Ni, Yu Guan

entry.summary: Proposes SemVID, a training-free token pruning framework for Video Temporal Grounding that preserves boundary-sensitive evidence and cross-frame reasoning chains. Identifies two VTG-specific pruning principles (Evidence Retention and Connectivity Strength) that prevent degradation seen with naive pruning.

entry.title: Interpretable Perception and Reasoning for Audiovisual Geolocation

author.name: Yiyang Su and Xiaoming Liu

entry.summary: Introduces audiovisual geolocation framework with AVG benchmark (20K clips, 1K locations) and a three-stage approach using acoustic decomposition via mixture-autoregressive sparse autoencoders, combined with visual and audio cues for geographic disambiguation.

entry.title: TML-Bench: Benchmark for Data Science Agents on Tabular ML Tasks

author.name: Mykola Pinchuk

entry.summary: Introduces TML-Bench, benchmarking 10 open-source LLMs on Kaggle-style tabular ML tasks across different time budgets, measuring end-to-end correctness and reliability of autonomous coding agents. MiniMax-M2.1 achieves best aggregate performance.

entry.title: Layer-wise Instance Binding for Regional and Occlusion Control in Text-to-Image Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Ruidong Chen, Yancheng Bai, Xuanpu Zhang, Jianhao Zeng, Lanjun Wang, Dan Song, Lei Sun, Xiangxiang Chu, Anan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes LayerBind for training-free regional and occlusion control in text-to-image diffusion transformers by modeling regional generation as distinct layers that are bound during early denoising stages.

entry.title: RouteGoT: Node-Adaptive Routing for Cost-Efficient Graph of Thoughts Reasoning

author.name: Yuhang Liu, Ruijie Wang, Yunlong Chu, Bing Hao, Yumeng Lin, Shengzhong Liu, Minglai Shao

entry.summary: Proposes RouteGoT, a node-adaptive routing framework for Graph of Thoughts reasoning that assigns different model capabilities to different nodes based on task complexity, reducing token consumption while maintaining or improving accuracy.

entry.title: Self-Auditing Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Few-Shot 3D Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Son Thai Ly and Hien V. Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes SEA-PEFT, a self-auditing parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that automatically configures adapters during fine-tuning via a search-audit-allocate loop, removing the need for manual adapter design in few-shot 3D medical image segmentation.

entry.title: ROSE: Reordered SparseGPT for More Accurate One-Shot Large Language Models Pruning

author.name: Mingluo Su and Huan Wang
